### File: `modules/components/admin/analytics/signup-chart.tsx`

SHA-256: `bdbfcc7f2d2d21179a66608c75553e14cfc35c3e11e04928a32a9ac393557f71`

```tsx
"use client";
import { useState } from "react";
import AnalyticsPanel from "@khatab/design/ui/analytics-panel";
import TimeSeriesChart from "@khatab/design/ui/time-series-chart";
import { Radio } from "@khatab/design/ui/choice-controls";
import type { AnalyticsDay, AnalyticsMetric, AnalyticsMetrics } from "@platform/types/admin-analytics";
import type { AnalyticsLabels } from "@platform/types/admin-analytics";
import MetricChange from "./metric-change";
import { formatAnalyticsNumber, formatAnalyticsDate, formatChartDay } from "@platform/features/admin/analytics/helpers/format";
export default function SignupChart({ daily, metrics, labels }: { daily: AnalyticsDay[]; metrics: AnalyticsMetrics; labels: AnalyticsLabels }) {
  const [metric, setMetric] = useState<AnalyticsMetric>("students");
  const total = metric === "students" ? metrics.studentsMonth : metrics.enrollmentsMonth;
  const previous = metric === "students" ? metrics.studentsPreviousMonth : metrics.enrollmentsPreviousMonth;
  const data = daily.map(day => ({ tick: formatChartDay(day.day), label: formatAnalyticsDate(day.day, { day: "numeric", month: "long" }),
    current: day[metric], previous: metric === "students" ? day.previousStudents : day.previousEnrollments }));
  return <AnalyticsPanel title={labels.chartTitle} description={labels.chartDescription} className="analytics-signup-panel">
    <div className="analytics-chart-toolbar"><div className="analytics-chart-summary">
      <span>{labels[metric]} · {labels.month}</span><strong className="numeral">{formatAnalyticsNumber(total)}</strong>
      <MetricChange labels={labels} current={total} previous={previous} />
    </div>
    <fieldset className="analytics-chart-controls"><legend>{labels.metric}</legend>
      <Radio name="analytics-metric" label={labels.students} value="students" checked={metric === "students"} onChange={() => setMetric("students")} />
      <Radio name="analytics-metric" label={labels.enrollments} value="enrollments" checked={metric === "enrollments"} onChange={() => setMetric("enrollments")} />
    </fieldset></div>
    <div className="analytics-legend"><span data-series="current">{labels.current}</span><span data-series="previous">{labels.previous}</span></div>
    {!data.some(point => point.current > 0) && <p className="analytics-empty-note">{labels.chartEmpty}</p>}
    <TimeSeriesChart data={data} title={labels.chartTitle} labels={{ current: labels.current, previous: labels.previous, value: labels[metric] }} />
    <details className="analytics-data-table"><summary>{labels.dailyTable}</summary><div className="analytics-table-scroll">
      <table><caption>{labels[metric]}</caption><thead><tr><th scope="col">{labels.day}</th><th scope="col">{labels.current}</th><th scope="col">{labels.previous}</th></tr></thead>
        <tbody>{data.map(point => <tr key={point.label}><th scope="row">{point.label}</th><td>{point.current}</td><td>{point.previous ?? "—"}</td></tr>)}</tbody></table>
    </div></details>
  </AnalyticsPanel>;
}
```

### File: `modules/components/admin/course-delete-button.tsx`

SHA-256: `9f1874835155b0ba307609f9f0164125895c8c5af31f3d75c0562ae25c04116a`

```tsx
"use client";
import { useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useAsyncCommand } from "@platform/hooks/use-async-command";
import { httpRequest } from "@platform/lib/http-request";
import { endpoints } from "@platform/config/navigation";
import type { AdminCourseRow, AdminCoursesLabels } from "@platform/types/admin-courses";
import AdminDialog from "./admin-dialog";
export default function CourseDeleteButton({ course, labels }: { course: AdminCourseRow; labels: AdminCoursesLabels }) {
 const [open,setOpen] = useState(false), router = useRouter(), command = useAsyncCommand(labels.error);
 async function remove() {
  const deleted = await command.run(() => httpRequest({ path: endpoints.adminCourseDelete(course.slug), body: { confirmSlug: course.slug }, failureLabel: labels.error, decode: value => {
   if (!value || typeof value !== "object" || !("deleted" in value) || value.deleted !== true) throw new Error(labels.error);
   return true;
  } }));
  if (deleted) { setOpen(false); router.refresh(); }
 }
 return <div className="lms-course-delete"><button type="button" className="lms-admin-danger" aria-haspopup="dialog" onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>{labels.remove}</button>
  {open && <AdminDialog title={labels.confirmTitle} closeLabel={labels.close} pending={command.pending} onClose={() => setOpen(false)}>
   <p><strong>{course.title}</strong></p><p>{course.students ? labels.protectedCourse : labels.confirmRemove}</p>
   {command.error && <p className="lms-error" role="alert">{command.error}</p>}
   <div className="lms-admin-actions">{!course.students && <button type="button" className="btn-primary" disabled={command.pending} onClick={() => void remove()}>{command.pending ? labels.pending : labels.confirm}</button>}
    <button type="button" className="lms-secondary-button" disabled={command.pending} onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>{labels.cancel}</button></div>
  </AdminDialog>}
 </div>;
}
```

```tsx
import { useAdminSave } from "@platform/hooks/use-admin-save";
import { readCourseEdit } from "@platform/features/admin/helpers/read-course-edit";
import CourseMediaFields from "./course-media-fields";
import { Checkbox } from "@khatab/design/ui/choice-controls";
import CourseFields from "./course-fields";
import CourseFormLayout from "./course-form-layout";
import SaveFeedback from "./save-feedback";
export default function CourseEditor({ course, published, revision, labels, categories, uploadLabels }: CourseEditorProps) {
  const command = useAdminSave(endpoints.adminCourse(course.slug), labels.error);
  return <CourseFormLayout method="post" labels={labels} pending={command.pending}
    onSubmit={event => { event.preventDefault(); void command.save(readCourseEdit(new FormData(event.currentTarget))); }}
    details={<CourseFields course={course} labels={labels} categories={categories} />}
    media={<CourseMediaFields course={course} labels={labels} uploadLabels={uploadLabels} />}
    actions={<><Checkbox label={labels.published} name="published" defaultChecked={published} disabled={command.pending} /><SaveFeedback {...command} labels={labels} /></>}>
    <input type="hidden" name="revision" value={revision} />
  </CourseFormLayout>;
}
```

```tsx
"use client";
import FormField from "@platform/components/ui/form-field";
import { Checkbox } from "@khatab/design/ui/choice-controls";
import { useCoursePrice } from "@platform/hooks/use-course-price";
export default function CoursePriceField({ initialAmount, labels }: {
  initialAmount?: number; labels: { price: string; free: string; priceHint: string };
```

```tsx
import Link from "next/link";
import { routes } from "@platform/config/navigation";
import { formatCourseDate } from "@platform/helpers/format-course-date";
import type { AdminCourseRow, AdminCoursesLabels } from "@platform/types/admin-courses";
import CourseDeleteButton from "./course-delete-button";
export default function CourseTable({ courses, labels }: { courses: AdminCourseRow[]; labels: AdminCoursesLabels }) {
  const columns = ["name", "createdAt", "updatedAt", "students", "lessons", "chapters", "sections", "actions"] as const;
  const counts = ["students", "lessons", "chapters", "sections"] as const;
  return <div className="lms-admin-table-wrap" data-reveal>
    <table className="lms-admin-table lms-course-table" role="table">
      <caption className="lms-visually-hidden">{labels.heading}</caption>
      <thead><tr>{columns.map(column => <th key={column} scope="col">{labels[column]}</th>)}</tr></thead>
      <tbody role="rowgroup">{courses.map(course => <tr key={course.slug} role="row">
        <th scope="row" role="rowheader">
          <Link className="lms-admin-name" href={routes.adminCourse(course.slug)}>{course.title}</Link>
          <small className="lms-admin-role">{labels[course.published ? "published" : "draft"]}</small>
        </th>
        <td role="cell" data-label={labels.createdAt}>{formatCourseDate(course.createdAt, labels.unknownDate)}</td>
        <td role="cell" data-label={labels.updatedAt}>{formatCourseDate(course.updatedAt, labels.unknownDate)}</td>
        {counts.map(key => <td role="cell" key={key} data-label={labels[key]} className="numeral">{course[key]}</td>)}
        <td role="cell" className="lms-admin-row-actions">
          <Link href={routes.adminCourse(course.slug)} className="lms-secondary-button">{labels.edit}</Link>
          <CourseDeleteButton course={course} labels={labels} />
        </td>
      </tr>)}</tbody>
    </table>
    {!courses.length && <p className="lms-admin-empty">{labels.empty}</p>}
  </div>;
}
```

```tsx
"use client";
import type { CurriculumContext, CurriculumTarget } from "@platform/types/curriculum";
import { useAdminSave } from "@platform/hooks/use-admin-save";
import { endpoints } from "@platform/config/navigation";
import { readCurriculumForm } from "@platform/features/admin/helpers/read-curriculum-form";
import AdminDialog from "../admin-dialog";
import SaveFeedback from "../save-feedback";
import CurriculumFields from "./curriculum-fields";
export default function CurriculumDialog({ context, target, onClose }: { context: CurriculumContext; target: CurriculumTarget; onClose: () => void }) {
  const { course, labels, revision } = context;
  const command = useAdminSave(endpoints.adminCurriculum(course.slug),labels.error);
  const title = `${target.operation === "delete" ? labels.remove : labels[target.operation]} ${labels[target.kind]}`;
  return <AdminDialog title={title} closeLabel={labels.close} pending={command.pending} onClose={onClose}>
    <div className="lms-curriculum-dialog"><form className="lms-profile-form lms-admin-form" onSubmit={async event => {
      event.preventDefault();
      if (await command.save(readCurriculumForm(new FormData(event.currentTarget),target,revision))) onClose();
    }}>
      <p className="lms-curriculum-note">{labels.courseLabel}: {course.title}</p>
      {target.operation === "delete" ? <p>{labels.deleteHint}</p> : <CurriculumFields context={context} target={target} />}
      <fieldset disabled={command.pending}><SaveFeedback {...command} labels={{ ...labels, save: target.operation === "delete" ? labels.remove : labels.save }} /></fieldset>
    </form></div>
  </AdminDialog>;
}
```

### File: `modules/components/admin/curriculum/curriculum-fields.tsx`

SHA-256: `09e19e88f0b57a9bd6e1b4c01aa4e7bad76b29e2dad83fdea6b13177fe86b5f8`

```tsx
"use client";
import type { CurriculumContext, CurriculumTarget } from "@platform/types/curriculum";
import FormField from "@platform/components/ui/form-field";
import Select from "@khatab/design/ui/select";
import { curriculumPolicy as policy } from "@platform/config/curriculum";
import LessonFields from "./lesson-fields";
export default function CurriculumFields({ context, target }: { context: CurriculumContext; target: CurriculumTarget }) {
  const { course, labels } = context;
  const chapter = course.modules.find(chapter => chapter.id === target.chapterId || chapter.id === target.id);
  if (target.kind === "lesson") return <LessonFields context={context} target={target} />;
  const record = target.kind === "chapter" ? chapter : chapter?.sections?.find(section => section.id === target.id);
  return <>
    <FormField label={labels.title} name="title" defaultValue={record?.title ?? ""} required minLength={policy.titleMin} maxLength={policy.titleMax} />
    {target.kind === "section" && <Select label={labels.chapterLabel} name="chapterId" required defaultValue={target.chapterId} options={course.modules.map(chapter => ({ value: chapter.id, label: chapter.title }))} />}
  </>;
}
```

```tsx
"use client";
import { useState } from "react";
import Select from "@khatab/design/ui/select";
import type { CurriculumCourse, CurriculumLabels } from "@platform/types/curriculum";
export default function LessonAssignment({ course, chapterId, sectionId, labels }: { course: CurriculumCourse; chapterId: string; sectionId: string; labels: CurriculumLabels }) {
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState(chapterId);
  const sections = course.modules.find(chapter => chapter.id === selected)?.sections ?? [];
  return <>
    <Select label={labels.chapterLabel} name="chapterId" required value={selected} onValueChange={setSelected} options={course.modules.map(chapter => ({ value: chapter.id, label: chapter.title }))} />
    <Select key={selected} label={labels.sectionLabel} name="sectionId" defaultValue={selected === chapterId ? sectionId : ""} options={[{ value: "", label: labels.ungrouped }, ...sections.map(section => ({ value: section.id, label: section.title }))]} />
  </>;
}
```

```tsx
"use client";
import TextareaField from "@platform/components/ui/textarea-field";
import type { CurriculumContext, CurriculumTarget } from "@platform/types/curriculum";
import { curriculumPolicy as policy } from "@platform/config/curriculum";
import LessonMediaFields from "./lesson-media-fields";
import FormField from "@platform/components/ui/form-field";
import { Checkbox } from "@khatab/design/ui/choice-controls";
import LessonAssignment from "./lesson-assignment";
export default function LessonFields({ context, target }: { context: CurriculumContext; target: CurriculumTarget }) {
  const { course, labels, videos } = context;
  const lesson = course.modules.flatMap(chapter => chapter.lessons).find(lesson => lesson.id === target.id);
  return <>
    <FormField label={labels.title} name="title" defaultValue={lesson?.title ?? ""} required minLength={policy.titleMin} maxLength={policy.titleMax} />
    <TextareaField label={labels.description} name="description" defaultValue={lesson?.description ?? ""} maxLength={policy.descriptionMax} rows={3} />
    <LessonAssignment course={course} chapterId={target.chapterId!} sectionId={target.sectionId ?? ""} labels={labels} />
    <LessonMediaFields slug={course.slug} initialUrl={lesson ? videos[lesson.id] ?? "" : ""} initialSeconds={lesson?.durationSeconds} labels={labels} />
    <Checkbox label={labels.preview} name="preview" defaultChecked={lesson?.preview ?? false} />
  </>;
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

export default function LessonMediaFields({ slug, initialUrl, initialSeconds, labels }: { slug: string; initialUrl: string; initialSeconds?: number; labels: CurriculumLabels }) {

  return <>
    <FormField label={labels.video} name="videoUrl" ref={inputRef} dir="ltr" value={url} onChange={event => change(event.target.value)} maxLength={adminCoursePolicy.urlMax} hint={labels.mediaHint} error={error} required />

    {error && <button type="button" className="lms-text-link" onClick={retry}>{labels.retryDuration}</button>}
  </>;
}
```

```tsx
"use client";
import type { AdminUsersLabels } from "@platform/types/admin-users";
import { suspensionPeriods } from "@platform/config/user-moderation";
import type { UserModeration } from "@platform/types/admin-users";
import AdminDialog from "./admin-dialog";
export default function ModerationConfirmation({ change, name, labels, pending, error, onConfirm, onCancel }: {
  change: UserModeration; name: string; labels: AdminUsersLabels; pending: boolean; error: string | null;
  onConfirm: () => void; onCancel: () => void;
}) {
  const description = change.action === "remove" ? labels.confirmRemove : change.action === "promote" ? labels.confirmPromote : labels.confirmRestriction;
  return <AdminDialog title={labels.confirmTitle} closeLabel={labels.close} pending={pending} onClose={onCancel}>
    <p>{name}</p><p><strong>{labels[change.action]}</strong>{change.action === "suspend" && ` · ${suspensionPeriods.find(item => item.id === change.period)?.label}`}</p><p>{description}</p>
    {error && <p role="alert" className="lms-error">{error}</p>}
    <div className="lms-admin-actions"><button className="btn-primary" onClick={onConfirm} disabled={pending}>{pending ? labels.pending : labels.confirm}</button>
      <button className="lms-secondary-button" onClick={onCancel} disabled={pending}>{labels.cancel}</button></div>
  </AdminDialog>;
}
```

### File: `modules/components/admin/moderation-controls.tsx`

```tsx
import Select from "@khatab/design/ui/select";
import { suspensionPeriods } from "@platform/config/user-moderation";
import type { AdminUser, AdminUsersLabels, SuspensionPeriod, UserModeration } from "@platform/types/admin-users";
export default function ModerationControls({ user, labels, period, pending, onPeriod, onAction }: {
  user: AdminUser; labels: AdminUsersLabels; period: SuspensionPeriod; pending: boolean;
  onPeriod: (period: SuspensionPeriod) => void; onAction: (change: UserModeration) => void;
}) {
  return <div className="lms-admin-controls">
    <fieldset disabled={pending}><legend>{labels.access}</legend><p>{labels.accessHint}</p>
      <div className="lms-admin-suspend"><Select label={labels.period} value={period} disabled={pending}
        options={suspensionPeriods.map(item => ({ value: item.id, label: item.label }))}
        onValueChange={value => onPeriod(value as SuspensionPeriod)} /><button type="button" className="lms-secondary-button" onClick={() => onAction({ action: "suspend", period })}>{labels.suspend}</button></div>
      <div className="lms-admin-actions">
        {user.suspendedUntil && <button type="button" className="lms-secondary-button" onClick={() => onAction({ action: "restore" })}>{labels.restore}</button>}
        <button type="button" className="lms-admin-danger" onClick={() => onAction({ action: "ban" })}>{labels.ban}</button>
      </div>
    </fieldset>
    <fieldset disabled={pending || !user.confirmed}><legend>{labels.permissions}</legend><p>{labels.confirmPromote}</p>
      <button type="button" className="lms-secondary-button" onClick={() => onAction({ action: "promote" })}>{labels.promote}</button>
      {!user.confirmed && <p>{labels.unconfirmed}</p>}
    </fieldset>
    <fieldset disabled={pending} className="lms-admin-destructive"><legend>{labels.danger}</legend><p>{labels.confirmRemove}</p>
      <button type="button" className="lms-admin-danger" onClick={() => onAction({ action: "remove" })}>{labels.remove}</button>
    </fieldset>
  </div>;
}
```

```tsx
import PageHeading from "@platform/components/ui/page-heading";
```

### File: `modules/components/admin/user-actions.tsx`

SHA-256: `6886635fe231293d067606391a71504d409d1c28b1a3bb71162ef591078f80a2`

```tsx
"use client";
import { useState } from "react";
import type { AdminUser, SuspensionPeriod, UserModeration } from "@platform/types/admin-users";
import type { AdminUsersLabels } from "@platform/types/admin-users";
import { useUserModeration } from "@platform/hooks/use-user-moderation";
import ModerationConfirmation from "./moderation-confirmation";
import AdminDialog from "./admin-dialog";
import ModerationControls from "./moderation-controls";
import UserIdentity from "./user-identity";
import UserStatus from "./user-status";
export default function UserActions({ user, labels }: { user: AdminUser; labels: AdminUsersLabels }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [period, setPeriod] = useState<SuspensionPeriod>("day"), [change, setChange] = useState<UserModeration | null>(null);
  const command = useUserModeration(user.id, labels.error);
  const confirm = async () => { if (change && await command.execute(change)) { setChange(null); setOpen(false); } };
  const action = async (next: UserModeration) => {
    if (next.action === "restore") { if (await command.execute(next)) setOpen(false); }
    else setChange(next);
  };
  if (user.admin) return <span className="lms-admin-protected" title={labels.protectedAdmin}>{labels.protected}</span>;
  return <div className="lms-admin-user-actions">
    <button type="button" className="lms-secondary-button lms-admin-manage" aria-haspopup="dialog" onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>{labels.manage}</button>
    {open && <AdminDialog title={labels.manage} closeLabel={labels.close} pending={command.pending} onClose={() => setOpen(false)}>
      <UserIdentity user={user} labels={labels} /><p className="lms-admin-account-email" dir="ltr">{user.email}</p>
      <UserStatus user={user} labels={labels} />
      <ModerationControls user={user} labels={labels} period={period} pending={command.pending} onPeriod={setPeriod} onAction={next => void action(next)} />
      {command.error && !change && <p role="alert" className="lms-error">{command.error}</p>}
    </AdminDialog>}
    {change && <ModerationConfirmation labels={labels} change={change} name={`${user.name} · ${user.email}`} pending={command.pending} error={command.error} onConfirm={() => void confirm()} onCancel={() => setChange(null)} />}
  </div>;
}
```

### File: `modules/components/admin/user-status.tsx`

SHA-256: `a6e1518d9e3b2ff7270c9fde9f6250b2a7c18951100813bb9ad34017e3e23adb`

```tsx
"use client";
import type { AdminUser } from "@platform/types/admin-users";
import { useCurrentTime } from "@platform/hooks/use-current-time";
import { userAdministration } from "@platform/config/user-moderation";
import { suspensionRemaining } from "@platform/features/admin/helpers/suspension-remaining";
import type { AdminUsersLabels } from "@platform/types/admin-users";
export default function UserStatus({ user, labels }: { user: AdminUser; labels: AdminUsersLabels }) {
  const now = useCurrentTime(userAdministration.refreshMs);
  const remaining = user.suspendedUntil && now ? suspensionRemaining(user.suspendedUntil, now) : null;
  const blocked = user.permanentlyBanned || Boolean(remaining && !remaining.expired);
  return <div className="lms-admin-status" data-blocked={blocked || undefined}>
    <strong>{user.permanentlyBanned ? labels.banned : remaining && !remaining.expired ? labels.suspended : user.suspendedUntil && !now ? "…" : labels.active}</strong>
    {user.suspendedUntil && !user.permanentlyBanned && <>
      <small>{labels.ends}: <time dateTime={user.suspendedUntil}>{new Date(user.suspendedUntil).toISOString().replace("T", " ").slice(0, 16)} UTC</time></small>
      {remaining && <small>{remaining.expired ? labels.expired : `${labels.remaining}: ${remaining.days} ${labels.days} · ${remaining.hours} ${labels.hours} · ${remaining.minutes} ${labels.minutes}`}</small>}
    </>}
  </div>;
}
```

```tsx
import { thumbnailUrl } from "@platform/helpers/media/thumbnail-url";
import AssetImage from "@khatab/design/ui/asset-image";
import { validateArtworkKind } from "./artwork/helpers/validate-kind";
import CourseIllustration from "./artwork/illustration";
import { courseLessons } from "@platform/features/catalog/helpers";
import type { ContentBindings } from "@platform/types/content";

import type { Course } from "@platform/types/lms";
export default function CourseArtwork({
  course,
  large = false,
  showLabels = true,
  site,
  lessonLabel,
}: {
  course: Pick<Course,"modules"|"artwork"|"tool"|"categoryLabel"|"thumbnailUrl"|"delivery"|"deliveryLabel">;
  large?: boolean;
} & (
  | { showLabels: false; lessonLabel?: never }
  | { showLabels?: true; lessonLabel: string }
) & { site: Pick<ContentBindings["site"], "englishName"> }) {
  if (course.thumbnailUrl) return <AssetImage asset={{ src: thumbnailUrl(course.thumbnailUrl), alt: "", width: 560, height: 260 }} className="lms-course-art" />;
  const kind = course.artwork;
  validateArtworkKind(kind);
  return (
    <div
      className={`lms-course-art lms-art-${kind} ${large ? "lms-art-large" : ""}`}
      aria-hidden="true"
    >
      {showLabels && (
        <div className="lms-art-top">
          <span className="lms-art-logo">{site.englishName.toUpperCase()}</span>
          <span>{course.tool}</span>
        </div>
      )}
      <svg viewBox="0 0 560 260" fill="none">
        <path
          d="M0 52h560M0 104h560M0 156h560M0 208h560M80 0v260M160 0v260M240 0v260M320 0v260M400 0v260M480 0v260"
          stroke="var(--border-hairline)"
        />
        <CourseIllustration kind={kind} />
      </svg>
      {showLabels && (
        <div className="lms-art-bottom">
          <span>{course.categoryLabel}</span>
          <span className="numeral">
            {course.delivery === "live" ? course.deliveryLabel : `${courseLessons(course).length} ${lessonLabel}`}
          </span>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

### File: `modules/components/courses/course-card.tsx`

SHA-256: `f42d3c8902d664ed6014ea876eb56317220dd0a28af03272b042ed6a68891f67`

```tsx
import { courseLessons } from "@platform/features/catalog/helpers";
import Action from "@khatab/design/ui/action";
import { routes } from "@platform/config/navigation";
import type { ContentBindings } from "@platform/types/content";

import Symbol from "@platform/components/ui/symbol";
import ProgressBar from "@platform/components/ui/progress-bar";
import CourseArtwork from "./course-artwork";
import CoursePrice from "./course-price";
import type { Course } from "@platform/types/lms";
export default function CourseCard({
  course,
  progress,
  copy,
  site,
  offerCopy,
}: {
  course: Course;
  progress?: {
    count: number;
    total: number;
    percent: number;
    next?: { id: string };
  };
} & {
  copy: Pick<ContentBindings["copy"], "lessons" | "continue" | "progress">;
  site: Pick<ContentBindings["site"], "englishName">;
  offerCopy: Pick<ContentBindings["offerCopy"], "price">;
}) {
  const detailHref = routes.course(course.slug, course.delivery);
  const actionHref = progress
    ? progress.next
      ? routes.lesson(course.slug, progress.next.id)
      : routes.course(course.slug, course.delivery)
    : routes.enrollment(course.slug, course.delivery);
  return (
    <article className="lms-course-card">
      <h3 className="lms-card-title">
        <Action kind="link" href={detailHref}>
          {course.title}
        </Action>
      </h3>
      <Action
        kind="link"
        href={detailHref}
        tabIndex={-1}
        aria-hidden="true"
        className="lms-card-cover"
      >
        <CourseArtwork
          site={{ englishName: site.englishName }}
          course={course}
          showLabels={false}
        />
      </Action>
      <div className="lms-course-card-body">
        <div className="lms-card-summary">
          <div className="lms-card-meta">
            <span>
              <Symbol name="book" />
              {course.delivery === "live" ? course.deliveryLabel : `${courseLessons(course).length} ${copy.lessons}`}
            </span>
            <span>
              <Symbol name="clock" />
              {course.duration}
            </span>
          </div>
          <CoursePrice
            offerCopy={{ price: offerCopy.price }}
            offer={course.offer}
            compact
          />
        </div>
        {progress && course.delivery !== "live" && (
          <ProgressBar
            copy={{ progress: copy.progress, lessons: copy.lessons }}
            {...progress}
          />
        )}
        <Action
          kind="link"
          className="btn-primary lms-full-button lms-card-action"
          href={actionHref}
        >
          {progress ? copy.continue : course.offer.actionLabel}
          <Symbol name="arrow" />
        </Action>
      </div>
    </article>
  );
}
```

```tsx
export default function CourseGrid({
  courses,

}: {
```

```tsx
import { numbered } from "@platform/features/catalog/helpers/numbered";
import { routes } from "@platform/config/navigation";
import type { ContentBindings } from "@platform/types/content";
import Link from "next/link";
import Symbol from "@platform/components/ui/symbol";
import type { Course } from "@platform/types/lms";
export default function Curriculum({
  course,
  copy,
}: { course: Course } & {
  copy: Pick<ContentBindings["copy"], "lessons" | "preview">;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="lms-curriculum">
      {course.modules.map((module, index) => (
        <details key={module.title} open={index === 0}>
          <summary>
            <span className="numeral">
              {numbered(index)}
            </span>
            <b>{module.title}</b>
            <small>
              {module.lessons.length} {copy.lessons}
            </small>
          </summary>
          <ul>
            {module.lessons.map((lesson) => (
              <li key={lesson.id}>
                <Symbol name="play" />
                <span>{lesson.title}</span>
                {lesson.preview && (
                  <Link
                    className="lms-preview-link"
                    href={routes.lesson(course.slug, lesson.id)}
                  >
                    {copy.preview}
                  </Link>
                )}
                <time className="numeral">{lesson.duration}</time>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </details>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}
```

### File: `modules/components/courses/enroll-button.tsx`

```tsx
"use client";
import Action from "@khatab/design/ui/action";

import type { ContentBindings } from "@platform/types/content";

import { useCourseEnrollment } from "@platform/hooks/use-course-enrollment";
import Symbol from "@platform/components/ui/symbol";
export default function EnrollButton({
  slug,
  firstLesson,
  enrolled,
  copy,
}: {
  slug: string;
  firstLesson?: string;
  enrolled: boolean;
} & {
  copy: Pick<
    ContentBindings["copy"],
    "error" | "saving" | "continue" | "enrollLabel"
  >;
}) {
  const { start, pending, error } = useCourseEnrollment({ slug, firstLesson, enrolled, errorLabel: copy.error });
  return (
    <div>
      <Action
        kind="button"
        type="button"
        className="btn-primary lms-full-button"
        disabled={pending || !firstLesson}
        onClick={start}
      >
        {pending ? copy.saving : enrolled ? copy.continue : copy.enrollLabel}
        <Symbol name="arrow" />
      </Action>
      {error && (
        <p className="lms-error" role="alert">
          {error}
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
export default function EnrollmentPanel({
  site,
  offerCopy,
  interfaceCopy,
  copy,
  course,
  slug,
  progress,
  enrolled,
}: {
  site: Pick<ContentBindings["site"], "englishName">;
  offerCopy: Pick<ContentBindings["offerCopy"], "price">;
  interfaceCopy: Pick<
    ContentBindings["interfaceCopy"],
    "courseNotesBenefit" | "courseProgressBenefit"
  >;

    | "demoVideo"

              {item}
            </li>
          ))}

        <p className="lms-demo-note">{copy.demoVideo}</p>
      </div>
    </aside>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import type { DashboardShellProps } from "@platform/types/dashboard-shell";

import { useId } from "react";
import { usePathname } from "next/navigation";
import { useMobileMenu } from "@khatab/design/hooks/use-mobile-menu";
import { useProtectedSession } from "@platform/hooks/use-protected-session";
import { endpoints, routes } from "@platform/config/navigation";
import RevealContent from "@platform/components/marketing/reveal-content";
import DashboardHeader from "./dashboard-header";
import DashboardSidebar from "./dashboard-sidebar";
export default function DashboardShell({
  children,
  name,
  avatarUrl,
  accountMenu,
  interfaceCopy,
  dashboardNavigation,
  site,
  copy,
  showSidebarHelp = true,
  showBrowseLink = true,
  sessionEndpoint = endpoints.auth.session,
}: DashboardShellProps) {
  const navigationId = useId();
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const verified = useProtectedSession(pathname, sessionEndpoint, routes.login);
  const menu = useMobileMenu({ breakpointToken: "--breakpoint-mobile" });
  if (!verified) return null;
  return (
    <div className="lms-app">
      <DashboardHeader accountMenu={accountMenu} avatarUrl={avatarUrl} showBrowseLink={showBrowseLink} name={name} site={site} copy={copy} menu={menu} navigationId={navigationId} />
      <div className="lms-app-grid">
        <DashboardSidebar showSidebarHelp={showSidebarHelp} name={name} interfaceCopy={interfaceCopy} dashboardNavigation={dashboardNavigation} copy={copy} menu={menu} navigationId={navigationId} pathname={pathname} />
        <RevealContent className="lms-app-main">{children}</RevealContent>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### File: `modules/components/layout/site-header.tsx`

SHA-256: `01d84296fa2e959062e883aeaa47aa24815799d16e5fa955c88850d25b7b1d7a`

```tsx
"use client";
import { useBelowBreakpoint } from "@khatab/design/hooks/use-below-breakpoint";
import { routes } from "@platform/config/navigation";

import type { NavigationAccount } from "@platform/types/navigation-account";
import type { ContentBindings } from "@platform/types/content";

import Link from "next/link";
import NavigationLink from "@khatab/design/ui/navigation-link";
import { usePathname } from "next/navigation";
import { useId } from "react";
import { useMobileMenu } from "@khatab/design/hooks/use-mobile-menu";
import Brand from "./brand";
import Symbol from "@platform/components/ui/symbol";
export default function SiteHeader({
  interfaceCopy,
  marketingNavigation,
  copy,
  site,
  account = null,
  actions = {
    home: routes.home,
    start: routes.login,
  },
}: {
  account?: NavigationAccount | null;
  actions?: { home: string; start: string };
  interfaceCopy: Pick<
    ContentBindings["interfaceCopy"],
    "mainNavigationLabel"
  >;
  marketingNavigation: ContentBindings["marketingNavigation"];
  copy: Pick<ContentBindings["copy"], "start" | "close" | "menu">;
  site: Pick<ContentBindings["site"], "name" | "englishName">;
}) {
  const { open, setOpen, menuRef, toggleRef } = useMobileMenu();
  const collapsed = useBelowBreakpoint("--breakpoint-navigation") && !open;
  const id = useId();
  const pathname = usePathname();
  return (
    <header className="site-header lms-site-header">
      <nav
        className="site-navbar"
        aria-label={interfaceCopy.mainNavigationLabel}
      >
        <div className="container lms-navbar">
          <Brand
            href={actions.home}
            site={{ name: site.name, englishName: site.englishName }}
          />
          <div
            className={`lms-marketing-links ${open ? "is-open" : ""}`}
            id={id}
            aria-hidden={collapsed}
            inert={collapsed}
            ref={(element) => {
              menuRef.current = element;
            }}
          >
            {marketingNavigation.map((link) => (
              <NavigationLink
                href={link.href}
                key={link.href}
                aria-current={pathname === link.href ? "page" : undefined}
                onClick={() => setOpen(false)}
              >
                {link.label}
              </NavigationLink>
            ))}
          </div>
          <div className="lms-nav-actions">
            {account ? <Link href={account.href} className="lms-text-link">{account.label}</Link> :
              <Link href={actions.start} className="btn-primary lms-nav-button">{copy.start}<Symbol name="arrow" /></Link>}
            <button
              className="lms-mobile-toggle"
              ref={toggleRef}
              aria-label={open ? copy.close : copy.menu}
              aria-controls={id}
              aria-expanded={open}
              onClick={() => setOpen(!open)}
            >
              <Symbol name={open ? "close" : "menu"} />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </nav>
    </header>
  );
}
```

### File: `modules/components/learning/completion-button.tsx`

```tsx
"use client";
import Action from "@khatab/design/ui/action";

import type { ContentBindings } from "@platform/types/content";

import { useLessonCompletion } from "@platform/hooks/use-lesson-completion";
import Symbol from "@platform/components/ui/symbol";
export default function CompletionButton({
  slug,
  lessonId,
  complete,
  enrolled,
  copy,
}: {
  slug: string;
  lessonId: string;
  complete: boolean;
  enrolled: boolean;
} & {
  copy: Pick<
    ContentBindings["copy"],
    "error" | "saving" | "completed" | "complete"
  >;
}) {
  const { toggle, pending, error } = useLessonCompletion({ slug, lessonId, complete, enrolled, errorLabel: copy.error });
  return (
    <div>
      <Action
        kind="button"
        className={
          complete ? "lms-secondary-button lms-is-complete" : "btn-primary"
        }
        type="button"
        onClick={toggle}
        disabled={pending}
      >
        <Symbol name="check" />
        {pending ? copy.saving : complete ? copy.completed : copy.complete}
      </Action>
      {error && (
        <p className="lms-error" role="alert">
          {error}
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";
import type { ContentBindings } from "@platform/types/content";

import { useId } from "react";
import { useLessonNotes } from "@platform/hooks/use-lesson-notes";
export default function LessonNotes({
  storageKey,
  copy,
}: { storageKey: string } & {
  copy: Pick<
    ContentBindings["copy"],
    "notes" | "notesHint" | "notesUnavailable" | "notesSaved"
  >;
}) {
  const id = useId();
  const { value, save, failed } = useLessonNotes(storageKey);
  return (
    <div className="lms-notes">
      <label htmlFor={id}>{copy.notes}</label>
      <textarea
        id={id}
        value={value}
        onChange={(event) => save(event.target.value)}
        placeholder={copy.notesHint}
        rows={5}
      />
      <small role="status" className={failed ? "lms-error" : "text-muted"}>
        {failed ? copy.notesUnavailable : copy.notesSaved}
      </small>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { numbered } from "@platform/features/catalog/helpers/numbered";
import type { ContentBindings } from "@platform/types/content";
import Link from "next/link";
import Symbol from "@platform/components/ui/symbol";
import ProgressBar from "@platform/components/ui/progress-bar";
import type { LessonOutlineModel } from "@platform/features/learning/helpers/lesson-outline";
export default function LessonOutline({
  model,
  active,
  copy,
}: {
  model: LessonOutlineModel;
  active: string;
} & {
  copy: Pick<
    ContentBindings["copy"],
    "courseContent" | "completed" | "pending" | "progress" | "lessons"
  >;
}) {
  return (
    <aside className="lms-lesson-outline">
      <div className="lms-outline-heading">
        <span className="lms-small-label">{copy.courseContent}</span>
        <h2>{model.title}</h2>
        <ProgressBar
          copy={{ progress: copy.progress, lessons: copy.lessons }}
          {...model.progress}
        />
      </div>
      <nav aria-label={copy.courseContent}>
        {model.modules.map((module, index) => (
          <div key={module.title} className="lms-outline-module">
            <h3>
              <span className="numeral">
                {numbered(index)}
              </span>
              {module.title}
            </h3>
            {module.lessons.map((lesson) => {
              const complete = lesson.complete;
              return (
                <Link
                  href={lesson.href}
                  key={lesson.id}
                  className={active === lesson.id ? "is-active" : ""}
                  aria-current={active === lesson.id ? "page" : undefined}
                >
                  <span
                    className={`lms-outline-check ${complete ? "is-complete" : ""}`}
                  >
                    <Symbol name={complete ? "check" : "play"} />
                  </span>
                  <span>
                    {lesson.title}
                    <small className="numeral">
                      {lesson.duration} ·{" "}
                      {complete ? copy.completed : copy.pending}
                    </small>
                  </span>
                </Link>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        ))}
      </nav>
    </aside>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import type { ContentBindings } from "@platform/types/content";

import DeferredVideoPlayer from "@khatab/design/ui/deferred-video-player";
import { useMediaPlayerSession } from "@khatab/design/hooks/use-media-player-session";
import { arabicPlayerLabels } from "@khatab/design/lib/player-labels";
import Symbol from "@platform/components/ui/symbol";
import type { Course, Lesson } from "@platform/types/lms";

export default function LessonPlayer({
```

```tsx
export default function CourseShowcase({
  copy,

  interfaceCopy,

  actionHref = routes.courses,
  sectionId = sectionIds.courses,
}: {
  actionHref?: string;
  sectionId?: string;
  copy: Pick<ContentBindings["copy"], "lessons" | "continue" | "progress">;

            content={{

                interfaceCopy.showcaseTitle,
                {
                  kind: "span",
```

```tsx
import ClientsSection from "@khatab/design/ui/clients-section";
import TestimonialsSection from "@khatab/design/ui/testimonials-section";
import ClosingSection from "@platform/components/marketing/closing-section";
import CoachingSection from "@platform/components/marketing/coaching-section";
import CourseShowcase from "@platform/components/marketing/course-showcase";
import SkillStrip from "@platform/components/marketing/skill-strip";
import SiteHeader from "@platform/components/layout/site-header";
import SiteFooter from "@platform/components/layout/site-footer";
import LandingHero from "@platform/components/marketing/landing-hero";
import InstructorSection from "@khatab/design/ui/instructor-section";
import TransformationSection from "@khatab/design/ui/transformation-section";
import FaqSection from "@khatab/design/ui/faq-section";
import { Fragment, type ComponentProps } from "react";
import RevealContent from "./reveal-content";
export interface LandingModel {
  header?: ComponentProps<typeof SiteHeader>;
  hero: ComponentProps<typeof LandingHero>;
  workSamples?: ComponentProps<typeof ClientsSection>;
  testimonials?: ComponentProps<typeof TestimonialsSection>;
  skills: ComponentProps<typeof SkillStrip>;
  courses: ComponentProps<typeof CourseShowcase>;
  steps: ComponentProps<typeof TransformationSection>;
  instructor: ComponentProps<typeof InstructorSection>;
  coaching: ComponentProps<typeof CoachingSection>;
  faq: ComponentProps<typeof FaqSection>;
  closing: ComponentProps<typeof ClosingSection>;
  footer?: ComponentProps<typeof SiteFooter>;
  order?: readonly LandingSection[];
  motion?: boolean;
}
export type LandingSection =
  | "hero"
  | "workSamples"
  | "testimonials"
  | "skills"
  | "courses"
  | "steps"
  | "instructor"
  | "coaching"
  | "faq"
  | "closing";
const defaultOrder: readonly LandingSection[] = [
  "hero",
  "skills",
  "courses",
  "workSamples",
  "steps",
  "instructor",
  "coaching",
  "testimonials",
  "faq",
  "closing",
];
export default function LandingPage({ model }: { model: LandingModel }) {
  const sections = {
    hero: <LandingHero {...model.hero} />,
    workSamples: model.workSamples && <ClientsSection {...model.workSamples} />,
    testimonials: model.testimonials && <TestimonialsSection {...model.testimonials} />,
    skills: <SkillStrip {...model.skills} />,
    courses: <CourseShowcase {...model.courses} />,
    steps: <TransformationSection contextVariant="plain" reveal {...model.steps} />,
    instructor: <InstructorSection contextVariant="plain" reveal {...model.instructor} />,
    coaching: <CoachingSection {...model.coaching} />,
    faq: <FaqSection contextVariant="plain" reveal {...model.faq} />,
    closing: <ClosingSection {...model.closing} />,
  };
  return (
    <>
      {model.header && <SiteHeader {...model.header} />}
      <RevealContent motion={model.motion ?? true}>
        {(model.order ?? defaultOrder).map((key) => (
          <Fragment key={key}>{sections[key]}</Fragment>
        ))}
      </RevealContent>
      {model.footer && <SiteFooter {...model.footer} />}
    </>
  );
}
```

### File: `modules/components/marketing/reveal-content.tsx`

SHA-256: `43b987a480c9097229b13335e8e28cf970f250d8c59581da7e5b0417eb3b05b4`

```tsx
"use client";

import { useRef } from "react";
import { useScrollReveals } from "@khatab/design/hooks/use-scroll-reveals";
import { useFragmentNavigation } from "@khatab/design/hooks/use-fragment-navigation";
export default function RevealContent({
  children,
  as: Element = "main",
  className,
  scope = "page",
  options,
  motion = true,
}: {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  as?: "main" | "div";
  className?: string;
  scope?: "page" | "cards";
  options?: import("@khatab/design/types/interactions").RevealOptions;
  motion?: boolean;
}) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  useFragmentNavigation({ rootRef: ref, enabled: scope === "page" });
  useScrollReveals({ rootRef: ref, options, enabled: motion });
  return (
    <Element ref={ref} className={className} data-reveal-scope={scope}>
      {children}
    </Element>
  );
}
```

### File: `modules/components/portfolio/header.tsx`

SHA-256: `49da93bf10c3143b2e3bfff9e4cc528a9668854c2f2d5496b4e19e4836bfa666`

```tsx
"use client";
import { useId } from "react";
import type { PortfolioContent } from "@platform/types/portfolio";
import { usePortfolioNavigation } from "@platform/hooks/portfolio/use-portfolio-navigation";
export default function PortfolioHeader({
  content,
  sectionIds,
  heroId,
}: {
  content: PortfolioContent["header"];
  sectionIds: readonly string[];
  heroId: string;
}) {
  const menuId = `${content.menuId}-${useId()}`;
  const { ref, toggleRef, open, active, close, toggle } =
    usePortfolioNavigation(sectionIds, heroId);
  return (
    <header className="p-ref-site-header personal-header" ref={ref}>
      <div className="p-ref-container p-ref-nav-container">
        <a
          className="p-ref-brand-logo"
          href={content.homeHref}
          aria-label={content.label}
        >
          <span className="p-ref-brand-name">{content.brand}</span>
        </a>
        <nav
          id={menuId}
          aria-label={content.navigationLabel}
          className={`p-ref-nav-menu ${open ? "p-ref-is-open" : ""}`}
        >
          {content.navigation.map((link) => {
            const current = link.href.startsWith("#") && active === link.href.slice(1);
            return (
            <a
              className={`p-ref-nav-link ${current ? "p-ref-is-active" : ""}`}
              key={link.href}
              href={link.href}
              aria-current={
                current ? "location" : undefined
              }
              onClick={close}
            >
              {link.label}
            </a>
          ); })}
        </nav>
        <div className="personal-header-actions">
          <a
            className="p-ref-btn p-ref-btn-primary p-ref-nav-cta"
            href={content.actionHref}
            onClick={close}
          >
            {content.action}
          </a>
          <button
            ref={toggleRef}
            className="p-ref-mobile-toggle personal-menu-toggle"
            type="button"
            aria-label={open ? content.closeLabel : content.openLabel}
            aria-expanded={open}
            aria-controls={menuId}
            onClick={toggle}
          >
            <span />
            <span />
            <span />
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </header>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";
import { useId, type ComponentPropsWithRef, type ReactNode } from "react";
export interface FormFieldProps extends Omit<ComponentPropsWithRef<"input">, "id"> {
  label: string; error?: string; hint?: string; control?: ReactNode;
}
export default function FormField({ label, error, hint, control, ...input }: FormFieldProps) {
  const id = useId();
  const descriptions = [error && `${id}-error`, hint && `${id}-hint`].filter(Boolean).join(" ");
  return (
    <div className="lms-form-field">
      <label htmlFor={id}>{label}</label>
      <div className="lms-field-input-wrap" dir={input.dir} data-has-control={control ? true : undefined}>
        <input {...input} id={id} aria-invalid={Boolean(error)} aria-describedby={descriptions || undefined} />
        {control}
      </div>
      {hint && <small id={`${id}-hint`} className="lms-field-hint">{hint}</small>}
      {error && <p id={`${id}-error`} className="lms-error" role="alert">{error}</p>}
    </div>
  );
}
```

### File: `modules/components/ui/image-upload.tsx`

SHA-256: `c7437b86168881109f2659eedd599b720c7da1f0ef997fec71774eb85ac939df`

```tsx
"use client";
import { useId, useState, type ChangeEvent } from "react";
import { useHydrated } from "@khatab/design/hooks/use-hydrated";
import { imageUploadPolicy } from "@platform/config/image-upload";
import { useAsyncCommand } from "@platform/hooks/use-async-command";
import { uploadImageFile } from "@platform/helpers/upload-image";
import type { ImageUploadLabels, ImageUploadTarget, UploadedImage } from "@platform/types/image-upload";
import FormFeedback from "@platform/components/account/form-feedback";
export default function ImageUpload({ target, labels, onUploaded }: { target: ImageUploadTarget; labels: ImageUploadLabels; onUploaded?: (image: UploadedImage) => void }) {
  const hydrated = useHydrated(), id = useId(), command = useAsyncCommand(labels.error), [saved, setSaved] = useState(false);
  async function change(event: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) {
    const file = event.currentTarget.files?.[0]; event.currentTarget.value = "";
    if (!file) return;
    setSaved(false);
    const image = await command.run(() => uploadImageFile(file, target, labels.error));
    if (image) { setSaved(true); onUploaded?.(image); }
  }
  return <div className="lms-image-upload" aria-busy={command.pending}>
    <span>{labels.title}</span><label className="lms-image-upload-trigger" htmlFor={id}>{command.pending ? labels.uploading : labels.choose}
      <input id={id} type="file" accept={imageUploadPolicy.accept} disabled={!hydrated || command.pending} onChange={change} aria-describedby={`${id}-hint`} />
    </label><small id={`${id}-hint`} className="lms-field-hint">{labels.hint}</small>
    <FormFeedback error={command.error} message={saved ? labels.saved : ""} />
  </div>;
}
```

```tsx
"use client";
import { useState } from "react";
import FormField, { type FormFieldProps } from "./form-field";
export default function PasswordField({ showLabel, hideLabel, ...props }: Omit<FormFieldProps, "type" | "control"> & {
  showLabel: string; hideLabel: string;
}) {
  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(false);
  const action = visible ? hideLabel : showLabel;
  return <FormField {...props} type={visible ? "text" : "password"} control={
    <button className="lms-password-toggle" type="button" disabled={props.disabled}
      aria-label={`${action} ${props.label}`} aria-pressed={visible} onClick={() => setVisible((value) => !value)}>
      {action}
    </button>
  } />;
}
```

### File: `modules/components/ui/progress-bar.tsx`

SHA-256: `a458cba65e077d037160c7e3eeae459da622064c2ce290a502f725f93fa34be4`

```tsx
import type { ContentBindings } from "@platform/types/content";

export default function ProgressBar({
  percent,
  count,
  total,
  copy,
}: {
  percent: number;
  count: number;
  total: number;
} & { copy: Pick<ContentBindings["copy"], "progress" | "lessons"> }) {
  if (
    ![percent, count, total].every(Number.isFinite) ||
    !Number.isInteger(count) ||
    !Number.isInteger(total) ||
    percent !== (total ? Math.round((count / total) * 100) : 0) ||
    total < 0 ||
    count < 0 ||
    count > total ||
    percent < 0 ||
    percent > 100
  )
    throw new Error("Invalid progress model");
  return (
    <div className="lms-progress">
      <div className="lms-progress-label">
        <span>{copy.progress}</span>
        <b className="numeral">{percent}%</b>
      </div>
      <progress max="100" value={percent} aria-label={copy.progress} />
      <small className="text-muted">
        {count} / {total} {copy.lessons}
      </small>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescript
  admin: "/admin/dashboard/courses",
  adminDashboard: "/admin/dashboard",
  adminProfile: "/admin/dashboard/profile",
  adminSettings: "/admin/dashboard/settings",
  adminUsers: "/admin/dashboard/users",
  adminPhoneConfirmations: "/admin/dashboard/phone-confirmations",
  adminUser: (username: string) => {
    if (!isValidUsername(username)) throw new Error("Invalid username route");
    return `/admin/dashboard/users/${normalizeUsername(username)}`;
  },
  adminCourseCreate: "/admin/dashboard/courses/new",
  adminCourseContent: (slug: string) => `/admin/dashboard/courses/${segment(slug)}/content`,
  adminCourse: (slug: string) => `${routes.admin}/${segment(slug)}`,
  workshopPage: (slug: string) => `/workshops/${segment(slug)}`,
  course: (slug: string, delivery?: "recorded" | "live") => delivery === "live" || slug === workshopCourseConfig.slug ? routes.workshopPage(slug) : `${learningBase}/courses/${segment(slug)}`,
  lesson: (slug: string, id: string) =>
    `${learningBase}/learn/${segment(slug)}/${segment(id)}`,
  enrollment: (slug: string, delivery?: "recorded" | "live") =>
    delivery === "live" || slug === workshopCourseConfig.slug ? routes.workshopPage(slug) : `${routes.course(slug)}#${sectionIds.enrollment}`,
  section: (id: keyof typeof sectionIds) => `${projectRoutes.learning}#${sectionIds[id]}`,
  catalog: (query = "", category = "all") => {
    const params = new URLSearchParams();
    if (query) params.set("q", query);
    if (category !== "all") params.set("category", category);
    return routes.courses + (params.size ? `?${params}` : "");
  },
};
export const endpoints = {
  adminCourses: "/api/admin/courses",
  adminCourseDelete: (slug: string) => `${endpoints.adminCourse(slug)}/delete`,
  imageUpload: "/api/media/images",
  adminAnalytics: "/api/admin/analytics",
  adminUsers: "/api/admin/users",
  adminUser: (id: string) => `/api/admin/users/${segment(id)}`,
  auth: { login: "/api/auth/login", signup: "/api/auth/signup", logout: "/api/auth/logout", session: "/api/auth/session" },
  adminCourse: (slug: string) => `/api/admin/courses/${segment(slug)}`,
  adminMediaStream: (slug: string, url: string) => `${endpoints.adminCourse(slug)}/media/stream?url=${encodeURIComponent(url)}`,
  adminCurriculum: (slug: string) => `/api/admin/courses/${segment(slug)}/content`,
  adminLesson: (slug: string, id: string) => `${endpoints.adminCourse(slug)}/lessons/${segment(id)}`,
  courses: "/api/courses",
  enrollments: "/api/enrollments",
  progress: "/api/progress",
  profile: "/api/profile",
  accountSettings: "/api/account/settings",
  accountPassword: "/api/account/password",
  emailConfirmation: "/api/account/verification",
  forgotPassword: "/api/auth/forgot-password",
  resetPassword: "/api/auth/reset-password",
  contactVerification: (id: string) => `${endpoints.adminUser(id)}/verification`,
  introStream: (slug: string) => `/api/courses/${segment(slug)}/intro`,
  lessonStream: (slug: string, id: string) => `/api/courses/${segment(slug)}/lessons/${segment(id)}/stream`,
  course: (slug: string) => `/api/courses/${segment(slug)}`,
  resource: (id: string) => `/api/resources/${segment(id)}`,
  certificate: (slug: string) => `/api/certificates/${segment(slug)}`,
};
```

### File: `modules/features/account/handle-confirmation.ts`

SHA-256: `4548a552091ffe3cc797258ff0932620b38b81a8187d40ce76ad644f99870a01`

```typescript
import { apiResponse } from "@platform/lib/api/respond";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
import { readJson, sameOrigin } from "@platform/lib/server-request";
import { requireAdmin } from "@platform/features/admin/identity";
import { validUserId } from "@platform/features/admin/helpers/read-moderation";
import { readUserContacts } from "./repositories/read-user-contacts";
export function handleConfirmation(request: Request, id: string) {
  return apiResponse(async () => {
    const { client } = await requireAdmin();
    if (!sameOrigin(request)) throw new ApiError(403, "FORBIDDEN");
    if (!validUserId(id)) throw new ApiError(404, "NOT_FOUND");
    const input = await readJson(request);
    if (!input || input.field !== "phone" || typeof input.value !== "string") throw new ApiError(400, "INVALID_INPUT");
    const contact = await readUserContacts(id), value = contact.phone_e164;
    if (!value || input.value !== value) throw new ApiError(409, "CONTACT_CHANGED");
    const { error } = await client.rpc("confirm_account_contact", { p_user_id: id, p_field: input.field, p_value: value });
    if (error) throw new ApiError(error.code === "40001" ? 409 : 503, error.code === "40001" ? "CONTACT_CHANGED" : "INTERNAL_ERROR");
    return Response.json({ confirmed: true });
  });
}
```

### File: `modules/features/account/handle-email-confirmation.ts`

SHA-256: `bd94b14f198454ea072365bc19b32ab52356710a6d9c036937f17e59550d01ab`

```typescript
import { authPolicy } from "@platform/config/auth";
import { apiResponse } from "@platform/lib/api/respond";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
import { readJson, sameOrigin } from "@platform/lib/server-request";
import { createDatabaseClient } from "@platform/lib/supabase/server";
import { isValidEmail } from "@platform/helpers/validation/email";
import { applicationOrigin } from "@platform/lib/application-origin";
export function handleEmailConfirmation(request: Request) {
  return apiResponse(async () => {
    if (!sameOrigin(request)) throw new ApiError(403, "FORBIDDEN");
    const input = await readJson(request), client = await createDatabaseClient();
    if (typeof input?.email !== "string" || !isValidEmail(input.email, authPolicy.emailMax)) throw new ApiError(400, "INVALID_INPUT");
    if (input.type !== undefined && input.type !== "signup" && input.type !== "email_change") throw new ApiError(400, "INVALID_INPUT");
    const pending = input.type === "email_change";
    if (pending) {
      const { data } = await client.auth.getUser();
      if (!data.user || data.user.new_email !== input.email) throw new ApiError(403, "FORBIDDEN");
    }
    const { error } = await client.auth.resend({ type: pending ? "email_change" : "signup", email: input.email, options: { emailRedirectTo: `${applicationOrigin()}/api/auth/callback` } });
    if (error) throw new ApiError(error.status === 429 ? 429 : 503, error.status === 429 ? "RATE_LIMITED" : "AUTH_FAILED");
    return Response.json({ sent: true });
  });
}
```

### File: `modules/features/account/handle-password.ts`

SHA-256: `4b8bb31ae9ce5b2fe895770e9df4a7914abf2f0b9f25f578140e67849b8e24a7`

```typescript
import { apiResponse } from "@platform/lib/api/respond";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
import { readJson, sameOrigin } from "@platform/lib/server-request";
import { requireIdentity } from "@platform/features/auth/server/identity";
import { verifyCurrentPassword } from "./helpers/verify-password";
import { authPolicy } from "@platform/config/auth";
export function handlePassword(request: Request) {
  return apiResponse(async () => {
    if (!sameOrigin(request)) throw new ApiError(403, "FORBIDDEN");
    const { client, user } = await requireIdentity(), input = await readJson(request);
    if (typeof input?.password !== "string" || input.password.length < authPolicy.passwordMin || input.password.length > authPolicy.passwordMax || input.password !== input.confirmPassword || input.password === input.currentPassword) throw new ApiError(400, "INVALID_INPUT");
    await verifyCurrentPassword(user.email ?? "", typeof input.currentPassword === "string" ? input.currentPassword : "", user.id);
    const { error } = await client.auth.updateUser({ password: input.password, current_password: typeof input.currentPassword === "string" ? input.currentPassword : undefined });
    if (error) throw new ApiError(error.status === 429 ? 429 : 400, error.status === 429 ? "RATE_LIMITED" : "AUTH_FAILED");
    return Response.json({ saved: true });
  });
}
```

### File: `modules/features/account/handle-recovery.ts`

SHA-256: `74215dffcda9e59c1f11a54f203f66a5491ee05c707beb5a577e727ad9e3bfd3`

```typescript
import { apiResponse } from "@platform/lib/api/respond";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
import { readJson, sameOrigin } from "@platform/lib/server-request";
import { createDatabaseClient } from "@platform/lib/supabase/server";
import { requireIdentity } from "@platform/features/auth/server/identity";
import { isValidEmail } from "@platform/helpers/validation/email";
import { authPolicy } from "@platform/config/auth";
import { applicationOrigin } from "@platform/lib/application-origin";
import { consumeRecovery } from "./repositories/recovery-grant";
export function handleRecovery(request: Request, mode: "request" | "reset") {
  return apiResponse(async () => {
    if (!sameOrigin(request)) throw new ApiError(403, "FORBIDDEN");
    const input = await readJson(request);
    if (mode === "request") {
      if (typeof input?.email !== "string" || !isValidEmail(input.email, authPolicy.emailMax)) throw new ApiError(400, "INVALID_INPUT");
      const client = await createDatabaseClient();
      const { error } = await client.auth.resetPasswordForEmail(input.email, { redirectTo: `${applicationOrigin()}/api/auth/callback` });
      if (error) throw new ApiError(error.status === 429 ? 429 : 503, error.status === 429 ? "RATE_LIMITED" : "AUTH_FAILED");
      return Response.json({ sent: true });
    }
    const { client, user } = await requireIdentity();
    if (typeof input?.password !== "string" || input.password.length < authPolicy.passwordMin || input.password.length > authPolicy.passwordMax || input.password !== input.confirmPassword) throw new ApiError(400, "INVALID_INPUT");
    await consumeRecovery(client, user.id);
    const { error } = await client.auth.updateUser({ password: input.password });
    if (error) throw new ApiError(400, "AUTH_FAILED");
    await client.auth.signOut({ scope: "global" });
    return Response.json({ saved: true });
  });
}
```

```typescript
import { apiResponse } from "@platform/lib/api/respond";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
import { readJson, sameOrigin } from "@platform/lib/server-request";
import { validateSettings } from "./helpers/validate-settings";
import { readAccount } from "./repositories/read-account";
import { saveSettings } from "./repositories/save-settings";
export function handleSettings(request?: Request) {
  return apiResponse(async () => {
    if (!request) return Response.json(await readAccount());
    if (!sameOrigin(request)) throw new ApiError(403, "FORBIDDEN");
    const input = validateSettings(await readJson(request));
    if (!input) throw new ApiError(400, "INVALID_INPUT");
    return Response.json(await saveSettings(input));
  });
}
```

### File: `modules/features/account/helpers/phone-number.ts`

SHA-256: `076acd19dba46c3526bfb229f91193118a11c0f96590ec67fb3b7895009a7ea6`

```typescript
import { parsePhoneNumberFromString } from "libphonenumber-js/max";
/** Accept only the requested +country-national format, with real numbering-plan validation. */
export function readPhoneNumber(value: unknown) {
  if (typeof value !== "string" || !/^\+[1-9]\d{0,2}-\d{4,14}$/.test(value)) return null;
  const phone = parsePhoneNumberFromString(value.replace("-", ""));
  if (!phone?.isValid() || value !== `+${phone.countryCallingCode}-${phone.nationalNumber}`) return null;
  return { e164: phone.number, display: value };
}
export function displayPhoneNumber(value: string | null) {
  const phone = value ? parsePhoneNumberFromString(value) : undefined;
  return phone ? `+${phone.countryCallingCode}-${phone.nationalNumber}` : "";
}
```

```typescript
import type { AccountProfile } from "@platform/types/account";
export function readAccountResponse(input: unknown): AccountProfile {
  if (!input || typeof input !== "object") throw new Error("Invalid account response");
  const v = input as Record<string, unknown>;
  if (!["id", "name", "username", "firstName", "lastName", "email", "phone"].every(key => typeof v[key] === "string") ||
    !["admin", "emailVerified", "phoneVerified"].every(key => typeof v[key] === "boolean") ||
    !(v.pendingEmail === null || typeof v.pendingEmail === "string") || !(v.avatarUrl === null || typeof v.avatarUrl === "string")) throw new Error("Invalid account response");
  return v as unknown as AccountProfile;
}
```

### File: `modules/features/account/helpers/validate-settings.ts`

SHA-256: `98b833c20a329fd387c5f76ebfc508bafdf4768a189b861f8f69e3d2db06187a`

```typescript
import { authPolicy } from "@platform/config/auth";
import { isValidUsername, normalizeUsername } from "@platform/helpers/validation/username";
import { isValidEmail } from "@platform/helpers/validation/email";
import { readPhoneNumber } from "./phone-number";
import type { AccountSettingsInput } from "@platform/types/account";
export function validateSettings(input: unknown): AccountSettingsInput | null {
  if (!input || typeof input !== "object") return null;
  const v = input as Record<string, unknown>;
  if (!["firstName", "lastName", "email", "phone"].every(key => typeof v[key] === "string")) return null;
  const firstName = (v.firstName as string).trim(), lastName = (v.lastName as string).trim();
  if (!firstName || `${firstName} ${lastName}`.trim().length < authPolicy.nameMin || `${firstName} ${lastName}`.trim().length > authPolicy.nameMax || /[\r\n\t]/.test(firstName + lastName)) return null;
  if (!isValidUsername(v.username) || !isValidEmail(v.email as string, authPolicy.emailMax) || !readPhoneNumber(v.phone)) return null;
  if (v.currentPassword !== undefined && (typeof v.currentPassword !== "string" || v.currentPassword.length > authPolicy.passwordMax)) return null;
  return { firstName, lastName, username: normalizeUsername(v.username), email: (v.email as string).trim().toLowerCase(), phone: v.phone as string, currentPassword: v.currentPassword as string ?? "" };
}
```

### File: `modules/features/account/helpers/verify-password.ts`

SHA-256: `5e988cdf1a02847ef9526be4afa7858d4058a063e55e7fdc11346d84d79e9a71`

```typescript
import "server-only";
import { createClient } from "@supabase/supabase-js";
import { supabaseEnvironment } from "@platform/lib/supabase/environment";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
/** Reauthentication uses an isolated client and never replaces the active browser session. */
export async function verifyCurrentPassword(email: string, password: string, userId: string) {
  if (!password || password.length > 128) throw new ApiError(400, "CURRENT_PASSWORD_REQUIRED");
  const { url, key } = supabaseEnvironment();
  const client = createClient(url, key, { auth: { persistSession: false, autoRefreshToken: false } });
  const { data, error } = await client.auth.signInWithPassword({ email, password });
  if (error || data.user?.id !== userId) throw new ApiError(error?.status === 429 ? 429 : 400, error?.status === 429 ? "RATE_LIMITED" : "CURRENT_PASSWORD_INVALID");
  const signout = await client.auth.signOut({ scope: "local" });
  if (signout.error) throw new ApiError(503, "INTERNAL_ERROR");
}
```

### File: `modules/features/account/repositories/read-account.ts`

SHA-256: `db9ba6d428e5ab9b7f08089989166514a3a02db23d8ad4b2e16653c1632fe6a5`

```typescript
import "server-only";
import { requireIdentity } from "@platform/features/auth/server/identity";
import { hasAdminAccess } from "@platform/features/admin/identity";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
import { displayPhoneNumber } from "../helpers/phone-number";
import type { AccountProfile } from "@platform/types/account";
export async function readAccount(): Promise<AccountProfile> {
  const { client, user } = await requireIdentity();
  const [profile, contact, admin] = await Promise.all([
    client.from("profiles").select("*").eq("id", user.id).single(),
    client.from("account_contacts").select("*").eq("user_id", user.id).single(), hasAdminAccess(),
  ]);
  if (profile.error || contact.error) throw new ApiError(503, "INTERNAL_ERROR");
  const p = profile.data, c = contact.data;
  return { id: user.id, name: p.name, username: p.username, firstName: p.first_name, lastName: p.last_name,
    email: c.email, pendingEmail: c.pending_email, phone: displayPhoneNumber(c.phone_e164),
    avatarUrl: p.avatar_url?.startsWith("https://") ? p.avatar_url : null, admin,
    emailVerified: Boolean(c.email_verified_at && !c.pending_email && user.email_confirmed_at && !user.new_email), phoneVerified: Boolean(c.phone_e164 && c.phone_verified_at) };
}
```

### File: `modules/features/account/repositories/read-phone-confirmations.ts`

SHA-256: `b6725930ac9185018bb3297bb9cc5c886121a802f974c41a826e16f72bd302fb`

```typescript
import "server-only";
import { requireAdmin } from "@platform/features/admin/identity";
import { createAuthAdministrator } from "@platform/lib/supabase/admin";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
import { phoneConfirmationConfig } from "@platform/config/phone-confirmations";
export async function readPhoneConfirmations(page: number) {
  await requireAdmin();
  const client = createAuthAdministrator(), start = (page - 1) * phoneConfirmationConfig.pageSize;
  const { data, count, error } = await client.from("account_contacts").select("user_id,email,phone_e164,updated_at", { count: "exact" })
    .is("phone_verified_at", null).not("phone_e164", "is", null).order("updated_at").order("user_id")
    .range(start, start + phoneConfirmationConfig.pageSize - 1);
  if (error) throw new ApiError(503, "INTERNAL_ERROR");
  if (!data?.length) return { requests: [], total: count ?? 0 };
  const profiles = await client.from("profiles").select("id,name,username").in("id", data.map(row => row.user_id));
  if (profiles.error) throw new ApiError(503, "INTERNAL_ERROR");
  const byId = new Map(profiles.data.map(profile => [profile.id, profile]));
  return { total: count ?? 0, requests: data.flatMap(row => {
    const profile = byId.get(row.user_id);
    return profile && row.phone_e164 ? [{ ...row, phone_e164: row.phone_e164, name: profile.name, username: profile.username }] : [];
  }) };
}
```

```typescript
export async function readUserContacts(id: string) {
```

### File: `modules/features/account/repositories/recovery-grant.ts`

SHA-256: `8b8f64634d9d51e72d298bc8ef998a2448ad17cf0ee60654307f72ea2f8313b6`

```typescript
import "server-only";
import type { DatabaseClient } from "@platform/types/database-client";
import { createAuthAdministrator } from "@platform/lib/supabase/admin";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
export async function recoverySession(client: DatabaseClient) {
  const { data, error } = await client.auth.getClaims();
  const id = data?.claims.session_id;
  if (error || typeof id !== "string") throw new ApiError(403, "RECOVERY_EXPIRED");
  return id;
}
export async function authorizeRecovery(client: DatabaseClient, userId: string) {
  const sessionId = await recoverySession(client);
  const { error } = await createAuthAdministrator().from("account_recovery_grants").upsert({ user_id: userId, session_id: sessionId, expires_at: new Date(Date.now() + 15 * 60 * 1000).toISOString() });
  if (error) throw new ApiError(503, "INTERNAL_ERROR");
}
export async function consumeRecovery(client: DatabaseClient, userId: string) {
  const sessionId = await recoverySession(client);
  const { data, error } = await createAuthAdministrator().from("account_recovery_grants").delete().eq("user_id", userId).eq("session_id", sessionId).gt("expires_at", new Date().toISOString()).select("user_id").maybeSingle();
  if (error || !data) throw new ApiError(403, "RECOVERY_EXPIRED");
}
export async function hasRecoveryGrant(client: DatabaseClient, userId: string) {
  const sessionId = await recoverySession(client);
  const { data, error } = await createAuthAdministrator().from("account_recovery_grants").select("user_id").eq("user_id", userId).eq("session_id", sessionId).gt("expires_at", new Date().toISOString()).maybeSingle();
  if (error) throw new ApiError(503, "INTERNAL_ERROR");
  return Boolean(data);
}
```

### File: `modules/features/account/repositories/save-settings.ts`

SHA-256: `e93e6071b28f9126c01961eea30f2143b81a155f68ed9b29e4b581fbb1449fef`

```typescript
import "server-only";
import { requireIdentity } from "@platform/features/auth/server/identity";
import { applicationOrigin } from "@platform/lib/application-origin";
import { readAccount } from "./read-account";
import { verifyCurrentPassword } from "../helpers/verify-password";
import { createAuthAdministrator } from "@platform/lib/supabase/admin";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
import { readPhoneNumber } from "../helpers/phone-number";
import type { AccountSettingsInput } from "@platform/types/account";
export async function saveSettings(input: AccountSettingsInput) {
  const account = await readAccount(), client = createAuthAdministrator();
  if (input.email !== (account.pendingEmail ?? account.email) && !account.admin) throw new ApiError(403, "EMAIL_LOCKED");
  const emailChanged = input.email !== (account.pendingEmail ?? account.email), phoneChanged = input.phone !== account.phone;
  if (emailChanged || phoneChanged) await verifyCurrentPassword(account.email, input.currentPassword, account.id);
  if (emailChanged) {
    const { client: session } = await requireIdentity();
    const { error } = await session.auth.updateUser({ email: input.email }, { emailRedirectTo: `${applicationOrigin()}/api/auth/callback` });
    if (error) throw new ApiError(error.status === 429 ? 429 : 400, error.status === 429 ? "RATE_LIMITED" : "AUTH_FAILED");
  }
  const { error } = await client.rpc("save_account_settings", {
    p_user_id: account.id, p_first_name: input.firstName, p_last_name: input.lastName,
    p_username: input.username, p_phone: readPhoneNumber(input.phone)!.e164,
  });
  if (error) throw new ApiError(error.code === "23505" ? 409 : 503, error.code === "23505" ? "USERNAME_TAKEN" : "INTERNAL_ERROR");
  return readAccount();
}
```

```typescript
export function periodChange(current: number, previous: number) {
  if (previous === 0) return { direction: current === 0 ? "flat" : "new", percent: null } as const;
  const difference = current - previous;
  return { direction: difference === 0 ? "flat" : difference > 0 ? "up" : "down", percent: Math.abs(difference / previous * 100) } as const;
}
```

```typescript
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
import { analyticsConfig } from "@platform/config/admin-analytics";
import type { AdminAnalytics } from "@platform/types/admin-analytics";
import { objectRecord, isCount, isTimestamp, isDay, isCourse, isSource } from "./validate-records";
export function readAnalyticsSnapshot(value: unknown): AdminAnalytics {
  const r = objectRecord(value), metrics = objectRecord(r?.metrics), courses = objectRecord(r?.courses);
  if (r && metrics && courses && [r.generatedAt, r.weekStart, r.monthStart].every(isTimestamp) && r.timezone === analyticsConfig.timezone
    && analyticsConfig.metrics.every(key => isCount(metrics[key]))
    && Array.isArray(r.daily) && r.daily.length <= 31 && r.daily.every(isDay)
    && analyticsConfig.periods.every(key => Array.isArray(courses[key]) && courses[key].length <= analyticsConfig.trendLimit && courses[key].every(isCourse))
    && Array.isArray(r.sources) && r.sources.every(isSource)) return r as unknown as AdminAnalytics;
  throw new ApiError(503, "INTERNAL_ERROR");
}
```

### File: `modules/features/admin/analytics/helpers/validate-records.ts`

SHA-256: `09848fc08679766b99f18de72cf34c55dffba3aada21a94fb6aedf9825a06744`

```typescript
import { analyticsConfig } from "@platform/config/admin-analytics";
import type { AnalyticsDay, AnalyticsSource, TrendingCourse } from "@platform/types/admin-analytics";
export function objectRecord(value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> | null {
  return value && typeof value === "object" && !Array.isArray(value) ? value as Record<string, unknown> : null;
}
export const isCount = (value: unknown): value is number => typeof value === "number" && Number.isSafeInteger(value) && value >= 0;
export const isTimestamp = (value: unknown): value is string => typeof value === "string" && Number.isFinite(Date.parse(value));
export function isDay(value: unknown): value is AnalyticsDay {
  const r = objectRecord(value);
  return Boolean(r && typeof r.day === "string" && /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(r.day) && isTimestamp(r.day) && isCount(r.students) && isCount(r.enrollments)
    && (r.previousStudents === null || isCount(r.previousStudents)) && (r.previousEnrollments === null || isCount(r.previousEnrollments)));
}
export function isCourse(value: unknown): value is TrendingCourse {
  const r = objectRecord(value);
  return Boolean(r && typeof r.slug === "string" && /^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$/.test(r.slug) && typeof r.title === "string"
    && (r.thumbnail === null || typeof r.thumbnail === "string") && ["recorded", "live"].includes(String(r.delivery))
    && typeof r.published === "boolean" && isCount(r.count) && isCount(r.previous));
}
export function isSource(value: unknown): value is AnalyticsSource {
  const r = objectRecord(value);
  return Boolean(r && analyticsConfig.sources.some(source => source === r.source) && isCount(r.count));
}
```

```typescript
export function handleCourseDelete(slug: string, request: Request) {

 });
}
```

```typescript
import { apiResponse } from "@platform/lib/api/respond";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
import { readJson, sameOrigin } from "@platform/lib/server-request";
import { requireAdmin } from "./identity";
import { readAdminCourses } from "./repositories/courses";
import { persistCurriculum } from "./repositories/persist-curriculum";
import { validMediaUrl } from "./helpers/validate-media-url";
export async function handleAdminLesson(slug: string, id: string, request: Request) {
  return apiResponse(async () => {
    await requireAdmin();
    if (!sameOrigin(request)) throw new ApiError(403,"FORBIDDEN");
    const body = await readJson(request);
    if (!validMediaUrl(body?.videoUrl) || !body.videoUrl) throw new ApiError(400,"INVALID_INPUT");
    const record = (await readAdminCourses(slug))[0];
    const lesson = record?.course.modules.flatMap(chapter => chapter.lessons).find(lesson => lesson.id === id);
    if (!record || !lesson) throw new ApiError(404,"NOT_FOUND");
    await persistCurriculum(slug,record.revision,record.course.modules,{ id, video_url: body.videoUrl, preview: lesson.preview ?? false });
    return Response.json({ saved: true });
  });
}
```

```typescript
import { requireAdmin } from "./identity";
import { driveFileId } from "@platform/helpers/media/drive-file-id";
import { streamDrive } from "@platform/features/catalog/stream-drive";
import { adminCoursePolicy } from "@platform/config/admin";
export function handleAdminMediaStream(slug: string, request: Request) {
  return apiResponse(async () => {
    const { client } = await requireAdmin();
    const url = new URL(request.url).searchParams.get("url") ?? "";

    return streamDrive(url, request);
  });
}
```

```typescript
import type { User } from "@supabase/supabase-js";
import type { AdminUser } from "@platform/types/admin-users";
import type { Database } from "@platform/types/database";
type Profile = Database["public"]["Tables"]["profiles"]["Row"];
export function adminUserRecord(user: User, profile: Profile | undefined, admin: boolean): AdminUser {
  const until = (user as User & { banned_until?: string }).banned_until ?? null;
  const avatar = profile?.avatar_url ?? user.user_metadata?.avatar_url;
  const name = profile?.name ?? user.user_metadata?.name;
  return { id: user.id, name: typeof name === "string" ? name : "—",
    username: profile?.username ?? `user-${user.id.replaceAll("-", "")}`, email: user.email ?? "—",
    avatarUrl: typeof avatar === "string" && /^https:\/\//.test(avatar) ? avatar : null,
    admin, confirmed: Boolean(user.email_confirmed_at), suspendedUntil: until,
    permanentlyBanned: Boolean(until && Date.parse(until) - Date.now() > 3650 * 86400000) };
}
```
