```typescript
import type { Course } from "@platform/types/lms";
import type { CurriculumMutation } from "@platform/types/curriculum";
import { curriculumCourse } from "./curriculum-course";
import { mutateChapter } from "./mutate-chapter";
import { mutateSection } from "./mutate-section";
import { mutateLesson } from "./mutate-lesson";
import { curriculumPolicy as policy } from "@platform/config/curriculum";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
export function applyCurriculumMutation(current: Course, input: CurriculumMutation, id: string) {
  const course = curriculumCourse(structuredClone(current));
  const mutate = { chapter: mutateChapter, section: mutateSection, lesson: mutateLesson };
  mutate[input.kind](course,input,id);
  if (course.modules.length > policy.maxChapters || course.modules.some(chapter => (chapter.sections?.length ?? 0) > policy.maxSections) || course.modules.flatMap(chapter => chapter.lessons).length > policy.maxLessons) throw new ApiError(400,"INVALID_INPUT");
  return course;
}
```

```typescript
import type { CourseModule } from "@platform/types/lms";
export function courseContentGroups(chapter: CourseModule, ungroupedLabel: string) {
  const grouped = new Set(chapter.sections?.flatMap(section => section.lessonIds));
  const groups = (chapter.sections ?? []).map(section => ({
    id: section.id, sectionId: section.id as string | undefined, title: section.title,
    lessons: chapter.lessons.filter(lesson => section.lessonIds.includes(lesson.id)),
  }));
  const ungrouped = chapter.lessons.filter(lesson => !grouped.has(lesson.id));
  if (ungrouped.length) groups.push({ id: "ungrouped", sectionId: undefined, title: chapter.sections?.length ? ungroupedLabel : "", lessons: ungrouped });
  return groups;
}
```

### File: `modules/features/admin/helpers/curriculum-lookup.ts`

```typescript
import type { CurriculumCourse } from "@platform/types/curriculum";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
export function curriculumChapter(course: CurriculumCourse, id?: string) {
  const chapter = course.modules.find(chapter => chapter.id === id);
  if (!chapter) throw new ApiError(404,"NOT_FOUND");
  return chapter;
}
export function curriculumLesson(course: CurriculumCourse, id?: string) {
  const chapter = course.modules.find(chapter => chapter.lessons.some(lesson => lesson.id === id));
  const lesson = chapter?.lessons.find(lesson => lesson.id === id);
  if (!chapter || !lesson) throw new ApiError(404,"NOT_FOUND");
  return { chapter, lesson };
}
export function curriculumSection(course: CurriculumCourse, id?: string, chapterId?: string) {
  const chapter = course.modules.find(chapter => (!chapterId || chapter.id === chapterId) && chapter.sections?.some(section => section.id === id));
  const section = chapter?.sections?.find(section => section.id === id);
  if (!chapter || !section) throw new ApiError(404,"NOT_FOUND");
  return { chapter, section };
}
```

```typescript
import type { CurriculumCourse, CurriculumMutation } from "@platform/types/curriculum";
import { curriculumChapter } from "./curriculum-lookup";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
export function mutateChapter(course: CurriculumCourse, input: CurriculumMutation, id: string) {
  if (input.operation === "create") { course.modules.push({ id, title: input.title!, lessons: [], sections: [] }); return; }
  const chapter = curriculumChapter(course,input.id);
  if (input.operation === "edit") { chapter.title = input.title!; return; }
  if (chapter.lessons.length || chapter.sections?.length) throw new ApiError(409,"CURRICULUM_NOT_EMPTY");
  course.modules = course.modules.filter(record => record.id !== chapter.id);
}
```

### File: `modules/features/admin/helpers/mutate-lesson.ts`

SHA-256: `06f888854c896e67c8376145843e9122515730a62a796fee4cf5eb15e1078922`

```typescript
import { formatPlayerTime } from "@khatab/design/helpers/media/format-time";
import type { CurriculumCourse, CurriculumMutation } from "@platform/types/curriculum";
import { curriculumChapter, curriculumLesson } from "./curriculum-lookup";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
export function mutateLesson(course: CurriculumCourse, input: CurriculumMutation, id: string) {
  const destination = curriculumChapter(course,input.chapterId);
  const section = input.sectionId ? destination.sections?.find(section => section.id === input.sectionId) : undefined;
  if (input.sectionId && !section) throw new ApiError(400,"INVALID_INPUT");
  const existing = input.operation === "create" ? undefined : curriculumLesson(course,input.id);
  const position = existing?.chapter.id === destination.id ? destination.lessons.findIndex(lesson => lesson.id === input.id) : -1;
  const lesson = existing?.lesson ?? { id, resourceIds: [], takeaway: [], videoUrl: "" };
  for (const chapter of course.modules) {
    chapter.lessons = chapter.lessons.filter(record => record.id !== lesson.id);
    chapter.sections?.forEach(section => { section.lessonIds = section.lessonIds.filter(id => id !== lesson.id); });
  }
  if (input.operation === "delete") return;
  const updated = {
    ...lesson,
    title: input.title!,
    description: input.description!,
    durationSeconds: input.durationSeconds!,
    duration: formatPlayerTime(input.durationSeconds!),
    preview: input.preview!,
    videoUrl: "",
  };
  if (position >= 0) destination.lessons.splice(position,0,updated); else destination.lessons.push(updated);
  section?.lessonIds.push(lesson.id);
}
```

### File: `modules/features/admin/helpers/mutate-section.ts`

SHA-256: `3d1fbcdd851a38c8c64c97e6987a2adf4a3bf10061ec5668dece7b641df011b6`

```typescript
import type { CurriculumCourse, CurriculumMutation } from "@platform/types/curriculum";
import { curriculumChapter, curriculumSection } from "./curriculum-lookup";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
export function mutateSection(course: CurriculumCourse, input: CurriculumMutation, id: string) {
  const destination = curriculumChapter(course,input.chapterId);
  destination.sections ??= [];
  if (input.operation === "create") { destination.sections.push({ id, title: input.title!, lessonIds: [] }); return; }
  const { chapter, section } = curriculumSection(course,input.id,input.sourceChapterId ?? input.chapterId);
  if (input.operation === "delete") {
    if (section.lessonIds.length) throw new ApiError(409,"CURRICULUM_NOT_EMPTY");
    chapter.sections = chapter.sections!.filter(record => record.id !== section.id); return;
  }
  section.title = input.title!;
  if (chapter.id === destination.id) return;
  if (destination.sections.some(record => record.id === section.id)) throw new ApiError(409,"SECTION_ID_CONFLICT");
  const assigned = new Set(section.lessonIds);
  destination.lessons.push(...chapter.lessons.filter(lesson => assigned.has(lesson.id)));
  chapter.lessons = chapter.lessons.filter(lesson => !assigned.has(lesson.id));
  chapter.sections = chapter.sections!.filter(record => record.id !== section.id);
  destination.sections.push(section);
}
```

```typescript
 return { search, category: category as AdminCourseQuery["category"], statuses: statuses as AdminCourseQuery["statuses"], delivery: delivery as AdminCourseQuery["delivery"], sort: sort as AdminCourseQuery["sort"], direction: direction as AdminCourseQuery["direction"], page: readAdminPage(params.get("page")) };
```

```typescript
import { categories } from "@platform/config/catalog";
import type { AdminCourseResults } from "@platform/types/admin-courses";
export function readCourseResults(value: unknown): AdminCourseResults {
  const result = value as AdminCourseResults | null;
  if (!result || !Array.isArray(result.courses) || !Number.isSafeInteger(result.total) || result.total < 0 ||
      !Number.isSafeInteger(result.page) || result.page < 1 || typeof result.hasNext !== "boolean") throw new Error("Invalid course results");
  for (const course of result.courses) {
    const validDates = course && [course.createdAt, course.updatedAt].every(date =>
      date === null || (typeof date === "string" && Number.isFinite(Date.parse(date))));
    if (!course || !validDates || typeof course.slug !== "string" || typeof course.title !== "string" ||
        typeof course.published !== "boolean" || !["live", "recorded"].includes(course.delivery) ||
        !categories.some(category => category.id !== "all" && category.id === course.category) ||
        ![course.students, course.lessons, course.chapters, course.sections].every(count => Number.isSafeInteger(count) && count >= 0))
      throw new Error("Invalid course result");
  }
  return result;
}
```

```typescript
import { suspensionPeriods } from "@platform/config/user-moderation";
import type { UserModeration } from "@platform/types/admin-users";
export function readModeration(value: unknown): UserModeration | null {
  if (!value || typeof value !== "object" || !("action" in value)) return null;
  if (value.action === "suspend" && "period" in value) {
    const period = suspensionPeriods.find(item => item.id === value.period);

}
```

```typescript
import type { AdminUser, AdminUserPage } from "@platform/types/admin-users";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
function isUser(value: unknown): value is AdminUser {
  if (!value || typeof value !== "object") return false;
  const item = value as Record<string, unknown>;
  return ["id", "name", "username", "email"].every(key => typeof item[key] === "string")
    && ["admin", "confirmed", "permanentlyBanned"].every(key => typeof item[key] === "boolean")
    && ["avatarUrl", "suspendedUntil"].every(key => item[key] === null || typeof item[key] === "string");
}
export function readUserResults(value: unknown): AdminUserPage {
  if (value && typeof value === "object") {
    const result = value as Record<string, unknown>;
    if (Array.isArray(result.users) && result.users.every(isUser) && typeof result.page === "number" && Number.isInteger(result.page)
      && typeof result.hasNext === "boolean" && typeof result.total === "number" && Number.isInteger(result.total)) {
      return { users: result.users, page: result.page, hasNext: result.hasNext, total: result.total };
    }
  }
  throw new ApiError(503, "INTERNAL_ERROR");
}
```

```typescript
export function suspensionRemaining(until: string, now: number) {
  const minutes = Math.max(0, Math.ceil((Date.parse(until) - now) / 60000));
  return { days: Math.floor(minutes / 1440), hours: Math.floor(minutes % 1440 / 60), minutes: minutes % 60, expired: minutes === 0 };
}
```

```typescript
import { routes } from "@platform/config/navigation";
import type { AdminUserQuery } from "@platform/types/admin-users";
export function userQueryUrl(query: AdminUserQuery, page = query.page) {
  const params = new URLSearchParams({ page: String(page) });
  if (query.searchMode === "prefix") params.set("mode", "prefix");
  if (query.search) params.set("q", query.search);
  for (const status of query.statuses) params.append("status", status);
  if (query.adminsOnly) params.set("admins", "1");
  if (query.newcomers) params.set("newcomers", "1");
  return `${routes.adminUsers}?${params}`;
}
```

### File: `modules/features/admin/helpers/validate-curriculum-mutation.ts`

SHA-256: `4088921c36a8713178a14ba12e1d8de9b2c011edf3610531604b2fde4fc40da2`

```typescript
import type { CurriculumMutation } from "@platform/types/curriculum";
import { curriculumPolicy as policy } from "@platform/config/curriculum";
import { validMediaUrl } from "./validate-media-url";
const identifier = (value: unknown) => typeof value === "string" && /^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$/.test(value) && value.length <= 100;
export function validateCurriculumMutation(body: Record<string,unknown> | null): CurriculumMutation | null {
  if (!body || !["chapter","section","lesson"].includes(String(body.kind)) || !["create","edit","delete"].includes(String(body.operation)) || !Number.isSafeInteger(body.revision) || Number(body.revision) < 0) return null;
  if (body.operation !== "create" && !identifier(body.id)) return null;
  if (body.kind !== "chapter" && !identifier(body.chapterId)) return null;
  if (body.sourceChapterId !== undefined && !identifier(body.sourceChapterId)) return null;
  if (body.sectionId !== undefined && body.sectionId !== "" && !identifier(body.sectionId)) return null;
  if (body.operation === "delete") return body as unknown as CurriculumMutation;
  if (typeof body.title !== "string" || body.title.trim().length < policy.titleMin || body.title.trim().length > policy.titleMax) return null;
  if (body.kind === "lesson" && (typeof body.description !== "string" || body.description.length > policy.descriptionMax || !Number.isSafeInteger(body.durationSeconds) || Number(body.durationSeconds) <= 0 || Number(body.durationSeconds) > policy.maxDurationSeconds || !body.videoUrl || !validMediaUrl(body.videoUrl) || typeof body.preview !== "boolean")) return null;
  return { ...body, title: body.title.trim() } as unknown as CurriculumMutation;
}
```

### File: `modules/features/admin/helpers/validate-media-url.ts`

SHA-256: `d09d3e0caf812769e0ba5b491baf708aa9a08e278149a5f570f3d038ccb4cc6a`

```typescript
import { adminCoursePolicy as policy } from "@platform/config/admin";
export function validMediaUrl(value: unknown): value is string {
  if (typeof value !== "string" || value.length > policy.urlMax) return false;
  if (!value) return true;
  if (/^\/assets\/[\w\-./]+$/.test(value)) return !value.split("/").includes("..");
  try { const url = new URL(value); return ["https:", "http:"].includes(url.protocol) && !url.username && !url.password; } catch { return false; }
}
```

```typescript
export async function createCourse(input: CreateCourseInput) {
 const { client } = await requireAdmin(), metadata = createCourseMetadata(input, courseDraftDefaults);
 const { error } = await client.from("courses").insert({ slug: input.slug, metadata: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(metadata)) as NonNullable<Json>, amount: input.amount, published: false });
```

SHA-256: `6773f4112e683ef65708981160560aaee63e7f4c08f7de1b25c11ecff98d7037`

```typescript
import { requireAdmin } from "../identity";
import { createAuthAdministrator } from "@platform/lib/supabase/admin";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
import { readAdminUser } from "./users";
import { suspensionPeriods, userAdministration } from "@platform/config/user-moderation";
import type { UserModeration } from "@platform/types/admin-users";
export async function moderateUser(id: string, change: UserModeration) {
  const { client, user: actor } = await requireAdmin();
  const target = await readAdminUser(id);
  if (target.admin || actor.id === id) throw new ApiError(403, "PROTECTED_ADMIN");
  if (change.action === "promote") {
    const result = await client.rpc("promote_admin_user", { target_id: id });
    if (result.error) throw new ApiError(result.error.code === "22023" ? 400 : 503, "INVALID_INPUT");
  } else {
    const administrator = createAuthAdministrator();
    const result = change.action === "remove" ? await administrator.auth.admin.deleteUser(id)
      : await administrator.auth.admin.updateUserById(id, { ban_duration: change.action === "restore" ? "none"
        : `${change.action === "ban" ? userAdministration.permanentBanHours : (change.action === "suspend" ? suspensionPeriods.find(item => item.id === change.period)!.hours : 0)}h` });
    if (result.error) throw new ApiError(503, "INTERNAL_ERROR");
  }
  return { saved: true };
}
```

```typescript
import { requireAdmin } from "../identity";
import type { CourseModule } from "@platform/types/lms";
import type { Json } from "@platform/types/database";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
export async function persistCurriculum(slug: string, revision: number, modules: CourseModule[], lesson: { id: string; video_url: string; preview: boolean } | null, deletedId?: string) {
  const { client } = await requireAdmin();
  const { error } = await client.rpc("save_admin_curriculum", { p_slug: slug, p_revision: revision, p_modules: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(modules)) as Json, p_lesson: lesson, p_deleted_id: deletedId });
  if (!error) return;
  const code = ["COURSE_CONFLICT","NOT_FOUND","FORBIDDEN"].find(code => error.message.includes(code));
  throw new ApiError(code === "COURSE_CONFLICT" ? 409 : code === "NOT_FOUND" ? 404 : code === "FORBIDDEN" ? 403 : 503,code ?? "INTERNAL_ERROR");
}
```

```typescript
import { assertCourseContent } from "../helpers/assert-course-content";
import { requireAdmin } from "../identity";
import { readAdminCourses } from "./courses";
import { editCourseMetadata } from "../helpers/edit-course-metadata";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
import type { Json } from "@platform/types/database";
import type { validateCourseEdit } from "../helpers/validate-course-edit";
export async function saveCourse(slug: string, values: NonNullable<ReturnType<typeof validateCourseEdit>>) {
  const { client } = await requireAdmin();
  const current = (await readAdminCourses(slug))[0];
  if (!current) throw new ApiError(404, "NOT_FOUND");
  if (values.revision !== undefined && values.revision !== current.revision) throw new ApiError(409,"COURSE_CONFLICT");
  const { amount, published } = values;
  const course = editCourseMetadata(current.course,values);
  if (published && course.delivery === "live" && !course.duration.trim()) throw new ApiError(400, "COURSE_DURATION_REQUIRED");
  assertCourseContent(course,published);
  const { error, data } = await client.from("courses").update({ metadata: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(course)) as NonNullable<Json>, amount, published }).eq("slug",slug).eq("revision",current.revision).select("slug").maybeSingle();
  if (error) throw new ApiError(503, "INTERNAL_ERROR");
  if (!data) throw new ApiError(409, "COURSE_CONFLICT");
  return { saved: true };
}
```

```typescript
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { requireAdmin } from "../identity";
import { readAdminCourses } from "./courses";
import { applyCurriculumMutation } from "../helpers/apply-curriculum-mutation";
import { assertCourseContent } from "../helpers/assert-course-content";
import type { CurriculumMutation } from "@platform/types/curriculum";
import { persistCurriculum } from "./persist-curriculum";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
export async function saveCurriculum(slug: string, input: CurriculumMutation) {
  await requireAdmin();
  const current = (await readAdminCourses(slug))[0];
  if (!current) throw new ApiError(404,"NOT_FOUND");
  if (current.revision !== input.revision) throw new ApiError(409,"COURSE_CONFLICT");
  const id = input.operation === "create" ? `${input.kind}-${randomUUID()}` : input.id!;
  const course = applyCurriculumMutation(current.course,input,id);
  assertCourseContent(course,current.published,"PUBLISHED_CURRICULUM_INCOMPLETE");
  const lesson = input.kind === "lesson" && input.operation !== "delete" ? { id, video_url: input.videoUrl!, preview: input.preview! } : null;
  await persistCurriculum(slug,input.revision,course.modules,lesson,input.kind === "lesson" && input.operation === "delete" ? id : undefined);
  return { saved: true, id };
}
```

```typescript
import "server-only";
import { requireAdmin } from "../identity";
import { createAuthAdministrator } from "@platform/lib/supabase/admin";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
import { isValidUsername, normalizeUsername } from "@platform/helpers/validation/username";
import { validUserId } from "../helpers/read-moderation";
import { readAdminUser } from "./users";
/** Resolve a public-facing handle only after authorization; mutations continue using immutable IDs. */
export async function resolveAdminUser(handle: string) {
  await requireAdmin();
  if (!isValidUsername(handle)) throw new ApiError(404, "NOT_FOUND");
  const { data, error } = await createAuthAdministrator().from("profiles")
    .select("id").eq("username", normalizeUsername(handle)).maybeSingle();
  if (error) throw new ApiError(503, "INTERNAL_ERROR");
  if (data) return readAdminUser(data.id);
  // Existing UUID bookmarks redirect to the stored username in the page.
  if (validUserId(handle)) return readAdminUser(handle);
  throw new ApiError(404, "NOT_FOUND");
}
```

### File: `modules/features/admin/repositories/user-subscriptions.ts`

SHA-256: `c2bfc6af5476f384fd76c3eb36997bebe01f2578aeb99cf53b2a23676ae8467c`

```typescript
import { requireAdmin } from "../identity";
import { createAuthAdministrator } from "@platform/lib/supabase/admin";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
import { publicCourse } from "@platform/features/catalog/helpers/public-course";
export async function readUserSubscriptions(id: string) {
  await requireAdmin();
  const client = createAuthAdministrator();
  const enrollments = await client.from("enrollments").select("course_slug,created_at").eq("user_id", id).order("created_at", { ascending: false });
  if (enrollments.error) throw new ApiError(503, "INTERNAL_ERROR");
  if (!enrollments.data.length) return [];
  const courses = await client.from("courses").select("slug,metadata,amount").in("slug", enrollments.data.map(row => row.course_slug));
  if (courses.error) throw new ApiError(503, "INTERNAL_ERROR");
  return enrollments.data.flatMap(row => {
    const record = courses.data.find(course => course.slug === row.course_slug);
    if (!record) return [];
    const course = publicCourse(record.metadata, record.slug, record.amount);
    return [{ slug: course.slug, title: course.title, delivery: course.delivery ?? "recorded" as const, enrolledAt: row.created_at }];
  });
}
```

```typescript
import { readJson, sameOrigin } from "@platform/lib/server-request";
import { apiResponse } from "@platform/lib/api/respond";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
import { authCopy } from "@platform/data/auth";
import type { AuthMode } from "@platform/types/auth";
import { validateAuth } from "./helpers/validate";
import { authenticate } from "./server/authenticate";
export async function handleAuth(request: Request, mode: AuthMode) {
  return apiResponse(async () => {
    if (!sameOrigin(request)) throw new ApiError(403, "FORBIDDEN");
    const result = validateAuth(await readJson(request), mode);
    if (!result.valid) return Response.json({ error: authCopy.invalidRequest, fields: result.errors }, { status: 400 });
    return Response.json(await authenticate(result.values, mode));
  });
}
```

```typescript
import { readProfileResponse } from "@platform/helpers/read-profile-response";
export function readAuthResponse(input: unknown, failureLabel: string) {
  if (!input || typeof input !== "object" || !("status" in input)) throw new Error(failureLabel);
  if (input.status === "confirmation_required") return { status: "confirmation_required" as const };
  if (input.status !== "authenticated" || !("profile" in input)) throw new Error(failureLabel);
  try { return { status: "authenticated" as const, profile: readProfileResponse(input.profile) }; }
  catch { throw new Error(failureLabel); }
}
```

```typescript
import type { AuthValues } from "@platform/types/auth";
export function readAuthValues(input: unknown): AuthValues {
  const source = input && typeof input === "object" && !Array.isArray(input) ? input as Record<string, unknown> : {};
  const text = (key: keyof AuthValues) => typeof source[key] === "string" ? source[key] : "";
  return { name: text("name").trim(), email: text("email").trim().toLowerCase(), password: text("password"), confirmPassword: text("confirmPassword") };
}
```

### File: `modules/features/auth/helpers/validate-field.ts`

SHA-256: `d5b9bf7c4bab9903a8bd15988453668e31c930a7e058e3ae7ac464d6c74fbb0c`

```typescript
import { authPolicy } from "@platform/config/auth";
import { isValidEmail } from "@platform/helpers/validation/email";
import type { AuthField, AuthIssue, AuthValues } from "@platform/types/auth";
export function validateAuthField(field: AuthField, value: AuthValues): AuthIssue | undefined {
  if (field === "name") {
    if (!value.name) return "nameRequired";
    if (value.name.length < authPolicy.nameMin || value.name.length > authPolicy.nameMax) return "nameLength";
  }
  if (field === "email") {
    if (!value.email) return "emailRequired";
    if (!isValidEmail(value.email, authPolicy.emailMax)) return "emailInvalid";
  }
  if (field === "password") {
    if (!value.password) return "passwordRequired";
    if (value.password.length < authPolicy.passwordMin || value.password.length > authPolicy.passwordMax) return "passwordLength";
  }
  if (field === "confirmPassword") {
    if (!value.confirmPassword) return "confirmationRequired";
    if (value.confirmPassword !== value.password) return "confirmationMismatch";
  }
}
```

### File: `modules/features/auth/helpers/validate.ts`

SHA-256: `d604f69a9bc2e7d86a2f2363bbee9578f06be39d5ffc58ebc35fa32965e8b57d`

```typescript
import { authFields } from "@platform/config/auth";
import { readAuthValues } from "./read-values";
import { validateAuthField } from "./validate-field";
import type { AuthErrors, AuthMode, AuthValidation } from "@platform/types/auth";
export function validateAuth(input: unknown, mode: AuthMode): AuthValidation {
  const values = readAuthValues(input), errors: AuthErrors = {};
  for (const field of authFields[mode]) {
    const issue = validateAuthField(field, values);
    if (issue) errors[field] = issue;
  }
  return Object.keys(errors).length ? { valid: false, errors } : { valid: true, values };
}
```

### File: `modules/features/auth/server/authenticate.ts`

SHA-256: `af50854daa5ec23d8db13e2e2d2366b366e894b74de5601802d1426f7e02162b`

```typescript
import { applicationOrigin } from "@platform/lib/application-origin";
import { createDatabaseClient } from "@platform/lib/supabase/server";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
import { ensureProfile } from "@platform/features/profile/repositories/ensure-profile";
import { readProfile } from "@platform/features/profile/repositories/read-profile";
import type { AuthMode, AuthValues } from "@platform/types/auth";
export async function authenticate(values: AuthValues, mode: AuthMode) {
  const client = await createDatabaseClient();
  const result = mode === "login"
    ? await client.auth.signInWithPassword({ email: values.email, password: values.password })
    : await client.auth.signUp({ email: values.email, password: values.password, options: {
      data: { name: values.name }, emailRedirectTo: `${applicationOrigin()}/api/auth/callback`,
    } });
  if (result.error) {
    if (result.error.status === 429) throw new ApiError(429, "RATE_LIMITED");
    throw new ApiError(mode === "login" ? 401 : 400, mode === "login" ? "INVALID_CREDENTIALS" : "AUTH_FAILED");
  }
  if (!result.data.session || !result.data.user) return { status: "confirmation_required" as const };
  await ensureProfile(client, result.data.user);
  return { status: "authenticated" as const, profile: await readProfile(client, result.data.user) };
}
```

SHA-256: `f79d2dfa7304e252b7d3d7de00dbc04d9218a5b4105fcdded63e36130f8c9625`

```typescript

export function formatCourseDuration(seconds: number) {
  const minutes = Math.round(seconds / 60),
    hours = Math.floor(minutes / 60),
    rest = minutes % 60;
  const arabic = (value: number) =>
    String(value).replace(/\d/g, (digit) => "٠١٢٣٤٥٦٧٨٩"[Number(digit)]);
  const hour =
    hours === 1 ? "ساعة" : hours === 2 ? "ساعتان" : `${arabic(hours)} ساعات`;
  const minute = `${arabic(rest || minutes)} ${(rest || minutes) >= 3 && (rest || minutes) <= 10 ? "دقائق" : "دقيقة"}`;
  return hours ? (rest ? `${hour} و${minute}` : hour) : minute;
}
```

```typescript

export function parseLessonTime(value: string) {
  if (!/^\d+:\d{2}$/.test(value))
    throw new Error(`Invalid lesson duration: ${value}`);
  const [minutes, seconds] = value.split(":").map(Number);
  if (seconds > 59) throw new Error(`Invalid lesson seconds: ${value}`);
  return minutes * 60 + seconds;
}
```

```typescript
import type { Course } from "@platform/types/lms";
import { validateCourse } from "./validate-course";
import { validateLessons } from "./validate-lessons";
export function publicCourse(metadata: unknown, slug: string, amount: number, options: { draft?: boolean } = {}): Course {
  const course = metadata as Course;
  const result = { ...course, slug, offer: { ...course.offer, amount } };
  validateCourse(result, new Set(), options);
  validateLessons(result, result.modules.flatMap(section => section.lessons.flatMap(lesson => lesson.resourceIds)), options);
  return { ...result, modules: result.modules.map(section => ({ ...section,
    lessons: section.lessons.map(lesson => ({ ...lesson, videoUrl: "" })),
  })) };
}
```

```typescript
    lessons: lessonIds.flatMap((id) => {
      const lesson = lessons.find((item) => item.id === id);
      return lesson ? [lesson] : [];
    }),
  };
}
```

### File: `modules/features/catalog/helpers/validate-course.ts`

SHA-256: `4ea89b411a26b0861ce023913d34d490d1a40903a57f7d06df4a39758c8bac37`

```typescript
import { artworkKinds, categories } from "@platform/config/catalog";
import type { Course } from "@platform/types/lms";
export function validateCourse(course: Course, slugs: Set<string>, { draft = false }: { draft?: boolean } = {}) {
  if (!/^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$/.test(course.slug) || slugs.has(course.slug) ||
      !course.title.trim() || (!draft && !course.modules.length && course.delivery !== "live") ||
      !categories.some((category) => category.id === course.category) ||
      !artworkKinds.includes(course.artwork) || !Number.isFinite(course.offer.amount) ||
      course.offer.amount < 0 || !course.offer.actionLabel.trim())
    throw new Error(`Invalid course: ${course.slug}`);
  if (!draft && course.delivery === "live" && (!course.deliveryLabel?.trim() || !course.duration.trim())) throw new Error(`Invalid live course: ${course.slug}`);
  if (!draft && course.modules.some((module) => !module.title.trim() || !module.lessons.length))
    throw new Error(`Empty published module: ${course.slug}`);
}
```

### File: `modules/features/catalog/helpers/validate-lessons.ts`

SHA-256: `023fa76f410611de6696cf7e8542af23e6ca4fce8300f776bfeeb5e57b186896`

```typescript
import { validateSections } from "./validate-sections";
import type { Course } from "@platform/types/lms";
import { courseLessons } from "./course-lessons";
export function validateLessons(course: Course, resourceIds: readonly string[], { draft = false }: { draft?: boolean } = {}) {
  validateSections(course);
  const ids = new Set<string>(), lessons = courseLessons(course);
  if (!draft && !lessons.length && course.delivery !== "live") throw new Error(`Empty published course: ${course.slug}`);
  for (const lesson of lessons) {
    if (!/^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$/.test(lesson.id) || !lesson.title.trim() ||
        ids.has(lesson.id) || !Number.isFinite(lesson.durationSeconds) || lesson.durationSeconds <= 0)
      throw new Error(`Invalid lesson: ${lesson.id}`);
    ids.add(lesson.id);
    if (lesson.resourceIds.some((id) => !resourceIds.includes(id)))
      throw new Error(`Unknown lesson resource: ${lesson.id}`);
  }
}
```

### File: `modules/features/catalog/helpers/validate-sections.ts`

SHA-256: `8e35bd79601e6f4c8ef2182a34dc00d417d1cd94063e924a9276eb21cdbb93ca`

```typescript
import type { Course } from "@platform/types/lms";
export function validateSections(course: Course) {
  for (const chapter of course.modules) {
    const ids = new Set<string>(), assigned = new Set<string>();
    const lessons = new Set(chapter.lessons.map(lesson => lesson.id));
    for (const section of chapter.sections ?? []) {
      if (!/^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$/.test(section.id) || !section.title.trim() || ids.has(section.id) ||
          new Set(section.lessonIds).size !== section.lessonIds.length ||
          section.lessonIds.some(id => !lessons.has(id) || assigned.has(id)))
        throw new Error(`Invalid course section: ${course.slug}`);
      ids.add(section.id);
      section.lessonIds.forEach(id => assigned.add(id));
    }
  }
}
```

### File: `modules/features/catalog/stream-drive.ts`

SHA-256: `6e29e5198247591739d5d4bd3dd025a9aa5f458da8367fb05ce8d0055edca1c8`

```typescript
import "server-only";
import { driveFileId } from "@platform/helpers/media/drive-file-id";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
export async function streamDrive(url: string, request: Request) {
  const id = driveFileId(url);
  if (!id) throw new ApiError(404,"NOT_FOUND");
  const range = request.headers.get("range");
  if (range && !/^bytes=\d*-\d*$/.test(range)) throw new ApiError(400,"INVALID_INPUT");
  const response = await fetch(`https://drive.usercontent.google.com/download?id=${id}&export=download&confirm=t`, {
    headers: range ? { Range: range } : {}, signal: request.signal, cache: "no-store",
  });
  if (!response.ok || !/^(video\/|application\/octet-stream)/i.test(response.headers.get("content-type") ?? "")) {
    await response.body?.cancel(); throw new ApiError(503,"MEDIA_UNAVAILABLE");
  }
  const headers = new Headers({ "Content-Type": response.headers.get("content-type") === "application/octet-stream" ? "video/mp4" : response.headers.get("content-type")!, "Cache-Control": "private, no-store" });
  for (const name of ["Content-Length","Content-Range","Accept-Ranges"]) { const value = response.headers.get(name); if (value) headers.set(name,value); }
  return new Response(response.body, { status: response.status, headers });
}
```

### File: `modules/features/certificates/download.ts`

```typescript
import { requireIdentity } from "@platform/features/auth/server/identity";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
import { findCourse } from "@platform/features/catalog";
import { readLearningState, courseProgress } from "@platform/features/learning";
import { certificatePresentation } from "./presentation";
import { renderCertificate } from "./renderer";
import { interfaceCopy } from "@platform/data/interface-copy";
import { site } from "@platform/data/site";
import { learningIdentity } from "@/config/identity";
export async function downloadCertificate(slug: string) {
  await requireIdentity();
  const course = await findCourse(slug);
  if (!course) throw new ApiError(404, "NOT_FOUND");
  const state = await readLearningState();
  if (!state.enrolled.includes(slug) || courseProgress(course, state).percent !== 100) throw new ApiError(403, "FORBIDDEN");
  const svg = renderCertificate({ brandName: site.name, brandEnglishName: site.englishName,
    learnerName: state.profile.name, courseTitle: course.title, title: interfaceCopy.certificateTitle,
    disclaimer: interfaceCopy.certificateDisclaimer }, certificatePresentation);
  return new Response(svg, { headers: { "Content-Type": "image/svg+xml; charset=utf-8",
    "Content-Disposition": `attachment; filename="${learningIdentity.exportPrefix}-${slug}.svg"` } });
}
```

```typescript
export interface CertificateModel {
  brandName: string;
  brandEnglishName: string;
  learnerName: string;
  courseTitle: string;
  title: string;
  disclaimer: string;
}
export interface CertificatePresentation {
  colors: { primary: string; background: string; text: string };
  fontBase64: string;
}
const escapeXml = (text: string) =>
  text.replace(
    /[<>&"']/g,
    (char) =>
      ({
        "<": "&lt;",
        ">": "&gt;",
        "&": "&amp;",
        '"': "&quot;",
        "'": "&apos;",
      })[char]!,
  );
export function renderCertificate(
  model: CertificateModel,
  presentation: CertificatePresentation,
) {
  return `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1200" height="850" viewBox="0 0 1200 850"><rect width="1200" height="850" fill="${presentation.colors.background}"/><rect x="35" y="35" width="1130" height="780" rx="14" fill="none" stroke="${presentation.colors.primary}" stroke-width="2"/><style>@font-face{font-family:CertificateArabic;src:url(data:font/ttf;base64,${presentation.fontBase64}) format('truetype');font-weight:700;}</style><g font-weight="700" text-anchor="middle" fill="${presentation.colors.text}" font-family="CertificateArabic"><text x="600" y="150" font-size="44">${escapeXml(model.brandName)} / ${escapeXml(model.brandEnglishName)}</text><text x="600" y="285" font-size="40">${escapeXml(model.title)}</text><text x="600" y="400" font-size="48">${escapeXml(model.learnerName)}</text><text x="600" y="505" font-size="30">${escapeXml(model.courseTitle)}</text><text x="600" y="650" font-size="24">${escapeXml(model.disclaimer)}</text></g></svg>`;
}
```

### File: `modules/features/learning/handle-enrollment.ts`

SHA-256: `d5797e45e5654f25f83b3454defdc5e4ab7332c4a9b443939a3322d7b8ee5aa9`

```typescript
import { apiResponse } from "@platform/lib/api/respond";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
import { readJson, sameOrigin } from "@platform/lib/server-request";
import { requireIdentity } from "@platform/features/auth/server/identity";
import { readState } from "./repositories/read-state";
import { enrollCourse } from "./repositories/enroll-course";
export async function handleEnrollment(request?: Request) {
  return apiResponse(async () => {
    if (!request) {
      const { client, user } = await requireIdentity();
      return Response.json(await readState(client, user));
    }
    if (!sameOrigin(request)) throw new ApiError(403, "FORBIDDEN");
    const body = await readJson(request);
    if (typeof body?.courseSlug !== "string") throw new ApiError(400, "INVALID_INPUT");
    return Response.json(await enrollCourse(body.courseSlug));
  });
}
```

### File: `modules/features/learning/helpers/course-progress.ts`

SHA-256: `d896c8b9e3d1a0a5dc37f749eb985ba9e9fd111d83c4fbc1ead896f853e2e298`

```typescript
import { courseLessons, lessonKey } from "../../catalog/helpers";
import type { Course, LearningState } from "@platform/types/lms";
export function courseProgress(
  course: Course,
  state: Pick<LearningState, "completed">,
) {
  const lessons = courseLessons(course),
    completed = new Set(state.completed);
  const count = lessons.filter((lesson) =>
    completed.has(lessonKey(course.slug, lesson.id)),
  ).length;
  return {
    count,
    total: lessons.length,
    percent: lessons.length ? Math.round((count / lessons.length) * 100) : 0,
    next: lessons.find(
      (lesson) => !completed.has(lessonKey(course.slug, lesson.id)),
    ),
  };
}
export type CourseProgress = ReturnType<typeof courseProgress>;
```

```typescript
import { courseProgress } from "./course-progress";
```

```typescript
      title: module.title,

        id: lesson.id,

        href: lessonHref(course.slug, lesson.id),
        complete: state.completed.includes(lessonKey(course.slug, lesson.id)),
      })),
    })),
  };
}
export type LessonOutlineModel = ReturnType<typeof lessonOutline>;
```

### File: `modules/features/learning/read-lesson-context.ts`

SHA-256: `eb0ecc74e7661f84b120ffd57b1a194b03b1ba27f9220615fe9c03b295ef1599`

```typescript
import { playableUrl } from "@platform/helpers/media/playable-url";
import { currentIdentity } from "@platform/features/auth/server/identity";
import { readPlayback } from "../catalog/repositories/read-playback";
import { notFound, redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { routes } from "@platform/config/navigation";
import { findCourse } from "../catalog/service";
import { findLesson, courseLessons, lessonKey } from "../catalog/helpers";
import { readLearningState } from "./service";
export async function readLessonContext(slug: string, lessonId: string) {
  const course = await findCourse(slug);
  if (!course) notFound();
  const lesson = findLesson(course, lessonId);
  if (!lesson) notFound();
  if (!lesson.preview && !await currentIdentity()) redirect(routes.login);
  const state = await readLearningState();
  const enrolled = state.enrolled.includes(slug);
  if (!enrolled && !lesson.preview) redirect(routes.course(slug));
  const lessons = courseLessons(course);
  const index = lessons.findIndex((item) => item.id === lessonId);
  return { slug, lessonId, course, lesson: { ...lesson, videoUrl: playableUrl(await readPlayback(slug, lessonId), slug, lessonId) }, state, enrolled, lessons, index,
    next: lessons[index + 1], complete: state.completed.includes(lessonKey(slug, lessonId)) };
}
export type LessonContext = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof readLessonContext>>;
```

### File: `modules/features/learning/repositories/enroll-course.ts`

SHA-256: `7d22ee17a28ba4c3727a7b4a80f0ab34ee835c81583ddc42b5724448ff5c0462`

```typescript
import { requireIdentity } from "@platform/features/auth/server/identity";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
import { findCourse } from "@platform/features/catalog/service";
import { readState } from "./read-state";
export async function enrollCourse(slug: string) {
  const { client, user } = await requireIdentity();
  const course = await findCourse(slug);
  if (!course) throw new ApiError(404, "NOT_FOUND");
  const { data, error: lookupError } = await client.from("enrollments").select("course_slug").eq("user_id", user.id).eq("course_slug", slug).maybeSingle();
  if (lookupError) throw new ApiError(503, "INTERNAL_ERROR");
  if (!data) {
    const verification = await client.rpc("contacts_verified");
    if (verification.error) throw new ApiError(503, "INTERNAL_ERROR");
    if (!verification.data) throw new ApiError(403, "CONTACT_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED");
    if (course.delivery === "live" || course.offer.amountLabel || course.offer.amount > 0) throw new ApiError(403, "PAYMENT_REQUIRED");
    const { error } = await client.from("enrollments").insert({ user_id: user.id, course_slug: slug });
    if (error && error.code !== "23505") throw new ApiError(503, "INTERNAL_ERROR");
  }
  return readState(client, user);
}
```

```typescript
import type { DatabaseClient } from "@platform/types/database-client";
import type { User } from "@supabase/supabase-js";
import { readProfile } from "@platform/features/profile/repositories/read-profile";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
import type { LearningState } from "@platform/types/lms";
export async function readState(client: DatabaseClient, user: User): Promise<LearningState> {
  const [profile, enrollment, progress] = await Promise.all([
    readProfile(client, user),
    client.from("enrollments").select("course_slug").eq("user_id", user.id),
    client.from("lesson_progress").select("course_slug,lesson_id").eq("user_id", user.id).eq("completed", true),
  ]);
  if (enrollment.error || progress.error) throw new ApiError(503, "INTERNAL_ERROR");
  return { profile, enrolled: enrollment.data.map((row) => row.course_slug), completed: progress.data.map((row) => `${row.course_slug}/${row.lesson_id}`) };
}
```

### File: `modules/features/learning/repositories/save-progress.ts`

SHA-256: `b24063d3844ee7494239b69cb49d9e1d5b04ab42a07c88c8d28aa7de3cce8319`

```typescript
import { requireIdentity } from "@platform/features/auth/server/identity";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
import { findCourse } from "@platform/features/catalog/service";
import { findLesson } from "@platform/features/catalog/helpers";
import { readState } from "./read-state";
export async function saveProgress(slug: string, id: string, completed: boolean) {
  const { client, user } = await requireIdentity();
  const course = await findCourse(slug);
  if (!course || !findLesson(course, id)) throw new ApiError(404, "NOT_FOUND");
  const { data, error: accessError } = await client.from("enrollments").select("course_slug").eq("user_id", user.id).eq("course_slug", slug).maybeSingle();
  if (accessError) throw new ApiError(503, "INTERNAL_ERROR");
  if (!data) throw new ApiError(403, "FORBIDDEN");
  const { error } = await client.from("lesson_progress").upsert({ user_id: user.id, course_slug: slug, lesson_id: id, completed }, { onConflict: "user_id,course_slug,lesson_id" });
  if (error) throw new ApiError(503, "INTERNAL_ERROR");
  return readState(client, user);
}
```

```typescript
export function workshopCourseContent(content: MarketingPageContent, course: Course, defaults: Course): MarketingPageContent {

    ...(getYouTubeEmbedUrl(source) ? { url: source } : { source: { kind: "file" as const, url: playableUrl(source,course.slug) } }),

    title: course.title === defaults.title ? content.hero.title : [course.title],
    description: course.description === defaults.description ? content.hero.description : course.description,
  } };
```

### File: `modules/features/media/handle-image-upload.ts`

SHA-256: `655dbe0e16a72406fabe74197d1c7f44c7096cb0fa572224f87778a7993dc724`

```typescript
import { apiResponse } from "@platform/lib/api/respond";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
import { sameOrigin } from "@platform/lib/server-request";
import { requireIdentity } from "@platform/features/auth/server/identity";
import { requireAdmin } from "@platform/features/admin/identity";
import { readImageUpload } from "./helpers/read-image-upload";
import { validateImage } from "./helpers/validate-image";
import { uploadImage } from "./repositories/upload-image";
import { saveAvatar } from "./repositories/save-avatar";
export function handleImageUpload(request: Request) {
  return apiResponse(async () => {
    if (!sameOrigin(request)) throw new ApiError(403, "FORBIDDEN");
    const { user } = await requireIdentity(), input = await readImageUpload(request);
    if (input.kind === "course") {
      const { client } = await requireAdmin();
      const course = await client.from("courses").select("slug").eq("slug", input.courseSlug).maybeSingle();
      if (course.error) throw new ApiError(503, "INTERNAL_ERROR");
      if (!course.data) throw new ApiError(404, "NOT_FOUND");
    }
    await validateImage(input.file);
    const folder = input.kind === "avatar" ? `users/${user.id}/avatars` : `courses/${input.courseSlug}/thumbnails`;
    const image = await uploadImage(input.file, folder, input.kind === "avatar");
    if (input.kind === "avatar") await saveAvatar(user.id, image);
    return Response.json(image, { status: 201 });
  });
}
```

### File: `modules/features/media/helpers/read-image-upload.ts`

SHA-256: `ea880d25ded6a332cec9e8a68c02e4cc3816e518d85dc9050811b890d004c214`

```typescript
import { imageUploadPolicy as policy } from "@platform/config/image-upload";
import { readRequestBytes } from "@platform/lib/read-request-bytes";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
export async function readImageUpload(request: Request) {
  if (!request.headers.get("content-type")?.startsWith("multipart/form-data;")) throw new ApiError(400, "INVALID_IMAGE");
  const bytes = await readRequestBytes(request, policy.maxRequestBytes);
  if (!bytes) throw new ApiError(413, "IMAGE_TOO_LARGE");
  const form = await new Response(new Blob([Uint8Array.from(bytes).buffer]), { headers: { "Content-Type": request.headers.get("content-type")! } }).formData().catch(() => null);
  const file = form?.get("file"), kind = form?.get("kind"), courseSlug = form?.get("courseSlug");
  if (!(file instanceof File) || !file.size || !["avatar", "course"].includes(String(kind))) throw new ApiError(400, "INVALID_IMAGE");
  if (file.size > policy.maxBytes) throw new ApiError(413, "IMAGE_TOO_LARGE");
  if (kind === "course" && (typeof courseSlug !== "string" || !/^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$/.test(courseSlug))) throw new ApiError(400, "INVALID_INPUT");
  return { file, kind: kind as "avatar" | "course", courseSlug: typeof courseSlug === "string" ? courseSlug : "" };
}
```

### File: `modules/features/media/helpers/read-uploaded-image.ts`

SHA-256: `04e5c567a2248a5354a56653187947e4b49c676a21cd02c342f50b2b63fd605e`

```typescript
import type { UploadedImage } from "@platform/types/image-upload";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
export function readUploadedImage(input: unknown): UploadedImage {
  const value = input as Partial<UploadedImage> | null;
  if (!value || typeof value.url !== "string" || !value.url.startsWith("https://res.cloudinary.com/") || typeof value.publicId !== "string" || typeof value.width !== "number" || typeof value.height !== "number" || !Number.isFinite(value.width) || !Number.isFinite(value.height) || value.width <= 0 || value.height <= 0) throw new ApiError(503, "IMAGE_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE");
  return value as UploadedImage;
}
```

### File: `modules/features/media/helpers/validate-image.ts`

SHA-256: `861de2a8136263bfb9ad4e5748c5d5f9f65c2be982734f751bcfaa5739117887`

```typescript
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
/** Check content signatures as well as the browser-declared MIME; Cloudinary decodes it again. */
export async function validateImage(file: File) {
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 12).arrayBuffer());
  const png = bytes.length >= 8 && [137, 80, 78, 71, 13, 10, 26, 10].every((value, index) => bytes[index] === value);
  const jpeg = bytes[0] === 255 && bytes[1] === 216 && bytes[2] === 255;
  const text = new TextDecoder().decode(bytes), webp = text.startsWith("RIFF") && text.slice(8, 12) === "WEBP";
  if (!(png && file.type === "image/png" || jpeg && file.type === "image/jpeg" || webp && file.type === "image/webp")) throw new ApiError(400, "INVALID_IMAGE");
}
```

### File: `modules/features/media/repositories/save-avatar.ts`

SHA-256: `d795c44d82bea6b633f5ed8c53e99ed4e7ed662ea5421ae367a1316a5c33dde0`

```typescript
import "server-only";
import { createAuthAdministrator } from "@platform/lib/supabase/admin";
import { cloudinaryRequest } from "@platform/lib/cloudinary/request";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
import type { UploadedImage } from "@platform/types/image-upload";
export async function saveAvatar(userId: string, image: UploadedImage) {
  const { error, data } = await createAuthAdministrator().from("profiles").update({ avatar_url: image.url }).eq("id", userId).select("id").single();
  if (error || !data) {
    await cloudinaryRequest("destroy", { public_id: image.publicId, invalidate: "true" }).catch(() => null);
    throw new ApiError(503, "INTERNAL_ERROR");
  }
}
```

### File: `modules/features/media/repositories/upload-image.ts`

SHA-256: `8a320ef12cf16deee928c759f884ae378023b2a97547dd0bcb846b0b5c0232c1`

```typescript
import "server-only";
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { cloudinaryEnvironment } from "@platform/lib/cloudinary/environment";
import { cloudinaryRequest } from "@platform/lib/cloudinary/request";
import { imageUploadPolicy as policy } from "@platform/config/image-upload";
import { readUploadedImage } from "../helpers/read-uploaded-image";
export async function uploadImage(file: File, folder: string, avatar: boolean) {
  const { root } = cloudinaryEnvironment(), assetFolder = `${root}/${folder}`, publicId = `${assetFolder}/${randomUUID()}`;
  const value = await cloudinaryRequest("upload", { asset_folder: assetFolder, public_id: publicId, overwrite: "false", allowed_formats: policy.formats, transformation: avatar ? policy.avatarTransform : policy.thumbnailTransform }, file);
  const image = readUploadedImage({ url: value.secure_url, publicId: value.public_id, width: value.width, height: value.height });
  if (image.publicId !== publicId) throw new Error("Unexpected image identifier");
  return { ...image, url: image.url.replace("/image/upload/", "/image/upload/f_auto,q_auto/") };
}
```

### File: `modules/features/profile/handle-request.ts`

SHA-256: `1dd944db577b3b28233fe0b02793fd404d1c8bc34596ccc7bbbd6d25a1ed6b13`

```typescript
import { apiResponse } from "@platform/lib/api/respond";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
import { readJson, sameOrigin } from "@platform/lib/server-request";
import { requireIdentity } from "@platform/features/auth/server/identity";
import { readProfile } from "./repositories/read-profile";
import { validateProfile } from "./validation";
export async function handleProfile(request?: Request) {
  return apiResponse(async () => {
    const { client, user } = await requireIdentity();
    if (!request) return Response.json(await readProfile(client, user));
    if (!sameOrigin(request)) throw new ApiError(403, "FORBIDDEN");
    const profile = validateProfile(await readJson(request));
    if (!profile) throw new ApiError(400, "INVALID_INPUT");
    if (profile.email !== user.email) throw new ApiError(403, "EMAIL_LOCKED");
    const { error } = await client.from("profiles").upsert({ id: user.id, name: profile.name, ...(profile.username ? { username: profile.username } : {}) });
    if (error) throw new ApiError(error.code === "23505" ? 409 : 503, error.code === "23505" ? "USERNAME_TAKEN" : "INTERNAL_ERROR");
    return Response.json({ ...await readProfile(client, user), emailChangePending: profile.email !== user.email });
  });
}
```

```typescript
export async function ensureProfile(client: DatabaseClient, user: User) {
```

```typescript
import type { DatabaseClient } from "@platform/types/database-client";
import type { User } from "@supabase/supabase-js";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
import { interfaceCopy } from "@platform/data/interface-copy";
export async function readProfile(client: DatabaseClient, user: User) {
  const { data, error } = await client.from("profiles").select("name, username").eq("id", user.id).maybeSingle();
  if (error) throw new ApiError(503, "INTERNAL_ERROR");

  return { name, username: data?.username, email: user.email ?? "" };
}
```

### File: `modules/features/profile/validation.ts`

SHA-256: `43200b48c50d7b7fe52ea1b606b36b04ec9cba5fffa9b7237926380e5a796f9e`

```typescript
import { isValidUsername, normalizeUsername } from "@platform/helpers/validation/username";
import { isValidEmail } from "@platform/helpers/validation/email";
import type { Learner } from "@platform/types/lms";
export const profilePolicy = {
  nameMin: 2,
  nameMax: 60,
  emailMax: 100,
} as const;
export function validateProfile(input: unknown, { allowEmptyEmail = false }: { allowEmptyEmail?: boolean } = {}): Learner | null {
  if (!input || typeof input !== "object") return null;
  const value = input as Record<string, unknown>;
  if (typeof value.name !== "string" || typeof value.email !== "string")
    return null;
  const name = value.name.trim(),
    email = value.email.trim();
  if (
    name.length < profilePolicy.nameMin ||
    name.length > profilePolicy.nameMax ||
    email.length > profilePolicy.emailMax ||
    (!(allowEmptyEmail && email === "") && !isValidEmail(email, profilePolicy.emailMax))
  )
    return null;
  if (value.username !== undefined && !isValidUsername(value.username)) return null;
  return { name, email, ...(typeof value.username === "string" ? { username: normalizeUsername(value.username) } : {}) };
}
```

```typescript
export function driveFileId(value: string) {
  try {
    const url = new URL(value);
    if (url.protocol !== "https:" || url.hostname !== "drive.google.com") return null;
    const id = url.pathname.match(/^\/file\/d\/([\w-]+)/)?.[1] ?? url.searchParams.get("id");
    return id && /^[\w-]{8,200}$/.test(id) ? id : null;
  } catch { return null; }
}
```

### File: `modules/helpers/media/probe-video-duration.ts`

SHA-256: `baef68b29b3d586004e48f78cc9a692e7aa47bdf144ee1d0a3af4cab9ac11b06`

```typescript
import { curriculumPolicy as policy } from "@platform/config/curriculum";
export function probeVideoDuration(source: string, signal: AbortSignal, errorLabel: string): Promise<number> {
  return new Promise((resolve,reject) => {
    const video = document.createElement("video");
    let settled = false;
    const finish = (seconds?: number) => {
      if (settled) return;
      settled = true; clearTimeout(timeout);
      signal.removeEventListener("abort",abort); video.onloadedmetadata = null; video.onerror = null;
      video.removeAttribute("src"); video.load();
      if (seconds) resolve(seconds); else reject(new Error(errorLabel));
    };
    const abort = () => finish();
    const timeout = setTimeout(abort,policy.metadataTimeoutMs);
    video.onloadedmetadata = () => {
      const seconds = Math.ceil(video.duration);
      finish(Number.isFinite(seconds) && seconds > 0 && seconds <= policy.maxDurationSeconds ? seconds : undefined);
    };
    video.onerror = abort; signal.addEventListener("abort",abort,{once:true});
    if (signal.aborted) { abort(); return; }
    video.preload = "metadata"; video.src = source; video.load();
  });
}
```

```typescript
/** Highlight every literal match without adding or dropping source text. */
export function highlightText(body: string, emphasis: string) {
  if (!emphasis) return [{ text: body, highlighted: false }];
  return body.split(emphasis).flatMap((text, index) =>
    index ? [{ text: emphasis, highlighted: true }, { text, highlighted: false }]
      : [{ text, highlighted: false }]);
}
```

```typescript
export function navigationRootMargin() {
  // IntersectionObserver resolves percentages against width, not viewport height.
  return getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue("--personal-navigation-root-margin")
    .trim().split(/\s+/).map((value, index) => index % 2 === 0 && value.endsWith("%")
```

### File: `modules/helpers/portfolio/observe-active-section.ts`

SHA-256: `a952574e5f2fc81391ed9e4a1c34d730c4020d91d8d7eb2d5c3b5645454106dc`

```typescript
import { navigationRootMargin } from "./navigation-root-margin";
export function observeActiveSection(ids: readonly string[], onActive: (id: string) => void) {
  const visible = new Set<Element>();
  const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries.forEach(entry => {
      if (entry.isIntersecting) visible.add(entry.target);
      else visible.delete(entry.target);
    });
    const current = [...visible].sort((a, b) => b.getBoundingClientRect().top - a.getBoundingClientRect().top)[0];
    onActive(current?.id ?? "");
  }, { rootMargin: navigationRootMargin() });
  ids.forEach((id) => {
    const section = document.getElementById(id);
    if (section) observer.observe(section);
  });
  return observer;
}
```

```typescript
export function updatePortfolioTimeline(root: HTMLElement, reduced: boolean) {
  const rect = root.getBoundingClientRect();
  const threshold = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(root).getPropertyValue("--personal-timeline-trigger"));
  const edge = innerHeight * threshold;
  root.style.setProperty("--personal-progress", String(reduced ? 1 : Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (edge - rect.top) / rect.height))));
  root.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>("[data-timeline-item]").forEach((item) =>
    item.classList.toggle("is-active", reduced || item.getBoundingClientRect().top <= edge));
}
```

```typescript
export async function uploadImageFile(file: File, target: ImageUploadTarget, failureLabel: string) {
  if (!file.size || file.size > imageUploadPolicy.maxBytes || !imageUploadPolicy.accept.split(",").includes(file.type)) throw new Error(failureLabel);
  const body = new FormData(); body.set("file", file); body.set("kind", target.kind);

}
```

```typescript
"use client";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { observeActiveSection } from "@platform/helpers/portfolio/observe-active-section";
export function useActiveSection(ids: readonly string[]) {
  const [active, setActive] = useState("");
  useEffect(() => {
    let observer: IntersectionObserver;
    const observe = () => {
      observer?.disconnect();
      observer = observeActiveSection(ids, setActive);
    };
    observe();
    addEventListener("resize", observe);
    return () => {
      observer?.disconnect();
      removeEventListener("resize", observe);
    };
  }, [ids]);
  return active;
}
```

```typescript
"use client";
import { createFrameScheduler } from "@khatab/design/helpers/browser/animation-frame";
import { updatePortfolioTimeline } from "@platform/helpers/portfolio/update-timeline";
import { useEffect, type RefObject } from "react";
/** One frame per scroll batch; mutate decorative geometry without React renders. */
export function useTimelineProgress(ref: RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>) {
  useEffect(() => {
    const root = ref.current;
    if (!root) return;
    const preference = matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)");
    const update = () => updatePortfolioTimeline(root, preference.matches);
    const { schedule, dispose } = createFrameScheduler(update);
    update();
    addEventListener("scroll", schedule, { passive: true });
    addEventListener("resize", schedule);
    preference.addEventListener("change", schedule);
    return () => {
      dispose();
      removeEventListener("scroll", schedule);
      removeEventListener("resize", schedule);
      preference.removeEventListener("change", schedule);
    };
  }, [ref]);
}
```

```typescript
"use client";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import { useAsyncCommand } from "./use-async-command";
import { httpRequest } from "@platform/lib/http-request";
export function useAccountSubmission(path: string, errorLabel: string, successLabel: string, decode: (input: unknown) => unknown = input => input, { refresh = true }: { refresh?: boolean } = {}) {
  const router = useRouter(), command = useAsyncCommand(errorLabel);
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
  async function submit(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault(); setMessage("");
    const form = event.currentTarget, input = Object.fromEntries(new FormData(form));
    const result = await command.run(() => httpRequest({ path, body: input, failureLabel: errorLabel, decode }));
    if (result) { setMessage(successLabel); form.querySelectorAll<HTMLInputElement>('input[name="password"],input[name="currentPassword"],input[name="confirmPassword"]').forEach(field => { field.value = ""; }); if (refresh) router.refresh(); }
  }
  return { submit, pending: command.pending, error: command.error, message };
}
```

### File: `modules/hooks/use-admin-save.ts`

SHA-256: `a5bdb58b2270d5cf7b7a68c2eaa45df900bff23daceb2ec90a2c7bea40c71f89`

```typescript
"use client";
import { useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { httpRequest } from "@platform/lib/http-request";
import { useAsyncCommand } from "./use-async-command";
export function useAdminSave(path: string, errorLabel: string, options: { refresh?: boolean } = {}) {
  const router = useRouter(), command = useAsyncCommand(errorLabel);
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState(false);
  const save = async (body: unknown) => {
    setSaved(false);
    const result = await command.run(() => httpRequest({ path, body, failureLabel: errorLabel, decode: value => {
      if (!value || typeof value !== "object" || !("saved" in value) || value.saved !== true) throw new Error(errorLabel);
      return true;
    } }));
    if (result) { setSaved(true); if (options.refresh !== false) router.refresh(); }
    return Boolean(result);
  };
  return { save, pending: command.pending, error: command.error, saved };
}
```

### File: `modules/hooks/use-async-command.ts`

SHA-256: `89a32f35eebc94733edbda382f9fba4e1bed7fb50c3cc66cf46f518527e40fba`

```typescript
"use client";
import { useRef, useState } from "react";
/** Own pending/error and exclusion for the entire workflow, not each HTTP step. */
export function useAsyncCommand(failureLabel: string) {
  const inFlight = useRef(false);
  const [pending, setPending] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  async function run<T>(command: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T | null> {
    if (inFlight.current) return null;
    inFlight.current = true;
    setPending(true);
    setError("");
    try { return await command(); }
    catch (error) {
      setError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : failureLabel);
      return null;
    } finally { inFlight.current = false; setPending(false); }
  }
  return { pending, error, run };
}
```

SHA-256: `30db054f61613bbb9e81ae8ebbdbbe30122611f1bfaa15d3ed87fba9d0305a04`

```typescript
"use client";
import { useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import { useAsyncCommand } from "./use-async-command";
import { httpRequest } from "@platform/lib/http-request";
import { authFields } from "@platform/config/auth";
import { validateAuth } from "@platform/features/auth/helpers/validate";
import { readAuthValues } from "@platform/features/auth/helpers/read-values";
import { validateAuthField } from "@platform/features/auth/helpers/validate-field";
import { readAuthResponse } from "@platform/features/auth/helpers/read-response";
import type { AuthErrors, AuthPageModel } from "@platform/types/auth";
export function useAuthForm({ mode, endpoint, redirectTo, copy }: Pick<AuthPageModel, "mode" | "endpoint" | "redirectTo" | "copy">) {
  const command = useAsyncCommand(copy.requestError);
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<AuthErrors>({});
  const [edited, setEdited] = useState(false);
  const [confirmation, setConfirmation] = useState(false);
  function change(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    if (!(event.target instanceof HTMLInputElement)) return;
    const field = authFields[mode].find((field) => field === (event.target as HTMLInputElement).name);
    if (field) setErrors((current) => ({ ...current, [field]: undefined }));
    setEdited(true);
    setConfirmation(false);
  }
  function blur(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    if (!(event.target instanceof HTMLInputElement)) return;
    const field = authFields[mode].find((field) => field === (event.target as HTMLInputElement).name);
    if (!field) return;
    const issue = validateAuthField(field, readAuthValues(Object.fromEntries(new FormData(event.currentTarget))));
    setErrors((current) => ({ ...current, [field]: issue }));
  }
  async function submit(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    const form = event.currentTarget;
    const result = validateAuth(Object.fromEntries(new FormData(form)), mode);
    setEdited(false);
    if (!result.valid) {
      setErrors(result.errors);
      const field = authFields[mode].find((field) => result.errors[field]);
      const input = field && form.elements.namedItem(field);
      if (input instanceof HTMLElement) input.focus();
      return;
    }
    setErrors({});
    const response = await command.run(() => httpRequest({ path: endpoint, body: result.values, failureLabel: copy.requestError, decode: (input) => readAuthResponse(input, copy.requestError) }));
    if (response?.status === "confirmation_required") { form.reset(); setConfirmation(true); }
    if (response?.status === "authenticated") { form.reset(); window.location.assign(redirectTo); }
  }
  return { submit, change, blur, errors, pending: command.pending, confirmation, error: edited ? "" : command.error };
}
```

```typescript
export function useCurrentTime(interval: number) {
```

```typescript
"use client";
import { persistencePolicy } from "@platform/config/persistence";
import { useCallback, useState, useSyncExternalStore } from "react";
export function useLessonNotes(key: string) {
  const [failed, setFailed] = useState(false);
  const subscribe = useCallback((notify: () => void) => {
    window.addEventListener("storage", notify);
    window.addEventListener(persistencePolicy.notesEvent, notify);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("storage", notify);
      window.removeEventListener(persistencePolicy.notesEvent, notify);
    };
  }, []);
  const snapshot = useCallback(() => {
    try {
      return localStorage.getItem(key) ?? "";
    } catch {
      return "";
    }
  }, [key]);
  const value = useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, snapshot, () => "");
  function save(text: string) {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(key, text);
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event(persistencePolicy.notesEvent));
      setFailed(false);
    } catch {
      setFailed(true);
    }
  }
  return { value, save, failed };
}
```

```typescript
export function useLessonVideoDuration(slug: string, initialUrl: string, initialSeconds: number | undefined, labels: { durationError: string; durationLoading: string }) {
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null), [url,setUrl] = useState(initialUrl), [attempt,retry] = useState(0);
```

```typescript
export function useProfileSubmission(entry: boolean, errorLabel: string) {
```

SHA-256: `b2ae8f9b4b49867df5a45efed6a46fa0394d854d427df1af92cb9983e68c54a3`

```typescript
"use client";
import { useHistoryRestoration } from "@khatab/design/ui/history-boundary";
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
/** Server layouts authorize initial rendering; client route changes and restored history are rechecked. */
export function useProtectedSession(pathname: string, endpoint: string, login: string) {
  const restoration = useHistoryRestoration();
  const [verifiedPath, setVerifiedPath] = useState<{ path: string; restoration: number } | null>(restoration ? null : { path: pathname, restoration });
  const lastPath = useRef(pathname);
  useEffect(() => {
    let controller: AbortController | undefined;
    const verify = async () => {
      controller?.abort();
      controller = new AbortController();
      const signal = controller.signal;
      setVerifiedPath(null);
      try {
        const response = await fetch(endpoint, { cache: "no-store", signal });
        if (!response.ok || (await response.json()).status !== "authenticated") {
          window.location.replace(login);
          return;
        }
        if (!signal.aborted) setVerifiedPath({ path: pathname, restoration });
      } catch {
        if (!signal.aborted) window.location.replace(login);
      }
    };
    const navigation = performance.getEntriesByType("navigation")[0] as PerformanceNavigationTiming | undefined;
    if (restoration || navigation?.type === "back_forward" || lastPath.current !== pathname) { lastPath.current = pathname; void verify(); }
    const restored = (event: PageTransitionEvent) => { if (event.persisted) void verify(); };
    const leaving = () => setVerifiedPath(null);
    window.addEventListener("pageshow", restored);
    window.addEventListener("pagehide", leaving);
    return () => {
      controller?.abort();
      window.removeEventListener("pageshow", restored);
      window.removeEventListener("pagehide", leaving);
    };
  }, [pathname, endpoint, login, restoration]);
  return verifiedPath?.path === pathname && verifiedPath.restoration === restoration;
}
```

```typescript
import { ApiError } from "./error";
import { backendCopy } from "@platform/data/backend-copy";
export async function apiResponse(action: () => Promise<Response>) {
  try {
    const response = await action();
    response.headers.set("Cache-Control", "private, no-store");
    return response;
  } catch (error) {
    const missing = error instanceof Error && error.message === "SUPABASE_NOT_CONFIGURED";
    const status = error instanceof ApiError ? error.status : missing ? 503 : 500;

  }
}
```

```typescript
export function applicationOrigin() {
  const value = process.env.APP_ORIGIN;
  if (!value) throw new Error("SUPABASE_NOT_CONFIGURED");
  const url = new URL(value);
  if (!["http:", "https:"].includes(url.protocol) || url.pathname !== "/" || url.search || url.hash)
    throw new Error("SUPABASE_NOT_CONFIGURED");
  return url.origin;
}
```

```typescript
  const cloudName = process.env.CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME, apiKey = process.env.CLOUDINARY_API_KEY, secret = process.env.CLOUDINARY_API_SECRET;
```

```typescript
import "server-only";
import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import { cloudinaryEnvironment } from "./environment";
import { imageUploadPolicy } from "@platform/config/image-upload";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
export async function cloudinaryRequest(action: "upload" | "destroy", parameters: Record<string, string>, file?: File, fetcher = fetch) {
  const { cloudName, apiKey, secret } = cloudinaryEnvironment();
  const values = { ...parameters, timestamp: String(Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000)) };
  const signature = createHash("sha256").update(Object.entries(values).sort(([a], [b]) => a.localeCompare(b)).map(([key, value]) => `${key}=${value}`).join("&") + secret).digest("hex");
  const body = new FormData();
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) body.set(key, value);
  body.set("signature", signature); body.set("api_key", apiKey);
  if (file) body.set("file", file, "image");
  const response = await fetcher(`https://api.cloudinary.com/v1_1/${cloudName}/image/${action}`, { method: "POST", body, signal: AbortSignal.timeout(imageUploadPolicy.timeoutMs) }).catch(() => { throw new ApiError(503, "IMAGE_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE"); });
  const data: unknown = await response.json().catch(() => null);
  if (!response.ok || !data || typeof data !== "object") throw new ApiError(503, "IMAGE_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE");
  return data as Record<string, unknown>;
}
```

```typescript
import { HttpError } from "./http-error";
export interface HttpRequestOptions<T> {
  path: string; body: unknown; failureLabel: string;
  decode: (input: unknown) => T;
  fetcher?: typeof fetch; signal?: AbortSignal;
}
export async function httpRequest<T>({ path, body, failureLabel, decode, fetcher = fetch, signal }: HttpRequestOptions<T>): Promise<T> {
  const response = await fetcher(path, {
    method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify(body), signal,
  }).catch(() => { throw new Error(failureLabel); });
  const data: unknown = await response.json().catch(() => { throw new Error(failureLabel); });
  if (!response.ok) {
    const error = data && typeof data === "object" && "error" in data ? data.error : undefined;
    throw new HttpError(response.status, typeof error === "string" ? error : failureLabel);
  }
  return decode(data);
}
```

### File: `modules/lib/read-request-bytes.ts`

SHA-256: `6fdcd5def0fe9506a2bd4826eeed5767462ebeb245ef391d175f63a93c976661`

```typescript
/** Read a bounded stream, including requests without a Content-Length header. */
export async function readRequestBytes(request: Request, maxBytes: number): Promise<Uint8Array | null> {
  if (!request.body || Number(request.headers.get("content-length")) > maxBytes) return null;
  const reader = request.body.getReader(), chunks: Uint8Array[] = [];
  let length = 0;
  try {
    while (true) {
      const { value, done } = await reader.read();
      if (done) break;
      length += value.byteLength;
      if (length > maxBytes) { await reader.cancel(); return null; }
      chunks.push(value);
    }
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(length);
    let offset = 0;
    for (const chunk of chunks) { bytes.set(chunk, offset); offset += chunk.length; }
    return bytes;
  } finally { reader.releaseLock(); }
}
```

```typescript
import { readRequestBytes } from "./read-request-bytes";
import { requestPolicy } from "@platform/config/request";
export async function readJson(request: Request): Promise<Record<string, unknown> | null> {
  try {
    const bytes = await readRequestBytes(request, requestPolicy.maxJsonBytes);
    if (!bytes) return null;
    const value: unknown = JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(bytes));
    return value && typeof value === "object" && !Array.isArray(value) ? value as Record<string, unknown> : null;
  } catch { return null; }
}

export function sameOrigin(request: Request) {
  const origin = request.headers.get("origin");
  if (!origin) return true;
  try {
    const parsed = new URL(origin);
    const host = request.headers.get("host") ?? new URL(request.url).host;
    return (
      ["http:", "https:"].includes(parsed.protocol) && parsed.host === host
    );
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}
```

```typescript
import "server-only";
import { createClient } from "@supabase/supabase-js";
import type { Database } from "@platform/types/database";
import { supabaseEnvironment } from "./environment";
import { ApiError } from "@platform/lib/api/error";
/** Never exports the secret or shares a cookie-bound authenticated client. */
export function createAuthAdministrator() {
  const { url } = supabaseEnvironment();
  const key = process.env.SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY;
  if (!key) throw new ApiError(503, "SUPABASE_NOT_CONFIGURED");
  return createClient<Database>(url, key, { auth: { persistSession: false, autoRefreshToken: false } });
}
```

```typescript
export function supabaseEnvironment() {
  const url = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL;
  const key = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY;
  if (!url || !key) throw new Error("SUPABASE_NOT_CONFIGURED");
  return { url, key };
}
```

### File: `modules/lib/supabase/middleware.ts`

SHA-256: `050e755cb2aab9d1092cb437af616c4cf53369749e677b75d1a6671571c7cff3`

```typescript
import { createServerClient } from "@supabase/ssr";
import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { supabaseEnvironment } from "./environment";
import { routes } from "@platform/config/navigation";
export async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {
  if (!process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL || !process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY) return NextResponse.next();
  const { url, key } = supabaseEnvironment();
  let response = NextResponse.next({ request });
  const client = createServerClient(url, key, { cookies: {
    getAll: () => request.cookies.getAll(),
    setAll(values, headers) {
      values.forEach(({ name, value }) => request.cookies.set(name, value));
      response = NextResponse.next({ request });
      values.forEach(({ name, value, options }) => response.cookies.set(name, value, options));
      Object.entries(headers).forEach(([name, value]) => response.headers.set(name, value));
    },
  } });
  const { data, error } = await client.auth.getClaims();
  if (request.nextUrl.pathname.startsWith("/admin/") || request.nextUrl.pathname === routes.dashboard || request.nextUrl.pathname.startsWith(`${routes.dashboard}/`)) {
    if (error || !data?.claims) {
      const target = request.nextUrl.clone();
      target.pathname = routes.login;
      target.search = "";
      const denied = NextResponse.redirect(target);
      response.cookies.getAll().forEach(cookie => denied.cookies.set(cookie));
      denied.headers.set("Cache-Control", "private, no-store");
      return denied;
    }
  }
  response.headers.set("Cache-Control", "private, no-store");
  return response;
}
```

### File: `modules/lib/supabase/server.ts`

SHA-256: `ef3a18d0f0a3cca2f441086046339e65ba0005e64ef0bdbe66f5107ff8b31c10`

```typescript
import "server-only";
import type { Database } from "@platform/types/database";
import { supabaseEnvironment } from "./environment";
import { createServerClient } from '@supabase/ssr'
import { cookies } from 'next/headers'

/**
 * If using Fluid compute: Don't put this client in a global variable. Always create a new client within each
 * function when using it.
 */
export async function createDatabaseClient() {
  const cookieStore = await cookies()
  const { url, key } = supabaseEnvironment()

  return createServerClient<Database>(
    url,
    key,
    {
      cookies: {
        getAll() {
          return cookieStore.getAll()
        },
        setAll(cookiesToSet) {
          try {
            cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =>
              cookieStore.set(name, value, options)
            )
          } catch {
            // The `setAll` method was called from a Server Component.
            // This can be ignored if you have middleware refreshing
            // user sessions.
          }
        },
      },
    }
  )
}
```
