```css
  .lms-page-heading[data-actions-first] > .btn-primary { width: auto; }
}
.lms-course-editor-tabs a[aria-current="page"] { color: var(--text-accent-readable); border-color: var(--primary-red); background: var(--primary-red-subtle); }

.lms-course-editor-layout { grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1.5fr) minmax(0,1fr); gap: var(--space-lg); align-items: stretch; }
.lms-course-editor-layout > .lms-profile-card { max-width: none; min-width: 0; display: grid; gap: var(--space-md); align-content: start; }
.lms-course-editor-layout h2, .lms-curriculum h2 { font-size: var(--size-1_25rem); margin: 0; }
.lms-course-details { grid-row: span 2; }
.lms-curriculum { display: grid; gap: var(--space-lg); }
.lms-curriculum .lms-profile-card { max-width: none; min-width: 0; }
.lms-curriculum-heading, .lms-curriculum-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: var(--space-md); }
.lms-curriculum-heading > div, .lms-curriculum-row > div { min-width: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.lms-curriculum-heading .lms-admin-actions, .lms-curriculum-row .lms-admin-actions { margin: 0; }
.lms-curriculum-groups { display: grid; gap: var(--space-lg); margin-top: var(--space-lg); }
.lms-curriculum-group { border-top: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-subtle); padding-top: var(--space-lg); }
.lms-curriculum-lessons { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: var(--space-md) 0 0; display: grid; gap: var(--space-sm); }
.lms-curriculum-row { border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); padding: var(--space-md); }
.lms-curriculum-row small, .lms-curriculum-note { display: block; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: var(--font-size-caption); }
.lms-curriculum-dialog .lms-profile-form { gap: var(--space-md); }
@media (max-width: 1024px) { .lms-course-editor-layout { grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr); } .lms-course-details { grid-row: auto; } }
@media (max-width: 480px) { .lms-curriculum-heading, .lms-curriculum-row { align-items: stretch; } .lms-curriculum-heading .lms-admin-actions, .lms-curriculum-row .lms-admin-actions { width: 100%; } }

.lms-course-price-field { display: grid; gap: var(--space-sm); min-width: 0; }
```

### File: `modules/styles/analytics.css`

SHA-256: `0c49c8087882256aeccf2d6052d291853da399266e3b12b98a4a8f23db730b3d`

```css
.analytics-overview { display: grid; gap: var(--space-xl); min-width: 0; }
.analytics-overview-header { display: flex; align-items: start; justify-content: space-between; gap: var(--space-lg); }
.analytics-overview-header p, .analytics-period-note { color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: var(--font-size-caption); margin: 0; }
.analytics-overview-header > div:last-child { display: grid; gap: var(--space-sm); justify-items: end; }
.analytics-overview-header .lms-secondary-button { min-height: var(--control-target-size); }
.analytics-metrics-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: var(--space-md); }
.analytics-primary-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 2fr) minmax(0, 1fr); gap: var(--space-lg); }
.analytics-secondary-grid, .analytics-revenue-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: var(--space-lg); }
.analytics-metric { padding: var(--space-lg); min-width: 0; border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: var(--radius-md); background: var(--bg-surface); }
.analytics-metric h2 { margin: 0; color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: var(--font-size-body); font-weight: var(--font-weight-label); }
.analytics-value { display: block; font-size: var(--size-2rem); margin-block: var(--space-md); color: var(--text-primary); line-height: var(--analytics-number-leading); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.analytics-metric > p { margin: var(--space-sm) 0; font-size: var(--font-size-caption); color: var(--text-secondary); }
.analytics-change { display: inline-flex; gap: var(--space-xs); font-size: var(--font-size-caption); color: var(--text-secondary); }
.analytics-change[data-direction="up"], .analytics-change[data-direction="new"] { color: var(--text-primary); }
.analytics-change[data-direction="down"] { color: var(--text-accent-readable); }
.analytics-unavailable { color: var(--text-secondary); }
.analytics-chart-controls { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: var(--space-md); border: 0; padding: 0; margin: 0; min-width: 0; }
.analytics-chart-controls legend { margin-bottom: var(--space-sm); font-size: var(--font-size-caption); color: var(--text-secondary); }
.analytics-legend { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: var(--space-md); color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: var(--font-size-caption); }
.analytics-legend span { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-sm); }
.analytics-legend span::before { content: ''; width: var(--space-md); border-top: var(--size-2px) solid var(--analytics-chart-current); }
.analytics-legend [data-series="previous"]::before { border-color: var(--analytics-chart-previous); border-top-style: dashed; }
.analytics-empty-note { color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: var(--font-size-caption); padding-block: var(--space-md); }
.analytics-periods { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: var(--space-xs); margin-bottom: var(--space-md); border-bottom: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-subtle); }
.analytics-periods a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: var(--control-target-size); padding-inline: var(--space-md); border-bottom: var(--size-2px) solid transparent; color: var(--text-secondary); transition: color var(--transition-fast), border-color var(--transition-fast); }
.analytics-periods a[aria-current], .analytics-periods a:hover { color: var(--text-primary); border-color: var(--primary-red); }
.analytics-course-ranking, .analytics-sources-list { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
.analytics-course-ranking > li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: start; gap: var(--space-md); padding-block: var(--space-md); border-bottom: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-subtle); }
.analytics-course-ranking > li:last-child { border: 0; }
.analytics-rank { color: var(--text-secondary); font-weight: var(--font-weight-action); }
.analytics-course-ranking > li:first-child .analytics-rank { color: var(--text-accent-readable); }
.analytics-course-ranking a { color: var(--text-primary); transition: color var(--transition-fast); }
.analytics-course-ranking a:hover { color: var(--text-accent-readable); }
.analytics-course-ranking small { display: block; font-size: var(--font-size-caption); color: var(--text-secondary); font-weight: var(--font-weight-body); }
.analytics-course-ranking strong { text-align: end; }
.analytics-rank-bar { margin-block: var(--space-sm); }
.analytics-overview progress { display: block; width: 100%; height: var(--space-xs); border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-full); background: var(--border-subtle); color: var(--primary-red); overflow: hidden; appearance: none; }
.analytics-overview progress::-webkit-progress-bar { background: var(--border-subtle); }
.analytics-overview progress::-webkit-progress-value { background: var(--primary-red); }
.analytics-overview progress::-moz-progress-bar { background: var(--primary-red); }
.analytics-sources-list > li { padding-block: var(--space-sm); }
.analytics-sources-list > li > div { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: var(--space-md); margin-bottom: var(--space-sm); }
.analytics-sources-list small { color: var(--text-secondary); }
.analytics-learning { display: grid; gap: var(--space-lg); margin: 0; }
.analytics-learning > div { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: var(--space-md); border-bottom: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-subtle); padding-bottom: var(--space-md); }
.analytics-learning dd { margin: 0; font-size: var(--size-2rem); font-weight: var(--font-weight-action); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.analytics-learning dt { color: var(--text-secondary); }
.analytics-definitions, .analytics-data-table { font-size: var(--font-size-caption); color: var(--text-secondary); }
.analytics-definitions summary, .analytics-data-table summary { min-height: var(--control-target-size); padding-block: var(--space-sm); }
.analytics-table-scroll { overflow-x: auto; }
.analytics-data-table table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; text-align: start; }
.analytics-data-table th, .analytics-data-table td { padding: var(--space-sm); border-bottom: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-subtle); text-align: start; }
.analytics-overview :focus-visible { outline: var(--size-2px) solid var(--text-primary); outline-offset: var(--space-xs); }
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  .analytics-metrics-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
  .analytics-primary-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
}
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .analytics-overview-header { flex-direction: column; }
  .analytics-overview-header > div:last-child { justify-items: start; }
  .analytics-secondary-grid, .analytics-revenue-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
}
@media (max-width: 480px) {
  .analytics-metrics-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
  .analytics-metric, .analytics-panel-heading, .analytics-panel-body { padding: var(--space-md); }
  .analytics-panel-body { padding-top: 0; }
  .analytics-course-ranking > li { gap: var(--space-sm); }
}
.analytics-loading { display: grid; gap: var(--space-lg); color: var(--text-secondary); }
.analytics-skeleton { min-height: var(--space-5xl); background: var(--bg-surface); border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: var(--radius-md); }
.analytics-skeleton-chart { min-height: var(--analytics-chart-height); }
.analytics-error { display: grid; gap: var(--space-lg); justify-items: start; }

/* A single focal chart and quieter supporting figures preserve the platform identity. */
.analytics-chart-toolbar { display: flex; align-items: start; justify-content: space-between; gap: var(--space-lg); margin-bottom: var(--space-lg); }
.analytics-chart-summary { display: grid; gap: var(--space-xs); }
.analytics-chart-summary > span:first-child { color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: var(--font-size-caption); }
.analytics-chart-summary > strong { font-size: var(--size-2rem); line-height: var(--analytics-number-leading); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.analytics-chart-controls { justify-content: end; }
.analytics-legend { margin-bottom: var(--space-md); }
.analytics-revenue-grid .analytics-metric { background: transparent; }
.analytics-revenue-grid .analytics-value { display: none; }
.analytics-revenue-grid .analytics-unavailable { display: inline-block; margin-top: var(--space-sm); font-size: var(--font-size-caption); }
.analytics-definitions { padding-top: var(--space-md); border-top: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-subtle); }
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .analytics-chart-toolbar { flex-direction: column; }
  .analytics-chart-controls { justify-content: start; }
}
```

### File: `modules/styles/auth.css`

SHA-256: `ca3bc5d0b22173c825cd9a54e41d242cfb6fc209011df77ea0a6d77d81181dca`

```css
.lms-form-field { display: grid; gap: var(--space-control); min-width: 0; }
.lms-field-input-wrap { position: relative; min-width: 0; }
.lms-field-input-wrap[data-has-control] input { padding-inline-end: var(--size-80px); }
.lms-password-toggle {
  position: absolute; inset-inline-end: var(--space-control); top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%);
  border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--text-secondary); font: inherit;
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption); cursor: pointer; padding: var(--space-unit);
  transition: color var(--motion-duration-control) var(--motion-easing);
}
.lms-password-toggle:hover, .lms-password-toggle:focus-visible { color: var(--primary-red); }
.lms-password-toggle:disabled { cursor: default; }
.lms-field-hint { color: var(--text-muted); font-size: var(--font-size-caption); }
.lms-auth-card .lms-error { color: var(--color-ffb3aa); margin: 0; }
.lms-auth-form input[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: var(--primary-red); }
.lms-auth-form .btn-primary { justify-self: stretch; }
.lms-auth-alternate {
  display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center; gap: var(--space-control);
  margin-top: var(--space-lg); font-size: var(--font-size-caption); color: var(--text-secondary);
}
.lms-auth-alternate a { color: var(--primary-red); transition: color var(--motion-duration-control) var(--motion-easing); }
.lms-auth-alternate a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
.lms-auth-status { color: var(--text-muted); font-size: var(--font-size-caption); }
```

### File: `modules/styles/lms.css`

SHA-256: `05a37de50cd4251eb20991a3821a43144bedc7dc17e92867a089708d54bb065c`

```css
.lms-icon {
  width: var(--size-20px);
  height: var(--size-20px);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

  display: flex;
  gap: var(--size-10px);
  align-items: center;
  font-size: var(--lms-size-1_7rem);

  line-height: var(--leading-headline);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

  color: var(--primary-red);
  font-size: var(--lms-size-1_4rem);

}

  display: block;
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  font-weight: var(--weight-medium);

  color: var(--text-muted);
  margin-top: var(--size-5px);
  direction: ltr;
}
.lms-site-header .site-navbar {
  top: 0;
  padding: var(--space-comfortable) 0;
  background: var(--color-rgba-16-19-23-0-92);
}
.lms-navbar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: var(--space-lg);
}
.lms-marketing-links {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--size-30px);
  font-size: var(--size-0_9rem);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}

.lms-marketing-links a[aria-current] {
  color: var(--primary-red);
}
.lms-nav-actions {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--size-22px);
}
.lms-nav-button {
  font-size: var(--font-size-control);
  padding: var(--size-10px) var(--space-comfortable) !important;
  min-height: var(--size-44px);
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.lms-text-link {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-unit);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-size: var(--size-0_9rem);
  font-weight: var(--weight-semibold);
}
.lms-text-link:hover {
  color: var(--primary-red);
}
.lms-mobile-toggle {
  display: none;

  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
}
.lms-landing-hero {
  padding-top: var(--space-3xl);
  padding-bottom: var(--space-3xl);
}
.lms-landing-hero .hero-inner-content {
  max-width: var(--size-1050px);
}
.lms-landing-hero .hero-headline {
  max-width: var(--size-980px);

  margin-right: auto;
  font-size: clamp(var(--size-2rem), var(--size-4_2vw), var(--size-3_8rem));
  line-height: var(--leading-control);
}
.lms-landing-hero .highlight-editors {

}
.lms-hero-actions {

}
.lms-secondary-button {
  display: inline-flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--size-10px);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-subtle);
  background: var(--bg-surface-soft);
  padding: var(--space-control) var(--size-20px);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  font-size: var(--size-0_95rem);

  transition:
    background var(--transition-fast),

}
.lms-secondary-button:active {

}
button:disabled {
  opacity: 0.6;
  cursor: wait !important;
}
.lms-hero-preview {
  max-width: var(--inner-corridor-width);
  margin: var(--size-40px) auto 0;
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  overflow: hidden;
  text-align: right;
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  box-shadow: 0 var(--size-22px) var(--size-60px) var(--color-rgba-0-0-0-0-25);
}
.lms-preview-titlebar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-unit);
  padding: var(--space-control) var(--size-20px);
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  background: var(--bg-surface-elevated);

}
.lms-preview-dots {

}
.lms-preview-body {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1.3fr 1fr;
}
.lms-preview-lessons {
  padding: var(--space-lg);
  border-right: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
}
.lms-small-label {
  display: block;
  color: var(--text-accent-readable);
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  font-weight: var(--weight-semibold);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-unit);
}
.lms-preview-lessons h2 {
  font-size: var(--lms-size-1_4rem);
  line-height: var(--leading-relaxed);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-md);
}
.lms-preview-lesson {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--size-10px);
  padding: var(--space-control) 0;
  border-top: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  font-size: var(--font-size-body);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}
.lms-preview-lesson .lms-icon {
  margin-right: auto;

  height: var(--space-md);

}

  place-items: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;

}

  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-unit);
  margin-top: var(--space-comfortable);
  color: var(--text-accent-readable);
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  font-weight: var(--weight-semibold);
}
.lms-skill-strip {
  border-top: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  border-bottom: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  padding: var(--space-lg) 0;
}
.lms-skill-strip .container {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-lg);
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.lms-skill-strip span {
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  color: var(--text-muted);
}
.lms-skill-strip b {
  font-size: var(--size-1_1rem);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-weight: var(--weight-medium);
  direction: ltr;
}
.lms-section-top {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-xl);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-xl);
}
.lms-section-top .body-large {
  max-width: var(--size-54ch);
}
.lms-course-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: var(--space-lg);
}
.lms-course-card {
  min-width: 0;
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  overflow: hidden;
  transition:
    transform var(--transition-smooth),
    border-color var(--transition-smooth),
    box-shadow var(--transition-smooth);
}
.lms-course-card:hover {
  border-color: var(--primary-red-border);
}
.lms-course-art {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: linear-gradient(
    var(--size-135deg),
    var(--bg-surface-elevated),
    var(--bg-main)
  );
  aspect-ratio: 16/10;
  border-bottom: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: space-between;
}
.lms-course-art svg {
  width: 100%;
  height: auto;
  min-height: 0;
  flex: 1;
}
.lms-art-top,
.lms-art-bottom {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: var(--space-unit);
  padding: var(--space-control) var(--space-md);
  position: relative;
  z-index: var(--layer-content);
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  color: var(--text-muted);
}
.lms-art-top > span:last-child {
  padding: var(--space-xs) var(--space-unit);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  direction: ltr;
}
.lms-art-logo {
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-weight: var(--weight-bold);
  letter-spacing: var(--lms-size-0_12em);
}
.lms-art-bottom {
  border-top: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
}
.lms-art-large {
  aspect-ratio: 16/10;
}
.lms-hero-preview .lms-art-large {
  aspect-ratio: auto;
  border-bottom: 0;
}
.lms-course-card-body {
  padding: var(--size-22px);
}
.lms-card-meta {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--space-md);
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  margin: var(--space-comfortable) 0;
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  color: var(--text-muted);
}
.lms-card-meta > span {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--size-5px);
  align-items: center;
}
.lms-card-meta .lms-icon {
  width: var(--space-heading-tight);
  height: var(--space-heading-tight);
}
.lms-benefits-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: var(--space-3xl);
  align-items: center;
}
.lms-benefit-list > div {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--space-comfortable);
  padding: var(--space-lg) 0;
  border-bottom: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
}
.lms-benefit-list > div:last-child {
  border-bottom: 0;
}
.lms-benefit-list > div > .lms-icon {
  width: var(--size-44px);
  height: var(--size-44px);
  padding: var(--size-10px);
  background: var(--primary-red-subtle);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--primary-red-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  color: var(--primary-red);
}
.lms-benefit-list h3 {
  font-size: var(--size-1_05rem);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-unit);
}
.lms-benefit-list p {
  font-size: var(--size-0_9rem);
  color: var(--text-muted);
}
.lms-footer {
  background: var(--color-0b0e11);
  padding: var(--size-40px) 0 var(--space-lg);
  border-top: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
}
.lms-footer-grid {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: var(--space-xl);
  align-items: center;
}
.lms-footer-grid p {
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  margin-top: var(--space-comfortable);
  max-width: var(--measure-footer-copy);
}
.lms-footer-links {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--size-20px);
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
}
.lms-footer-links a:hover {
  color: var(--primary-red);
}
.lms-footer-bottom {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: var(--space-md);
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  margin-top: var(--space-xl);
  padding-top: var(--size-20px);
  border-top: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
}
.lms-public-main {
  padding-top: var(--space-2xl);
  padding-bottom: var(--size-80px);
  min-height: var(--lms-size-70vh);
}
.lms-page-heading {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: var(--space-lg);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-xl);
}
.lms-page-heading :is(h1, h2) {
  font-size: clamp(
    var(--lms-size-1_7rem),
    var(--lms-size-3vw),
    var(--lms-size-2_5rem)
  );
  line-height: var(--leading-normal);
  margin-bottom: var(--size-10px);
}
.lms-page-heading p {
  color: var(--text-muted);
  max-width: var(--lms-size-64ch);
}
.lms-catalog-controls {
  margin-bottom: var(--size-20px);
}
.lms-search {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-control);
  max-width: var(--lms-size-560px);
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  padding: var(--size-6px) var(--space-heading-tight);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-lg);
}
.lms-search > .lms-icon {
  color: var(--text-muted);
}
.lms-search input {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
  border: 0;
  background: none;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: var(--font-size-control);
  padding: var(--size-10px) 0;
  outline: 0;
}
.lms-search:focus-within {
  border-color: var(--primary-red);
}
.lms-search button {
  background: var(--primary-red);
  padding: var(--space-unit) var(--space-md);
  font-weight: var(--weight-semibold);
  font-size: var(--font-size-control);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
}
.lms-filter-tabs {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--space-unit);
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.lms-filter-tabs > a {
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  padding: var(--space-unit) var(--space-md);
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}
.lms-filter-tabs > a:hover,
.lms-filter-tabs > .is-active {
  background: var(--primary-red-subtle);
  border-color: var(--primary-red-border);
  color: var(--primary-red);
}
.lms-results-meta {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: var(--space-md);
  margin: var(--space-lg) 0;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
}
.lms-empty {
  text-align: center;
  padding: var(--space-3xl) var(--space-lg);
  border: var(--size-1px) dashed var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  background: var(--bg-surface-soft);
}
.lms-empty > .lms-icon {
  width: var(--space-2xl);
  height: var(--space-2xl);
  margin: 0 auto var(--size-20px);
  color: var(--primary-red);
}
.lms-empty h2 {
  font-size: var(--lms-size-1_3rem);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-control);
}
.lms-empty p {
  color: var(--text-muted);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-lg);
}
.lms-breadcrumb {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-control);
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  color: var(--text-muted);
  margin-bottom: var(--size-28px);
}
.lms-breadcrumb a:hover {
  color: var(--primary-red);
}
.lms-course-detail {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) var(--size-360px);
  gap: var(--space-2xl);
  align-items: start;
}
.lms-course-title {
  font-size: clamp(var(--size-2rem), var(--size-3_5vw), var(--size-2_75rem));
  line-height: var(--leading-normal);
  margin-bottom: var(--size-20px);
}
.lms-detail-meta {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--size-20px);
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  margin: var(--space-lg) 0;
}
.lms-detail-meta span {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--size-6px);
}
.lms-outcomes {
  margin: var(--space-xl) 0;
  padding: var(--space-lg);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
}
.lms-outcomes h2 {
  font-size: var(--size-1_2rem);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-comfortable);
}
.lms-outcomes ul,
.lms-enrollment-body ul,
.lms-takeaways {
  list-style: none;
  display: grid;
  gap: var(--space-heading-tight);
}
.lms-outcomes li,
.lms-enrollment-body li,
.lms-takeaways li {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--size-10px);
  font-size: var(--font-size-body);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}
.lms-outcomes .lms-icon,
.lms-enrollment-body li .lms-icon,
.lms-takeaways .lms-icon {
  color: var(--primary-red);
  width: var(--dimension-18);
  height: var(--dimension-18);
}
.lms-content-heading {
  margin-bottom: var(--space-lg);
}
.lms-content-heading h2 {
  font-size: var(--lms-size-1_4rem);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-unit);
}
.lms-content-heading p {
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-size: var(--size-0_9rem);
}
.lms-curriculum {
  display: grid;
  gap: var(--space-control);
}
.lms-curriculum details {
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  overflow: hidden;
}
.lms-curriculum summary {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-control);
  padding: var(--space-comfortable);
  cursor: pointer;
}
.lms-curriculum summary::after {
  content: "+";
  margin-right: auto;
  color: var(--primary-red);
  font-size: var(--lms-size-1_3rem);
}
.lms-curriculum details[open] summary::after {
  content: "−";
}
.lms-curriculum summary > span {
  color: var(--text-accent-readable);
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
}
.lms-curriculum summary b {
  font-size: var(--size-0_9rem);
}
.lms-curriculum summary small {
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
}
.lms-curriculum ul {
  list-style: none;
  border-top: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
}
.lms-curriculum li {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--size-10px);
  padding: var(--space-md) var(--space-comfortable);
  font-size: var(--font-size-body);
  border-bottom: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}
.lms-curriculum li:last-child {
  border-bottom: 0;
}
.lms-curriculum li > .lms-icon {
  width: var(--space-heading-tight);
  height: var(--space-heading-tight);
  color: var(--text-muted);
}
.lms-curriculum time {
  margin-right: auto;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  direction: ltr;
}
.lms-preview-link {
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  color: var(--text-accent-readable);
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.lms-enrollment-card {
  position: sticky;
  top: var(--size-110px);
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  overflow: hidden;
}
.lms-enrollment-body {
  padding: var(--space-lg);
}
.lms-enrollment-body h2 {
  font-size: var(--size-1_25rem);
  line-height: var(--leading-relaxed);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-lg);
}
.lms-enrollment-body ul {
  margin: var(--space-lg) 0;
}
.lms-enrollment-body li {
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
}
.lms-full-button {
  width: 100%;
  font-size: var(--font-size-action);
  padding: var(--space-heading-tight) !important;
}
.lms-demo-note {
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  color: var(--text-muted);
  line-height: var(--leading-spacious);
  padding-top: var(--space-md);
  border-top: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
}
.lms-app-header {
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  z-index: var(--layer-dashboard-header);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: var(--size-20px);
  min-height: var(--size-80px);
  padding: var(--space-md) var(--space-xl);
  background: var(--color-rgba-16-19-23-0-92);
  backdrop-filter: blur(var(--blur-navigation));
  border-bottom: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
}
.lms-app-header-actions {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-lg);
}
.lms-demo-label {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  padding: var(--size-3px) var(--size-10px);
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
}
.lms-avatar {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: var(--size-38px);
  height: var(--size-38px);
  background: var(--primary-red-subtle);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--primary-red-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  color: var(--primary-red);
  font-weight: var(--weight-bold);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.lms-app-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: var(--lms-size-248px) minmax(0, 1fr);
  max-width: var(--lms-size-1600px);
  margin: 0 auto;
}
.lms-sidebar {
  position: sticky;
  top: var(--size-80px);
  align-self: start;
  min-height: calc(var(--size-100vh) - var(--size-80px));
  padding: var(--size-28px) var(--space-comfortable);
  border-left: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  background: var(--bg-main);
}
.lms-sidebar-profile {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-control);
  padding: 0 var(--space-unit) var(--space-lg);
  border-bottom: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  margin-bottom: var(--size-20px);
}
.lms-sidebar-profile b {
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  display: block;
}
.lms-sidebar-profile small {
  display: block;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
}
.lms-sidebar nav {
  display: grid;
  gap: var(--size-6px);
}
.lms-sidebar nav a {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-control);
  padding: var(--space-control) var(--space-heading-tight);
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-size: var(--size-0_9rem);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid transparent;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
}
.lms-sidebar nav a:hover {
  color: var(--text-primary);
  background: var(--bg-surface-soft);
}
.lms-sidebar nav a.is-active {
  background: var(--primary-red-subtle);
  border-color: var(--primary-red-border);
  color: var(--primary-red);
}
.lms-sidebar-help {
  margin-top: var(--space-2xl);
  padding: var(--space-comfortable);
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
}
.lms-sidebar-help > .lms-icon {
  color: var(--primary-red);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-control);
}
.lms-sidebar-help b {
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
}
.lms-sidebar-help p {
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  color: var(--text-muted);
  margin: var(--space-unit) 0 var(--space-control);
}
.lms-sidebar-help a {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-unit);
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  color: var(--text-accent-readable);
}
.lms-sidebar-home {
  display: block;
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  color: var(--text-muted);
  padding: var(--space-lg) var(--space-unit);
}
.lms-app-main {
  padding: var(--size-40px);
  min-width: 0;
  min-height: calc(var(--size-100vh) - var(--size-80px));
}
.lms-app-main .lms-page-heading :is(h1, h2) {
  font-size: var(--size-2rem);
}
.lms-stat-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: var(--space-comfortable);
  margin-bottom: var(--size-28px);
}
.lms-stat-card {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-comfortable);
  padding: var(--space-lg);
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
}
.lms-stat-card > .lms-icon {
  color: var(--primary-red);
  width: var(--size-40px);
  height: var(--size-40px);
  background: var(--primary-red-subtle);
  padding: var(--size-9px);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
}
.lms-stat-card b {
  font-size: var(--lms-size-1_8rem);
  line-height: var(--leading-compact);
  display: block;
}
.lms-stat-card span {
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  color: var(--text-muted);
}
.lms-continue-card {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.2fr;
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--primary-red-border);
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  overflow: hidden;
}
.lms-continue-card > .lms-course-art {
  aspect-ratio: auto;
  border-bottom: 0;
  min-height: var(--lms-size-270px);
}
.lms-continue-card > div:last-child {
  padding: var(--size-28px);
}
.lms-continue-card h2 {
  font-size: var(--lms-size-1_5rem);
  line-height: var(--leading-normal);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-unit);
}
.lms-continue-card p {
  font-size: var(--font-size-body);
  color: var(--text-muted);
}
.lms-continue-card .btn-primary {
  font-size: var(--font-size-action);
  padding: var(--space-control) var(--size-20px);
  margin-top: var(--space-md);
}
.lms-progress {
  margin: var(--space-comfortable) 0 var(--space-unit);
}
.lms-progress-label {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-unit);
  color: var(--text-muted);
}
.lms-progress-label b {
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}
.lms-progress progress {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: var(--size-5px);
  appearance: none;
  border: none;
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  overflow: hidden;
  background: var(--bg-surface-elevated);
}
.lms-progress progress::-webkit-progress-bar {
  background: var(--bg-surface-elevated);
}
.lms-progress progress::-webkit-progress-value {
  background: var(--primary-red);
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
}
.lms-progress progress::-moz-progress-bar {
  background: var(--primary-red);
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
}
.lms-progress small {
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  margin-top: var(--space-unit);
  display: block;
}
.lms-dashboard-section {
  margin-top: var(--size-36px);
  margin-bottom: var(--size-20px);
}
.lms-dashboard-section h2 {
  font-size: var(--size-1_25rem);
}
.lms-dashboard-grid {
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
}
.lms-learn-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: var(--lms-size-320px) minmax(0, 1fr);
  max-width: var(--lms-size-1600px);
  margin: 0 auto;
}
.lms-lesson-outline {
  position: sticky;
  top: var(--size-80px);
  align-self: start;
  height: calc(var(--size-100vh) - var(--size-80px));
  overflow-y: auto;
  border-left: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  background: var(--bg-main);
}
.lms-outline-heading {
  padding: var(--space-lg);
  border-bottom: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
}
.lms-outline-heading h2 {
  font-size: var(--size-1_1rem);
  line-height: var(--leading-relaxed);
}
.lms-outline-module h3 {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--size-10px);
  padding: var(--size-22px) var(--size-20px) var(--space-control);
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}
.lms-outline-module h3 span {
  color: var(--primary-red);
}
.lms-outline-module a {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-control);
  padding: var(--space-heading-tight) var(--size-20px);
  border-right: var(--size-3px) solid transparent;
  font-size: var(--font-size-body);
  font-weight: var(--font-weight-label);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  line-height: var(--leading-relaxed);
}
.lms-outline-module a small {
  display: block;
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  font-weight: var(--font-weight-body);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  margin-top: var(--size-5px);
}
.lms-outline-module a.is-active {
  border-color: var(--primary-red);
  background: var(--primary-red-subtle);
  color: var(--text-primary);
}
.lms-outline-module a:hover {
  background: var(--bg-surface-soft);
}
.lms-outline-check {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: var(--size-26px);
  height: var(--size-26px);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
}
.lms-outline-check .lms-icon {
  width: var(--dimension-12);
  height: var(--dimension-12);
}
.lms-outline-check.is-complete {
  color: var(--accent-green);
  border-color: var(--accent-green-border);
  background: var(--accent-green-subtle);
}
.lms-lesson-main {
  padding: var(--space-xl);
  min-width: 0;
}
.lms-lesson-title {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: var(--space-comfortable);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-lg);
}
.lms-lesson-title h1 {
  font-size: var(--size-1_55rem);
  line-height: var(--leading-relaxed);
}
.lms-lesson-duration {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--space-unit);
  align-items: center;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
}
.lms-lesson-player {
  aspect-ratio: 16/9;
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  overflow: hidden;
  background: var(--bg-surface);
}
.lms-lesson-player iframe,
.lms-player-button {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  border: 0;
  display: block;
}
.lms-player-button {
  position: relative;
  text-align: center;
}
.lms-player-button .lms-course-art {
  height: 100%;
  aspect-ratio: auto;
}
.lms-player-button .lms-course-art > svg {
  opacity: 0.4;
}
.lms-player-overlay {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--space-heading-tight);
  background: var(--color-rgba-16-20-26-0-7);
}
.lms-player-overlay .video-play-button {
  margin: 0;
  width: var(--size-68px);
  height: var(--size-68px);
}
.lms-player-overlay small {
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  color: var(--text-muted);
  max-width: 90%;
}
.lms-player-overlay > span:not(.video-play-button) {
  font-size: var(--size-1_05rem);
  font-weight: var(--weight-semibold);
  max-width: 90%;
}
.lms-lesson-actions {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-comfortable);
  padding: var(--space-lg) 0;
  border-bottom: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-xl);
}
.lms-lesson-actions .btn-primary {
  font-size: var(--font-size-action);
  padding: var(--space-control) var(--size-20px);
}
.lms-is-complete {
  border-color: var(--accent-green-border);
  color: var(--accent-green);
  background: var(--accent-green-subtle);
}
.lms-lesson-information {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1.1fr 1fr;
  gap: var(--space-xl);
}
.lms-lesson-information h2 {
  font-size: var(--size-1_1rem);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-heading-tight);
}
.lms-lesson-information p {
  font-size: var(--font-size-body);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-comfortable);
}
.lms-takeaways {
  margin-bottom: var(--space-xl);
}
.lms-takeaways li {
  font-size: var(--font-size-body);
}
.lms-resource-link {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-control);
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  padding: var(--space-heading-tight);
  margin-bottom: var(--size-10px);
  font-size: var(--font-size-body);
}
.lms-resource-link > span {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
}
.lms-resource-link small {
  display: block;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  margin-top: var(--space-xs);
}
.lms-resource-link > .lms-icon:last-child {
  color: var(--primary-red);
}
.lms-notes {
  padding: var(--size-22px);
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  align-self: start;
}
.lms-notes label {
  font-weight: var(--weight-semibold);
  display: block;
  margin-bottom: var(--space-heading-tight);
}
.lms-notes textarea,
.lms-profile-form input,
.lms-profile-form textarea,
.lms-profile-form select {
  display: block;
  resize: vertical;
  width: 100%;
  font-family: inherit;
  background: var(--bg-main);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  padding: var(--space-control);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-size: var(--font-size-control);
  line-height: var(--leading-spacious);
}
.lms-notes small {
  display: block;
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  margin-top: var(--space-control);
}
.lms-resource-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: var(--size-20px);
}
.lms-resource-card {
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: var(--space-lg);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: flex-start;
}
.lms-resource-symbol {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: var(--space-2xl);
  height: var(--space-2xl);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--primary-red-border);
  background: var(--primary-red-subtle);
  color: var(--primary-red);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-lg);
}
.lms-resource-card > small {
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
}
.lms-resource-card h2 {
  font-size: var(--size-1_1rem);
  line-height: var(--leading-normal);
  margin: var(--size-10px) 0;
}
.lms-resource-card p {
  font-size: var(--font-size-body);
  color: var(--text-muted);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-lg);
  flex: 1;
}
.lms-resource-card .lms-secondary-button {
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  align-self: stretch;
}
.lms-profile-card {
  max-width: var(--lms-size-640px);
  padding: var(--space-xl);
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
}
.lms-profile-card-heading {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-comfortable);
  padding-bottom: var(--space-lg);
  border-bottom: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-lg);
}
.lms-profile-card-heading h2 {
  font-size: var(--size-1_25rem);
  margin-bottom: var(--size-10px);
}
.lms-avatar-large {
  width: var(--size-60px);
  height: var(--size-60px);
  font-size: var(--lms-size-1_5rem);
}
.lms-profile-form {
  display: grid;
  gap: var(--size-10px);
}
.lms-profile-form label {
  font-size: var(--font-size-body);
  font-weight: var(--weight-semibold);
  margin-top: var(--space-unit);
}
.lms-profile-form .btn-primary {
  justify-self: start;
  margin-top: var(--space-md);
  font-size: var(--font-size-action);
  padding: var(--space-control) var(--space-lg);
}
.lms-profile-card > .lms-demo-note {
  margin-top: var(--size-28px);
}
.lms-error {
  color: var(--color-ffb3aa);
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  margin-top: var(--size-10px);
}
.lms-success {
  color: var(--accent-green);
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
}
.lms-login-page {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: var(--size-80px);
  align-items: center;
  padding-top: var(--size-80px);
  padding-bottom: var(--space-4xl);
  min-height: var(--lms-size-80vh);
}
.lms-login-message h1 {
  font-size: clamp(var(--size-2rem), var(--size-4vw), var(--lms-size-3_4rem));
  line-height: var(--leading-normal);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-lg);
}
.lms-login-steps {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: var(--space-md);
  margin-top: var(--space-xl);
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
}
.lms-login-card {
  padding: var(--size-40px);
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
}
.lms-login-card h2 {
  font-size: var(--lms-size-1_5rem);
  line-height: var(--leading-normal);
  margin: var(--space-comfortable) 0 var(--space-control);
}
.lms-login-card p {
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  color: var(--text-muted);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-lg);
}
.lms-login-card > small {
  display: block;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  margin-top: var(--size-20px);
}
.lms-login-card .btn-primary {
  width: 100%;
}
.lms-certificate {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  flex-direction: column;
  text-align: center;
  gap: var(--space-md);
  padding: var(--space-xl);
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--primary-red-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
}
.lms-certificate > .lms-icon {
  width: var(--space-2xl);
  height: var(--space-2xl);
  color: var(--primary-red);
}
.lms-certificate h2 {
  font-size: var(--size-1_25rem);
}
.lms-certificate h3 {
  font-size: var(--size-1rem);
  line-height: var(--leading-normal);
}
.lms-certificate small {
  color: var(--text-muted);
}
.lms-not-found {
  display: flex;
  min-height: var(--lms-size-90vh);
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: var(--space-lg);
  text-align: center;
}
.lms-not-found h1 {
  font-size: var(--size-2rem);
  line-height: var(--leading-normal);
}
.lms-not-found p {
  color: var(--text-muted);
}
.lms-loading {
  padding-top: var(--space-3xl);
  padding-bottom: var(--space-3xl);
  min-height: var(--lms-size-70vh);
}
.lms-skeleton {
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  animation: lmsSkeleton var(--lms-size-1_6s) ease-in-out infinite alternate;
}
.lms-skeleton-heading {
  width: 50%;
  height: var(--lms-size-70px);
  margin-bottom: var(--size-40px);
}
.lms-skeleton-card {
  height: var(--size-360px);
}
@keyframes lmsSkeleton {
  from {
    opacity: 0.45;
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
  }
}
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  .lms-marketing-links {
    opacity: 0;
    visibility: hidden;
    pointer-events: none;
    transform: translateY(calc(-1 * var(--space-unit)));
    transition:
      opacity var(--transition-smooth),
      transform var(--transition-smooth),
      visibility var(--motion-duration-instant) linear var(--motion-duration-surface);
  }
  .lms-mobile-toggle {
    display: inline-flex;
  }
  .lms-marketing-links {
    display: flex;
    position: absolute;
    top: 100%;
    right: 0;
    left: 0;
    padding: var(--size-20px) var(--space-lg);
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: stretch;
    background: var(--bg-main);
    border-bottom: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-subtle);
    gap: var(--space-heading-tight);
  }
  .lms-marketing-links.is-open {
    opacity: 1;
    visibility: visible;
    pointer-events: auto;
    transform: none;
    transition-delay: var(--motion-duration-instant);
  }
  .lms-marketing-links a {
    padding: var(--space-unit) 0;
  }
  .lms-course-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }
  .lms-course-detail {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) var(--lms-size-320px);
    gap: var(--size-28px);
  }
  .lms-app-grid {
    grid-template-columns: var(--lms-size-210px) minmax(0, 1fr);
  }
  .lms-app-main {
    padding: var(--size-28px);
  }
  .lms-app-header {
    padding: var(--space-md) var(--space-lg);
  }
  .lms-stat-card {
    padding: var(--space-comfortable);
    gap: var(--space-control);
  }
  .lms-stat-card > .lms-icon {
    width: var(--space-xl);
    height: var(--space-xl);
    padding: var(--size-7px);
  }
  .lms-continue-card {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
  .lms-continue-card > .lms-course-art {
    display: none;
  }
  .lms-resource-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }
  .lms-learn-grid {
    grid-template-columns: var(--lms-size-280px) minmax(0, 1fr);
  }
  .lms-lesson-information {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
  .lms-lesson-main {
    padding: var(--space-lg);
  }
  .lms-login-page {
    gap: var(--size-40px);
  }
  .lms-skill-strip .container {
    justify-content: center;
  }
  .lms-skill-strip .container > span {
    width: 100%;
    text-align: center;
  }
}
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .lms-site-header .site-navbar {
    padding: var(--space-control) 0;
  }
  .lms-navbar {
    gap: var(--space-control);
  }
  .lms-nav-actions {
    gap: var(--space-control);
  }
  .lms-nav-actions > .lms-text-link {
    min-height: var(--control-target-size);
    white-space: nowrap;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  .lms-nav-button {
    padding: var(--space-unit) var(--space-control) !important;
    font-size: var(--font-size-control);
  }
  .lms-brand {
    font-size: var(--size-1_45rem);
  }
  .lms-brand-mark {
    font-size: var(--size-1_2rem);
  }
  .lms-brand small {
    font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  }
  .lms-landing-hero {
    padding-top: var(--size-40px);
    padding-bottom: var(--size-40px);
  }
  .lms-landing-hero .hero-headline {
    font-size: clamp(
      var(--lms-size-1_8rem),
      var(--size-5vw),
      var(--size-2_75rem)
    );
  }
  .lms-landing-hero .hero-support-text {
    font-size: var(--size-0_95rem);
  }
  .lms-hero-actions {
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: stretch;
    margin: var(--space-lg) auto var(--space-md);
    max-width: var(--size-360px);
    gap: var(--space-control);
  }
  .lms-hero-actions .btn-primary {
    font-size: var(--font-size-action);
  }
  .lms-hero-preview {
    margin-top: var(--space-xl);
  }
  .lms-preview-body {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
  .lms-preview-body > .lms-course-art {
    aspect-ratio: 16/9;
  }
  .lms-preview-lessons {
    border-right: 0;
    border-top: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
    padding: var(--size-20px);
  }
  .lms-preview-lessons h2 {
    font-size: var(--size-1_25rem);
  }
  .lms-preview-lessons h2 br {
    display: none;
  }
  .lms-section-top {
    align-items: flex-start;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: var(--space-md);
  }
  .lms-course-grid {
    gap: var(--space-comfortable);
  }
  .lms-benefits-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: var(--space-lg);
  }
  .lms-footer-grid {
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: flex-start;
  }
  .lms-footer-links {
    gap: var(--space-md);
  }
  .lms-course-detail {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: var(--space-xl);
  }
  .lms-enrollment-card {
    position: static;
    order: -1;
  }
  .lms-enrollment-card > .lms-course-art {
    display: none;
  }
  .lms-enrollment-body {
    padding: var(--size-20px);
  }
  .lms-enrollment-body ul {
    display: none;
  }
  .lms-enrollment-body h2 {
    font-size: var(--size-1_1rem);
    margin-bottom: var(--space-md);
  }
  .lms-enrollment-body .lms-demo-note {
    margin-top: var(--space-md);
  }
  .lms-public-main {
    padding-top: var(--space-xl);
    padding-bottom: var(--space-2xl);
  }
  .lms-page-heading {
    margin-bottom: var(--space-lg);
  }
  .lms-results-meta {
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  }
  .lms-app-header {
    padding: var(--space-control) var(--space-md);
    min-height: var(--size-72px);
  }
  .lms-app-header-actions {
    gap: var(--space-control);
  }
  .lms-app-header-actions > .lms-text-link {
    display: none;
  }
  .lms-app-grid,
  .lms-learn-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
  .lms-sidebar {
    display: none;
  }
  .lms-sidebar.is-open {
    display: block;
    position: fixed;
    inset: var(--size-72px) 0 0;
    z-index: var(--layer-sidebar);
    overflow: auto;
    min-height: 0;
  }
  .lms-app-main {
    padding: var(--size-28px) var(--space-md);
  }
  .lms-stat-grid {
    gap: var(--size-10px);
  }
  .lms-stat-card {
    padding: var(--space-md) var(--space-control);
    gap: var(--space-unit);
    align-items: flex-start;
    flex-direction: column;
  }
  .lms-stat-card span {
    font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  }
  .lms-stat-card b {
    font-size: var(--lms-size-1_5rem);
  }
  .lms-continue-card > div:last-child {
    padding: var(--size-22px);
  }
  .lms-continue-card h2 {
    font-size: var(--lms-size-1_3rem);
  }
  .lms-resource-grid {
    gap: var(--space-md);
  }
  .lms-resource-card {
    padding: var(--size-20px);
  }
  .lms-lesson-outline {
    position: static;
    height: auto;
    order: 2;
    border-left: 0;
    border-top: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  }
  .lms-lesson-main {
    padding: var(--space-lg) var(--space-md);
  }
  .lms-lesson-title {
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: var(--size-10px);
  }
  .lms-lesson-title h1 {
    font-size: var(--lms-size-1_3rem);
  }
  .lms-lesson-duration {
    font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  }
  .lms-lesson-actions {
    gap: var(--space-control);
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }
  .lms-lesson-information {
    gap: var(--space-lg);
  }
  .lms-player-overlay .video-play-button {
    width: var(--size-50px);
    height: var(--size-50px);
  }
  .lms-player-overlay > span:not(.video-play-button) {
    font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  }
  .lms-player-overlay small {
    font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  }
  .lms-player-overlay {
    gap: var(--size-10px);
  }
  .lms-login-page {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: var(--space-xl);
    padding-top: var(--size-40px);
    padding-bottom: var(--space-2xl);
  }
  .lms-login-message h1 {
    font-size: var(--size-2rem);
  }
  .lms-login-card {
    padding: var(--size-28px);
  }
  .lms-profile-card {
    padding: var(--space-lg);
  }
  .lms-not-found h1 {
    font-size: var(--lms-size-1_5rem);
  }
}
@media (max-width: 480px) {
  .lms-course-grid,
  .lms-resource-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
  .lms-course-card-body {
    padding: var(--size-20px);
  }
  .lms-filter-tabs > a {
    padding: var(--size-7px) var(--size-10px);
    font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  }
  .lms-app-header .lms-demo-label {
    display: none;
  }
  .lms-search {
    padding: var(--size-6px) var(--size-10px);
    gap: var(--space-unit);
  }
  .lms-search input {
    font-size: var(--font-size-control);
  }
  .lms-search button {
    padding: var(--space-unit) var(--space-control);
  }
  .lms-preview-titlebar {
    font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
    padding: var(--size-10px) var(--space-control);
  }
  .lms-skill-strip b {
    font-size: var(--size-0_9rem);
  }
  .lms-skill-strip .container {
    gap: var(--space-heading-tight);
  }
  .lms-curriculum li {
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }
  .lms-curriculum li > span {
    flex: 1;
  }
  .lms-curriculum summary {
    gap: var(--space-unit);
    padding: var(--space-md) var(--space-control);
  }
  .lms-curriculum summary b {
    font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  }
  .lms-curriculum summary small {
    font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  }
  .lms-detail-meta {
    gap: var(--space-heading-tight);
  }
  .lms-course-title {
    font-size: var(--lms-size-1_7rem);
  }
  .lms-lesson-title {
    flex-direction: column;
  }
  .lms-player-overlay small {
    display: none;
  }
  .lms-stat-card {
    padding: var(--space-control) var(--size-10px);
  }
  .lms-stat-card span {
    font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  }
  .lms-page-heading :is(h1, h2),
  .lms-app-main .lms-page-heading :is(h1, h2) {
    font-size: var(--size-1_6rem);
  }
  .lms-footer-bottom {
    flex-direction: column;
  }
  .lms-hero-actions .btn-primary {
    padding: var(--space-heading-tight) var(--space-comfortable) !important;
  }
  .lms-brand {
    gap: var(--size-6px);
  }
  .lms-nav-button > .lms-icon {
    display: none;
  }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .lms-skeleton {
    animation: none;
  }
  .lms-course-card:hover,
  .lms-secondary-button:hover {
    transform: none;
  }
}

/* Course cards: title → clean cover → information right / price left → action. */
.lms-course-card {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  border-top: var(--size-3px) solid var(--primary-red);
}
.lms-course-card:focus-within {
  border-color: var(--primary-red);
}
.lms-course-card > a .lms-course-art {
  aspect-ratio: 16/7;
}
.lms-course-card-body {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  flex: 1;
}
.lms-card-title a {
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: color var(--transition-smooth);
}
.lms-card-title a:hover,
.lms-card-title a:focus-visible {
  color: var(--primary-red);
  text-decoration: none;
}
.lms-course-price {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: var(--space-unit);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-md);
}
.lms-course-price > div {
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.lms-price-label {
  display: block;
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}
.lms-course-price strong {
  display: block;
  font-size: var(--size-2rem);
  line-height: var(--leading-control);
  color: var(--text-primary);
}
.lms-course-price strong small {
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  font-weight: var(--weight-medium);
}
.lms-price-caption {
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  text-align: end;
  max-width: 50%;
}
.lms-card-action {
  font-size: var(--font-size-action);
  min-height: var(--size-50px);
}
#course-enrollment {
  scroll-margin-top: var(--size-110px);
}

.lms-card-title {
  padding: var(--size-22px);
  font-size: var(--lms-size-1_3rem);
  line-height: var(--leading-normal);
  font-weight: var(--weight-bold);
  margin: 0;
}
.lms-card-cover {
  display: block;
}
.lms-card-summary {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: var(--space-unit);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-md);
}
.lms-card-summary .lms-card-meta {
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--space-unit);
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}
.lms-price-compact {
  margin: 0;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  text-align: left;
}
.lms-course-card-body > .lms-card-action {
  margin-top: auto;
}

/* Bold, large labels preserve the approved white-on-red main action identity. */
.btn-primary {
  font-size: var(--font-size-action);
  font-weight: var(--font-weight-action);
}
.btn-primary,
.btn-primary:hover {
  color: var(--text-on-action);
  background: var(--primary-red);
}
/* Compact actions require the normal-text contrast threshold. */
.btn-primary.lms-nav-button,
.lms-search button {
  font-size: var(--font-size-control);
  color: var(--text-on-compact-action);
  background: var(--primary-red);
}
.lms-search input::placeholder,
.lms-notes textarea::placeholder,
.lms-profile-form input::placeholder {
  color: var(--text-muted);
  opacity: 1;
}

/* Context is optional prose, not a repeating section badge. */
.lms-heading-context,
.lms-page-heading .lms-heading-context {
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-size: var(--font-size-caption);
  font-weight: var(--font-weight-label);
  margin-top: 0;
  margin-bottom: var(--space-sm);
}
.lms-landing-hero .hero-headline {
  margin-top: 0;
}

/* Explicit properties keep interaction transitions predictable and lightweight. */
.lms-marketing-links a,
.lms-text-link,
.lms-footer-links a,
.lms-breadcrumb a,
.lms-preview-lessons > a,
.lms-preview-link,
.lms-sidebar-help a {
  transition: color var(--transition-fast);
}
.lms-filter-tabs > a,
.lms-sidebar nav a,
.lms-outline-module a,
.lms-resource-link,
.lms-search,
.lms-search button,
.lms-mobile-toggle,
.lms-profile-form input,
.lms-notes textarea {
  transition:
    color var(--transition-fast),
    background-color var(--transition-fast),
    border-color var(--transition-fast),
    box-shadow var(--transition-fast);
}
.btn-primary,
.lms-secondary-button {
  transition:
    color var(--transition-fast),
    background-color var(--transition-fast),
    border-color var(--transition-fast),
    box-shadow var(--transition-smooth),
    transform var(--transition-smooth);
}
.btn-primary:active,
.lms-secondary-button:active {
  transform: translateY(0) scale(var(--motion-press-scale));
  transition-duration: var(--motion-duration-press);
}
@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .lms-player-button:hover .video-play-button {
    transform: scale(var(--motion-play-hover-scale));
  }
}
.lms-player-button:active .video-play-button {
  transform: scale(var(--motion-press-scale));
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .btn-primary:active,
  .lms-secondary-button:active,
  .lms-player-button:hover .video-play-button,
  .lms-player-button:active .video-play-button {
    transform: none;
  }
}

/* Entrance wrappers keep reveal transforms separate from card hover transforms. */
.lms-card-entrance {
  min-width: 0;
  display: flex;
}
.lms-card-entrance > .lms-course-card {
  width: 100%;
}
.lms-card-cover .lms-course-art > svg,
.btn-primary > [data-icon="arrow"],
.lms-secondary-button > [data-icon="arrow"] {
  transition: transform var(--transition-smooth);
}
@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .lms-course-card:hover {
    transform: translateY(var(--motion-card-lift));
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-course-hover);
  }
  .lms-course-card:hover .lms-card-cover .lms-course-art > svg {
    transform: scale(var(--motion-cover-scale));
  }
  .btn-primary:hover,
  .lms-secondary-button:hover {
    transform: translateY(var(--motion-button-lift));
  }
  .btn-primary:hover > [data-icon="arrow"],
  .lms-secondary-button:hover > [data-icon="arrow"] {
    transform: translateX(var(--motion-arrow-shift));
  }
  .btn-primary:active,
  .lms-secondary-button:active {
    transform: translateY(0) scale(var(--motion-press-scale));
  }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .lms-course-card:hover,
  .btn-primary:hover,
  .lms-secondary-button:hover,
  .lms-course-card:hover .lms-card-cover .lms-course-art > svg,
  .btn-primary:hover > [data-icon="arrow"],
  .lms-secondary-button:hover > [data-icon="arrow"] {
    transform: none;
  }
}

/* Match supporting motion to the longer shared surface timing. */
.stage-column,
.highlight-editors {
  transition:
    transform var(--transition-smooth),
    border-color var(--transition-smooth),
    box-shadow var(--transition-smooth);
}
.stage-num-badge,
.faq-chevron {
  transition:
    transform var(--transition-smooth),
    color var(--transition-fast),
    border-color var(--transition-fast);
}
.video-play-button {
  transition:
    transform var(--transition-smooth),
    background-color var(--transition-fast);
}

.lms-hero-video {
  width: 100%;
  margin-top: var(--space-xl);
}

.lms-admin-checkbox { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-control); }
.lms-admin-checkbox input { width: auto; accent-color: var(--primary-red); }
.lms-admin-form .lms-form-field { margin: 0; }
```

```css
  flex-direction: column;
  background: var(--personal-reference-bg-dark-card);
  border: var(--personal-reference-value-1px) solid
    var(--personal-reference-border-subtle);
  border-radius: var(--personal-reference-radius-md);
  overflow: hidden;
  text-decoration: none;
  transition-property:
    transform, color, background-color, border-color, box-shadow, opacity,
    width, padding;
  transition-duration: var(--motion-duration-surface);
  transition-timing-function: var(--motion-easing);
}
.personal-site .p-ref-course-yt-card:hover {
  border-color: var(--personal-reference-primary-orange-border);
  transform: translateY(var(--personal-reference-value-negative-4px));
  box-shadow:
    0 var(--personal-reference-value-16px) var(--personal-reference-value-40px)
      var(--personal-reference-value-rgba-0-0-0-0-4),
    0 0 var(--personal-reference-value-25px)
      var(--personal-reference-value-rgba-252-53-34-0-12);
}
.personal-site .p-ref-course-yt-thumb {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  aspect-ratio: 16 / 9;
  background: var(--personal-reference-value-000);
  overflow: hidden;
}
.personal-site .p-ref-course-yt-img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  transition-property:
    transform, color, background-color, border-color, box-shadow, opacity,
    width, padding;
  transition-duration: var(--motion-duration-surface);
  transition-timing-function: var(--motion-easing);
}
.personal-site .p-ref-course-yt-card:hover .p-ref-course-yt-img {
  transform: scale(1.04);
}
.personal-site .p-ref-course-yt-badge {
  position: absolute;
  top: var(--personal-reference-value-14px);
  right: var(--personal-reference-value-14px);
  background: var(--personal-reference-value-rgba-16-19-23-0-9);
  backdrop-filter: blur(var(--personal-reference-value-8px));
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(var(--personal-reference-value-8px));
  border: var(--personal-reference-value-1px) solid
    var(--personal-reference-primary-orange-border);
  color: var(--personal-reference-primary-orange);
  font-size: var(--personal-reference-value-0-8rem);
  font-weight: 700;
  padding: var(--personal-reference-value-4px)
    var(--personal-reference-value-12px);
  border-radius: var(--personal-reference-radius-pill);
}
.personal-site .p-ref-course-yt-content {
  padding: var(--personal-reference-value-24px)
    var(--personal-reference-value-26px);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  flex: 1;
  justify-content: space-between;
}
.personal-site .p-ref-course-yt-title {
  font-size: var(--personal-reference-value-1-25rem);
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--personal-reference-text-white);
  margin-bottom: var(--personal-reference-value-8px);
  line-height: 1.35;
}
.personal-site .p-ref-course-yt-desc {
  font-size: var(--personal-reference-value-0-92rem);
  color: var(--personal-reference-text-muted);
  line-height: 1.7;
  margin-bottom: var(--personal-reference-value-20px);
}
.personal-site .p-ref-course-yt-cta {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--personal-reference-value-8px);
  font-size: var(--personal-reference-value-0-92rem);
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--personal-reference-primary-orange);
  margin-top: auto;
  transition-property:
    transform, color, background-color, border-color, box-shadow, opacity,
    width, padding;
  transition-duration: var(--motion-duration-surface);
  transition-timing-function: var(--motion-easing);
}
.personal-site .p-ref-course-yt-card:hover .p-ref-course-yt-cta svg {
  transform: translateX(var(--personal-reference-value-negative-4px));
}
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .personal-site .p-ref-courses-youtube-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}
.personal-site .p-ref-collab-section {
  padding: var(--personal-reference-section-spacing) 0;

  border-top: var(--personal-reference-value-1px) solid

}
.personal-site .p-ref-collab-box {
  background: radial-gradient(

  border: var(--personal-reference-value-1px) solid

      var(--personal-reference-value-24px),
      var(--personal-reference-value-5vw),
      var(--personal-reference-value-48px)
    );
  text-align: right;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: 0 var(--personal-reference-value-20px)
    var(--personal-reference-value-60px)
    var(--personal-reference-value-rgba-0-0-0-0-5);
}
.personal-site .p-ref-collab-headline {

}
.personal-site .p-ref-collab-copy {

}

@media (max-width: 991px) {

  }
  .personal-site .p-ref-reel-play-btn {

  }
  .personal-site .p-ref-reel-play-btn svg {

  }

    animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
    transition-duration: var(--personal-reference-value-0-01ms) !important;
    scroll-behavior: auto !important;
  }
}
.personal-site .personal-header-actions {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--personal-reference-value-12px);
}
.personal-site .p-ref-timeline-progress-bar {

}
.personal-site .p-ref-timeline-item.is-active .p-ref-timeline-node {
  background: var(--primary-red);
  border-color: var(--primary-red);
  transform: scale(1.25);
  box-shadow: 0 0 var(--personal-reference-value-14px) var(--primary-red-glow);
}
.personal-site .media-player-poster img {
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  transition: transform var(--transition-smooth);
}
.personal-site .personal-work-card:hover .media-player-poster img {
  transform: scale(1.06);
}
.personal-site .media-player {
  height: 100%;
}
.personal-site .media-player video {

}
.personal-site .personal-course-upcoming .p-ref-course-yt-cta {
  color: var(--portfolio-muted);
}
.personal-site .personal-skip {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  transform: translateY(-200%);
  z-index: var(--layer-navigation-menu);
  background: var(--bg-main);
  padding: var(--space-md);
}
.personal-site .personal-skip:focus {
  transform: translateY(0);
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .personal-site *,
  .personal-site *::before,
  .personal-site *::after {
    animation: none !important;
    transition-duration: var(--motion-duration-instant) !important;
  }
  .personal-site [class*="p-ref-"]:hover,
  .personal-site [class*="p-ref-"]:hover img,
  .personal-site [class*="p-ref-"]:hover svg {
    transform: none;
  }
}
```

```typescript
export type AnalyticsPeriod = "week" | "month" | "all";
export type AnalyticsMetric = "students" | "enrollments";
export interface AnalyticsMetrics {
  studentsWeek: number; studentsPreviousWeek: number; studentsMonth: number; studentsPreviousMonth: number;
  totalStudents: number; enrollmentsWeek: number; enrollmentsPreviousWeek: number;
  enrollmentsMonth: number; enrollmentsPreviousMonth: number; totalEnrollments: number;
  studentsEnrolled: number; publishedCourses: number; completedLessons: number;
}
export interface AnalyticsDay {
  day: string; students: number; enrollments: number;
  previousStudents: number | null; previousEnrollments: number | null;
}
export interface TrendingCourse {
  slug: string; title: string; thumbnail: string | null; delivery: "recorded" | "live";
  published: boolean; count: number; previous: number;
}
export interface AnalyticsSource { source: "youtube" | "facebook" | "instagram" | "tiktok" | "google" | "direct" | "unknown"; count: number }
export interface AdminAnalytics {
  generatedAt: string; timezone: string; weekStart: string; monthStart: string;
  metrics: AnalyticsMetrics; daily: AnalyticsDay[];
  courses: Record<AnalyticsPeriod, TrendingCourse[]>; sources: AnalyticsSource[];
}

import type { analyticsCopy } from "@platform/data/admin-analytics";
export type AnalyticsLabels = { [K in keyof typeof analyticsCopy]: K extends "sourceNames" ? Record<keyof typeof analyticsCopy.sourceNames, string> : string };
```

```typescript
import type { suspensionPeriods, userSearchModes } from "@platform/config/user-moderation";
export type SuspensionPeriod = typeof suspensionPeriods[number]["id"];
export type UserModeration = { action: "suspend"; period: SuspensionPeriod } | { action: "ban" | "restore" | "remove" | "promote" };
export interface AdminUser {
  id: string; name: string; username: string; email: string; avatarUrl: string | null;
  admin: boolean; confirmed: boolean; suspendedUntil: string | null; permanentlyBanned: boolean;
}
export interface AdminUserPage { users: AdminUser[]; page: number; hasNext: boolean; total: number; }
export interface AdminUserQuery {
  page: number; search: string; searchMode: typeof userSearchModes[number]; statuses: ("suspended" | "banned")[]; adminsOnly: boolean; newcomers: boolean;
}
```

```typescript
import { workshopCourseConfig } from "./config/workshop-course";
import type { NextConfig } from "next";
import { projectRoutes, legacyLearningNamespaces } from "./config/project-navigation";

const nextConfig: NextConfig = {
  poweredByHeader: false,
  output: "standalone",
  async redirects() {
    return [
      { source: `/${workshopCourseConfig.slug}`, destination: projectRoutes.workshop, permanent: true },
      { source: `/courses/${workshopCourseConfig.slug}`, destination: projectRoutes.workshop, permanent: true },
      ...legacyLearningNamespaces.flatMap((namespace) => [
        { source: `/${namespace}/${workshopCourseConfig.slug}`, destination: projectRoutes.workshop, permanent: true },
        { source: `/${namespace}/courses/${workshopCourseConfig.slug}`, destination: projectRoutes.workshop, permanent: true },
        { source: `/${namespace}`, destination: projectRoutes.learning, permanent: true },
        { source: `/${namespace}/:path+`, destination: "/:path+", permanent: true },
      ]),
      { source: "/portfolio", destination: projectRoutes.portfolio, permanent: false },
      { source: "/workshop", destination: projectRoutes.workshop, permanent: false },
    ];
  },
};

export default nextConfig;
```

```typescript
import { emailVariables } from "./variables";
import type { EmailBrand, EmailContent, EmailTheme } from "./types";
export function escapeEmailText(value: string) {
  return value.replaceAll("&", "&amp;").replaceAll("<", "&lt;").replaceAll(">", "&gt;").replaceAll('"', "&quot;").replaceAll("'", "&#39;");
}
export function emailAction(content: EmailContent, theme: EmailTheme, brand: EmailBrand) {
  if (content.code) return `<p dir="ltr" style="font-size:${theme.headingSize};font-weight:700;text-align:center;padding:${theme.gap};border:1px solid ${theme.border};border-radius:${theme.radius}">${content.code}</p>`;
  if (!content.action) return "";
  const url = content.actionUrl ?? emailVariables.confirmationUrl;
  return `<table role="presentation" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" border="0" style="margin:${theme.padding} 0"><tr><td bgcolor="${theme.primary}" style="border-radius:${theme.radius};text-align:center"><a href="${url}" style="display:inline-block;padding:${theme.gap} ${theme.padding};font-family:${escapeEmailText(theme.font)};font-size:${theme.buttonSize};font-weight:700;color:${theme.text};text-decoration:none">${escapeEmailText(content.action)}</a></td></tr></table>
<p style="font-size:${theme.smallSize};color:${theme.secondary}">${escapeEmailText(brand.fallback)}</p><p dir="ltr" style="font-size:${theme.smallSize};word-break:break-all;overflow-wrap:anywhere"><a href="${url}" style="color:${theme.secondary}">${url}</a></p>`;
}
```

### File: `packages/design-system/email/variables.ts`

SHA-256: `0d08e2ef7305fbd38066bd453d0ad9f3fb607b39a4638fc4b241ec1b53564d59`

```typescript
/** Dashboard-compatible placeholders; product templates use only this contract. */
export const emailVariables = {
  confirmationUrl: "{{ .ConfirmationURL }}", token: "{{ .Token }}", tokenHash: "{{ .TokenHash }}",
  siteUrl: "{{ .SiteURL }}", email: "{{ .Email }}", data: "{{ .Data }}", redirectTo: "{{ .RedirectTo }}",
} as const;
export function validateEmailVariables(source: string) {
  const allowed = new Set<string>(Object.values(emailVariables));
  const variables = [...source.matchAll(/{{[\s\S]*?}}/g)].map(match => match[0]);
  for (const variable of variables) {
    const expression = variable.match(/^{{\s*(\.\w+)\s*}}$/)?.[1];
    if (!expression || !allowed.has(`{{ ${expression} }}`)) throw new Error(`Unsupported email placeholder: ${variable}`);
  }
  if (/{{|}}/.test(source.replace(/{{[\s\S]*?}}/g, ""))) throw new Error("Malformed email placeholder");
  return [...new Set(variables)];
}
```

### File: `packages/design-system/helpers/browser/animation-frame.ts`

SHA-256: `3844775a3ee4fa3060964ed9ae4480d543a995c86e885cb30ceacfca15c5ff2a`

```typescript
/** Coalesce events and release scheduled work when its owning effect ends. */
export function createFrameScheduler(update: () => void) {
  let frame = 0, disposed = false;
  const schedule = () => {
    if (!disposed && !frame) frame = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      frame = 0;
      update();
    });
  };
  const dispose = () => {
    disposed = true;
    cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
  };
  return { schedule, dispose };
}
```

### File: `packages/design-system/helpers/media/bounded-number.ts`

SHA-256: `6c0b17f3a337888819f5e650c7f1159f471932d10dfcc0443704eb36a64ea376`

```typescript
/** Return a finite clamped value, or null when either boundary is invalid. */
export function boundedNumber(value: number, maximum: number): number | null {
  if (!Number.isFinite(value) || !Number.isFinite(maximum) || maximum < 0) return null;
  return Math.max(0, Math.min(maximum, value));
}
```

### File: `packages/design-system/helpers/media/format-time.ts`

SHA-256: `4baa6943879b7f90a36aff557d4b51164a7a28013959371fcd5ab6469bd51561`

```typescript
export function formatPlayerTime(seconds: number) {
  const value = Number.isFinite(seconds) ? Math.max(0, Math.floor(seconds)) : 0;
  const hours = Math.floor(value / 3600),
    minutes = Math.floor((value % 3600) / 60),
    rest = String(value % 60).padStart(2, "0");
  return hours
    ? `${hours}:${String(minutes).padStart(2, "0")}:${rest}`
    : `${minutes}:${rest}`;
}
```

### File: `packages/design-system/helpers/media/native/play.ts`

SHA-256: `982e883d2a9257aed3f56daaf7d2e54e614a9aacfde2b0ff1adf5901a60820f5`

```typescript
import type { Dispatch, SetStateAction } from "react";
import type { PlayerSnapshot } from "../../../types/video-player";
export function playNativeVideo(getVideo: () => HTMLVideoElement | null, publish: Dispatch<SetStateAction<PlayerSnapshot>>) {
  const video = getVideo();
  if (!video) return;
  void video.play().catch((error) => {
    if (getVideo() !== video || !video.hasAttribute("src") || error.name === "AbortError") return;
    publish((previous) => ({ ...previous, status: error.name === "NotAllowedError" ? "paused" : "error" }));
  });
}
```

### File: `packages/design-system/helpers/media/native/read-snapshot.ts`

SHA-256: `e328b9a353c0dc1f54f82531b233c1cf14dcbb1f78cc3e3ea02d4b3eee2e3a3a`

```typescript
import type { PlayerSnapshot } from "../../../types/video-player";
export function readNativeSnapshot(video: HTMLVideoElement, previous: PlayerSnapshot): PlayerSnapshot {
  const status = video.error ? "error" : video.ended ? "ended" : video.paused ? "paused"
    : video.readyState < 3 ? "buffering" : "playing";
  return {
    status: video.readyState === 0 && !video.error ? previous.status : status,
    ready: video.readyState >= 1 && !video.error,
    time: Number.isFinite(video.currentTime) ? video.currentTime : 0,
    duration: Number.isFinite(video.duration) ? video.duration : 0,
    volume: Math.round(video.volume * 100), muted: video.muted,
  };
}
```

### File: `packages/design-system/helpers/media/native/seek.ts`

SHA-256: `8eff01a1212211c0556888ec3007ea54d8cd52d096dbe4051c9efe8353ee686f`

```typescript
import { boundedNumber } from "../bounded-number";
import type { Dispatch, SetStateAction } from "react";
import type { PlayerSnapshot } from "../../../types/video-player";
export function seekNativeVideo(video: HTMLVideoElement | null, time: number, publish: Dispatch<SetStateAction<PlayerSnapshot>>) {
  if (!video) return;
  const value = boundedNumber(time, video.duration);
  if (value === null) return;
  video.currentTime = value;
  // Publish immediately so consecutive keyboard seeks use the requested position.
  publish((previous) => ({ ...previous, time: video.currentTime }));
}
```

```typescript
import { boundedNumber } from "../bounded-number";
export function setNativeVolume(video: HTMLVideoElement | null, value: number) {
  const level = boundedNumber(value, 100);
  if (!video || level === null) return;
  video.volume = level / 100;
  video.muted = level === 0;
}
```
