### File: `packages/design-system/styles/workshop.css`

SHA-256: `fdf280c78cb05b3774dcd68ab5b8d920871278b5b0c7e9f7c678231968cddea6`

```css
*,
*::before,
*::after {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
}

html {
  font-family: var(--font-arabic);
  direction: rtl;
  text-align: right;
  background-color: var(--bg-main);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  scroll-behavior: smooth;
  scroll-padding-top: var(--size-130px);
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
  overflow-x: clip;
}

section[id] {
  scroll-margin-top: var(--size-130px);
}

::-webkit-scrollbar {
  width: var(--size-9px);
}

::-webkit-scrollbar-button {
  display: none !important;
  width: 0 !important;
  height: 0 !important;
}

::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
  background: var(--color-0d1015);
}

::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
  background: var(--color-202732);
  border-radius: var(--size-6px);
  border: var(--size-2px) solid var(--color-0d1015);
  transition:
    background var(--transition-fast),
    border-color var(--transition-fast);
}

::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover,
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:active {
  background: var(--primary-red) !important;
}

html {
  scrollbar-width: thin;
  scrollbar-color: var(--color-202732) var(--color-0d1015);
}

:focus-visible {
  outline: var(--size-2px) solid var(--primary-red) !important;
  outline-offset: var(--size-3px) !important;
}

body {
  min-height: var(--size-100vh);
  line-height: var(--leading-body);
  overflow-x: clip;
  background-color: var(--bg-main);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  position: relative;
  cursor: default;
}

img,
svg,
video {
  display: block;
  max-width: 100%;
  height: auto;
}

a {
  color: inherit;
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: color var(--transition-fast);
}

button {
  font-family: inherit;
  background: none;
  border: none;
  color: inherit;
}

h1,
h2,
h3,
h4,
h5,
h6 {
  font-weight: var(--weight-bold);
  line-height: var(--leading-tight);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  letter-spacing: var(--size-negative-0_02em);
}

.headline-h1 {
  font-size: clamp(var(--size-1_85rem), var(--size-5vw), var(--size-3_8rem));
  font-weight: var(--weight-heavy);
  line-height: var(--leading-tight);
  letter-spacing: var(--size-negative-0_03em);
}

.headline-h2 {
  font-size: clamp(var(--size-1_45rem), var(--size-3_5vw), var(--size-2_75rem));
  font-weight: var(--weight-bold);
  line-height: var(--leading-title);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-md);
}

.headline-h3 {
  font-size: clamp(var(--size-1_15rem), var(--size-2_2vw), var(--size-1_65rem));
  font-weight: var(--weight-semibold);
  line-height: var(--leading-label);
}

.body-large {
  font-size: clamp(var(--size-1rem), var(--size-1_4vw), var(--size-1_22rem));
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  line-height: var(--leading-longform);
}

.body-regular {
  font-size: clamp(var(--size-0_9rem), var(--size-1_1vw), var(--size-1rem));
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  line-height: var(--leading-copy);
}

.text-red {
  color: var(--primary-red);
}
.text-muted {
  color: var(--text-muted);
}

.numeral {
  font-family: var(--font-arabic);
  font-weight: var(--weight-heavy);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

.container {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: var(--container-max);
  margin-left: auto;
  margin-right: auto;
  padding-left: clamp(var(--space-md), var(--size-4vw), var(--space-lg));
  padding-right: clamp(var(--space-md), var(--size-4vw), var(--space-lg));
}

.container-narrow {
  max-width: var(--container-narrow);
}

.container-corridor {
  padding-left: 0 !important;
  padding-right: 0 !important;
}

.container-inner {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: var(--inner-corridor-width);
  margin-left: auto;
  margin-right: auto;
  padding-left: var(--space-md);
  padding-right: var(--space-md);
}

.section {
  padding-top: clamp(var(--space-2xl), var(--size-7vw), var(--size-92px));
  padding-bottom: clamp(var(--space-2xl), var(--size-7vw), var(--size-92px));
  position: relative;
}

.section-dark {
  background-color: var(--bg-main);
}

.section-alt {
  background-color: var(--bg-section-alt);
  border-top: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  border-bottom: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
}

.site-header {
  position: -webkit-sticky;
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  z-index: var(--layer-navigation);
  width: 100%;
  background-color: var(--bg-main);
}

.top-scarcity-bar {
  background-color: var(--primary-red);
  border-bottom: var(--size-1px) solid var(--color-rgba-0-0-0-0-15);
  height: var(--space-3xl);
  min-height: var(--space-3xl);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.top-bar-inner {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  padding-left: 0 !important;
  padding-right: 0 !important;
}

.top-scarcity-nav-capsule {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  width: 100%;
  height: var(--size-44px);
  background: var(--color-rgba-12-16-22-0-94);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--color-rgba-255-255-255-0-18);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  box-shadow: 0 var(--size-6px) var(--shadow-offset-18)
    var(--color-rgba-0-0-0-0-35);
  padding: 0 var(--space-comfortable);
  font-size: var(--size-0_88rem);
  font-weight: var(--weight-bold);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  align-self: center;
}

.top-live-item {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-sm);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-weight: var(--weight-bold);
}

.top-live-item .live-dot {
  width: var(--dimension-8);
  height: var(--dimension-8);
  border-radius: 50%;
  background-color: var(--accent-green);
  box-shadow: 0 0 var(--size-10px) var(--accent-green);
  display: inline-block;
}

.top-live-item .proof-num-highlight {
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-weight: var(--weight-heavy);
}

.top-bar-sep {
  color: var(--color-rgba-255-255-255-0-3);
  font-weight: var(--weight-heavy);
  font-size: var(--size-1rem);
}

.top-timer-item {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-sm);
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.top-timer-label {
  color: var(--color-rgba-255-255-255-0-95);
  font-weight: var(--weight-bold);
  font-size: var(--size-0_88rem);
}

.top-timer-boxes {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: var(--space-sm);
}

.timer-unit-box {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: var(--space-xs);
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  padding: 0;
  line-height: var(--leading-solid);
}

.timer-unit-box b {
  font-size: var(--size-1_05rem);
  font-weight: var(--weight-heavy);
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.timer-unit-box small {
  font-size: var(--size-0_82rem);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-weight: var(--weight-semibold);
}

.timer-sep {
  color: var(--color-rgba-255-255-255-0-45);
  font-weight: var(--weight-heavy);
  font-size: var(--size-0_95rem);
  margin: 0 var(--size-1px);
}

.site-navbar {
  background-color: var(--color-rgba-16-19-23-0-98);
  backdrop-filter: blur(var(--blur-navigation));

  border-bottom: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  height: var(--space-3xl);
  min-height: var(--space-3xl);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 0;
}

.nav-inner {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  width: 100%;
  gap: var(--size-20px);
}

.nav-brand {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-sm);
  text-decoration: none;
  width: auto;
  min-width: 0;
  justify-content: flex-start;
}

.nav-brand-title {
  font-size: var(--size-1_25rem);
  font-weight: var(--weight-heavy);
  letter-spacing: var(--size-negative-0_01em);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  transition: color var(--transition-fast);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.nav-brand:hover .nav-brand-title {
  color: var(--primary-red) !important;
}

.nav-brand-dot {
  display: none !important;
}

.nav-links {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: var(--size-22px);
  list-style: none;
  flex: 1;
}

.nav-link-item a {
  font-size: var(--size-0_92rem);
  font-weight: var(--weight-semibold);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  padding: var(--size-6px) var(--space-xs);
  position: relative;
  transition: color var(--transition-fast);
}

.nav-link-item a:hover {
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.nav-link-item a::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 0;
  right: 0;
  left: 0;
  height: var(--size-2px);
  background-color: var(--primary-red);
  transform: scaleX(0);
  transition: transform var(--transition-smooth);
}
@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .nav-link-item a:hover::after {
    transform: scaleX(1);
  }
}

.nav-actions {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-control);
  width: auto;
  min-width: 0;
  justify-content: flex-end;
}

.nav-cta-btn {
  padding: var(--space-sm) var(--space-comfortable) !important;
  font-size: var(--size-0_88rem) !important;
  font-weight: var(--weight-bold);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
  height: var(--size-38px);
}

.mobile-nav-toggle {
  display: none;
  width: var(--size-44px);
  height: var(--size-44px);
  min-width: var(--size-44px);
  min-height: var(--size-44px);
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  background: var(--bg-surface);
}

.mobile-nav-toggle svg {
  width: var(--size-20px);
  height: var(--size-20px);
  stroke: currentColor;
}

.eyebrow {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-sm);
  padding: var(--size-6px) var(--space-md);
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  background: var(--color-rgba-252-53-34-0-12);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--primary-red-border);
  font-size: var(--size-0_85rem);
  font-weight: var(--weight-bold);
  color: var(--color-ffa59c);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-md);
  width: fit-content;
  box-shadow: 0 0 var(--space-md) var(--color-rgba-252-53-34-0-14);
}

.eyebrow-accent {
  border-color: var(--color-rgba-252-53-34-0-45);
  background: var(--color-rgba-252-53-34-0-16);
  color: var(--color-ffb3aa);
}

.eyebrow-dot {
  width: var(--size-7px);
  height: var(--size-7px);
  border-radius: 50%;
  background-color: var(--primary-red);
  display: inline-block;
  box-shadow: 0 0 var(--shadow-offset-8) var(--primary-red);
  animation: pulseRed var(--size-2s) infinite;
}

@keyframes pulseRed {
  0%,
  100% {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: scale(1);
  }
  50% {
    opacity: 0.45;
    transform: scale(var(--scale-decoration-1-3));
  }
}

.btn-primary {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: var(--size-10px);
  background-color: var(--primary-red);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-weight: var(--weight-bold);
  font-size: var(--size-1_1rem);
  padding: var(--space-md) var(--size-36px);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid transparent;
  cursor: pointer;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  transition:
    transform var(--transition-smooth),
    background-color var(--transition-fast),
    box-shadow var(--transition-fast);
  text-align: center;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .btn-primary:hover {
    background-color: var(--primary-red-hover);
    transform: translateY(var(--size-negative-2px));
    box-shadow: 0 var(--size-10px) var(--space-lg) var(--primary-red-glow);
  }
}

.btn-primary:active {
  transform: translateY(0);
}

.btn-arrow-icon {
  width: var(--dimension-18);
  height: var(--dimension-18);
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  transition: transform var(--transition-smooth);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.btn-arrow-icon svg {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  fill: currentColor;
}

.hero-cta-wrapper {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  margin-top: var(--size-36px);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-lg);
  width: 100%;
}

.hero-cta-wrapper .btn-primary {
  width: var(--size-360px);
  max-width: 100%;
  padding: var(--space-md) var(--size-28px);
  font-size: var(--size-1_12rem);
  font-weight: var(--weight-heavy);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  justify-content: center;
  box-shadow: 0 var(--shadow-offset-12) var(--size-30px) var(--primary-red-glow);
}

.cta-microcopy {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  width: var(--size-360px);
  max-width: 100%;
  font-size: var(--size-0_88rem);
  color: var(--text-muted);
  margin-top: var(--space-md);
}

.cta-microcopy-dot {
  width: var(--dimension-4);
  height: var(--dimension-4);
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--text-faint);
}

.hero-section {
  padding-top: var(--space-4xl);
  padding-bottom: var(--space-5xl);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-align: center;
}

.hero-interactive-grid {
  position: absolute;
  inset: var(--size-negative-60px);
  background-image:
    linear-gradient(
      to right,
      var(--color-rgba-255-255-255-0-025) var(--size-1px),
      transparent var(--size-1px)
    ),
    linear-gradient(
      to bottom,
      var(--color-rgba-255-255-255-0-025) var(--size-1px),
      transparent var(--size-1px)
    );
  background-size: var(--space-3xl) var(--space-3xl);
  mask-image: radial-gradient(
    ellipse 75% 65% at 50% 25%,
    var(--color-000) 35%,
    transparent 80%
  );
  -webkit-mask-image: radial-gradient(
    ellipse 75% 65% at 50% 25%,
    var(--color-000) 35%,
    transparent 80%
  );
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: var(--layer-base);
  will-change: transform;
  transition: transform var(--transition-smooth);
}

.hero-inner-content {
  position: relative;
  z-index: var(--layer-content);
  width: 100%;
  margin: 0 auto;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
}

.hero-headline {
  margin-top: var(--size-10px);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-lg);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-size: clamp(var(--size-2rem), var(--size-3_4vw), var(--size-2_75rem));
  font-weight: var(--weight-heavy);
  line-height: var(--leading-1-52);
  max-width: var(--size-980px);
  width: 100%;
  text-wrap: balance;
}

@keyframes softBadgeBreathing {
  0%,
  100% {
    box-shadow:
      0 0 var(--space-md) var(--color-rgba-252-53-34-0-2),
      inset 0 0 var(--shadow-offset-8) var(--primary-red-subtle);
    border-color: var(--color-rgba-252-53-34-0-5);
  }
  50% {
    box-shadow:
      0 0 var(--size-28px) var(--color-rgba-252-53-34-0-38),
      inset 0 0 var(--shadow-offset-12) var(--color-rgba-252-53-34-0-2);
    border-color: var(--color-rgba-252-53-34-0-8);
  }
}

.highlight-editors {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-sm);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  background: linear-gradient(
    var(--size-135deg),
    var(--color-rgba-252-53-34-0-24) 0%,
    var(--color-rgba-20-24-32-0-94) 50%,
    var(--color-rgba-252-53-34-0-18) 100%
  );
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--color-rgba-252-53-34-0-55);
  padding: var(--size-3px) var(--space-detail);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  animation: softBadgeBreathing var(--size-4s) ease-in-out infinite;
  position: relative;
  vertical-align: middle;
  overflow: hidden;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition:
    transform var(--transition-smooth),
    border-color var(--transition-fast),
    box-shadow var(--transition-smooth);
}

.highlight-editors::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: -120%;
  width: 65%;
  height: 100%;
  background: linear-gradient(
    var(--size-105deg),
    transparent 0%,
    var(--color-rgba-255-255-255-0-05) 25%,
    var(--color-rgba-255-255-255-0-45) 50%,
    var(--color-rgba-255-255-255-0-05) 75%,
    transparent 100%
  );
  transform: skewX(var(--size-negative-20deg));
  transition: left var(--transition-smooth);
  pointer-events: none;
}
@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .highlight-editors:hover {
    transform: translateY(var(--size-negative-1px));
    border-color: var(--color-rgba-252-53-34-0-85);
    box-shadow:
      0 0 var(--space-lg) var(--color-rgba-252-53-34-0-42),
      inset 0 0 var(--shadow-offset-12) var(--color-rgba-252-53-34-0-2);
  }
}

.highlight-editors:hover::before {
  left: 160%;
}

.highlight-editors .badge-sparkle-icon {
  color: var(--color-ffa59c);
  filter: drop-shadow(0 0 var(--size-6px) var(--primary-red));
  transition:
    transform var(--transition-smooth),
    color var(--transition-fast);
}
@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .highlight-editors:hover .badge-sparkle-icon {
    transform: scale(var(--scale-decoration-1-15)) rotate(var(--size-15deg));
    color: var(--text-primary);
  }
}

@keyframes softTextGlow {
  0%,
  100% {
    text-shadow: 0 0 var(--dimension-8) var(--color-rgba-252-53-34-0-2);
  }
  50% {
    text-shadow: 0 0 var(--dimension-18) var(--color-rgba-252-53-34-0-45);
  }
}

.hero-headline .highlight-red {
  color: var(--primary-red);
  display: inline-block;
  animation: softTextGlow var(--size-4s) ease-in-out infinite;
  position: relative;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition:
    text-shadow var(--transition-smooth),
    transform var(--transition-smooth),
    color var(--transition-fast);
}

.hero-headline .highlight-red::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  bottom: var(--size-0px);
  right: 0;
  width: 0%;
  height: var(--size-2px);
  background: linear-gradient(
    var(--size-90deg),
    var(--primary-red),
    var(--color-ffa59c)
  );
  border-radius: var(--size-2px);
  box-shadow: 0 0 var(--shadow-offset-8) var(--primary-red);
  transition: width var(--transition-smooth);
}
@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .hero-headline .highlight-red:hover {
    transform: translateY(var(--size-negative-1px));
    text-shadow:
      0 0 var(--size-22px) var(--color-rgba-252-53-34-0-7),
      0 0 var(--size-35px) var(--primary-red-border);
  }
}

.hero-headline .highlight-red:hover::after {
  width: 100%;
}

.hero-support-text {
  font-size: var(--size-1_12rem);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  line-height: var(--leading-longform);
  margin-bottom: var(--size-34px);
  max-width: var(--size-840px);
  width: 100%;
  text-wrap: balance;
}

.hero-video-centered {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: var(--inner-corridor-width, var(--inner-corridor-width));
  margin-left: auto;
  margin-right: auto;
  margin-bottom: var(--size-28px);
  align-self: center;
}

@keyframes videoShellCalmGlow {
  0%,
  100% {
    border-color: var(--primary-red-border);
    box-shadow:
      0 0 var(--space-lg) var(--color-rgba-252-53-34-0-12),
      0 var(--space-lg) var(--space-3xl) var(--color-rgba-0-0-0-0-6);
  }
  50% {
    border-color: var(--color-rgba-252-53-34-0-55);
    box-shadow:
      0 0 var(--size-38px) var(--color-rgba-252-53-34-0-24),
      0 var(--space-lg) var(--space-3xl) var(--color-rgba-0-0-0-0-6);
  }
}

.hero-video-shell {
  position: relative;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  background-color: var(--bg-surface);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--primary-red-border);
  box-shadow:
    0 0 var(--space-lg) var(--color-rgba-252-53-34-0-12),
    0 var(--space-lg) var(--space-3xl) var(--color-rgba-0-0-0-0-6);
  animation: videoShellCalmGlow var(--size-4_5s) ease-in-out infinite;
  overflow: hidden;
  aspect-ratio: 16 / 9;
  width: 100%;
}

.hero-video-shell iframe,
.hero-video-shell video {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  border: none;
  display: block;
}

.hero-video-placeholder {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: var(--space-md);
  background: linear-gradient(
    var(--size-180deg),
    var(--color-1c232c) 0%,
    var(--color-12161d) 100%
  );
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background-color var(--transition-fast);
}

.hero-video-placeholder:hover {
  background: linear-gradient(
    var(--size-180deg),
    var(--color-222b36) 0%,
    var(--color-151a22) 100%
  );
}

.video-play-button {
  width: var(--size-68px);
  height: var(--size-68px);
  border-radius: 50%;
  background-color: var(--primary-red);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  box-shadow: 0 var(--shadow-offset-12) var(--size-30px) var(--primary-red-glow);
  transition:
    transform var(--transition-smooth),
    background-color var(--transition-fast);
}

.video-play-button svg {
  width: var(--size-26px);
  height: var(--size-26px);
  margin-right: var(--size-negative-3px);
  fill: currentColor;
}
@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .hero-video-placeholder:hover .video-play-button {
    transform: scale(var(--scale-decoration-1-08));
    background-color: var(--primary-red-hover);
  }
}

.video-meta-label {
  font-size: var(--size-1rem);
  font-weight: var(--weight-bold);
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.video-meta-time {
  font-size: var(--size-0_82rem);
  color: var(--text-muted);
}

.hero-bottom-cta {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-sm);
}

.clients-section {
  text-align: center;
}

.clients-header {
  max-width: var(--size-1050px);
  margin: 0 auto var(--space-2xl);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
}

.clients-header p.body-large {
  max-width: var(--size-980px);
  text-wrap: balance;
  margin: 0 auto;
}

.clients-single-line {
  white-space: nowrap;
  margin-bottom: var(--space-control);
}

.creators-marquee {
  direction: ltr;
  position: relative;
  margin: 0 auto var(--space-3xl);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  padding: var(--space-detail) 0;
  background: var(--color-rgba-0-0-0-0-25);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  overflow: hidden;
}

.creators-track {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--space-md);
  align-items: center;
  width: max-content;
  animation: marqueeScroll var(--size-38s) linear infinite;
}

@keyframes marqueeScroll {
  0% {
    transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
  }
  100% {
    transform: translate3d(calc(-50% - var(--space-md) / 2), 0, 0);
  }
}
.creators-marquee .creator-chip {
  direction: rtl;
}
@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .creators-marquee:hover .creators-track {
    animation-play-state: paused;
  }
}

.creator-chip {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--size-10px);
  padding: var(--space-sm) var(--space-md);
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  background: var(--color-rgba-16-20-26-0-7);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  flex-shrink: 0;
  transition:
    border-color var(--transition-fast),
    transform var(--transition-smooth);
}
@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .creator-chip:hover {
    border-color: var(--primary-red-border);
    transform: translateY(var(--size-negative-2px));
  }
}

.creator-avatar {
  width: var(--space-xl);
  height: var(--space-xl);
  border-radius: 50%;
  overflow: hidden;
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-strong);
  background-color: var(--bg-surface-elevated);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-weight: var(--weight-bold);
  font-size: var(--size-0_85rem);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.creator-avatar-photo,
.creator-avatar img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: block;
}

.creator-name {
  font-weight: var(--weight-bold);
  font-size: var(--size-0_9rem);
}

.creator-platform {
  font-size: var(--size-0_75rem);
  color: var(--text-muted);
  border-right: var(--size-1px) solid var(--color-rgba-255-255-255-0-15);
  padding-right: var(--space-sm);
}

.clients-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: var(--size-20px);
  align-items: stretch;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 100%;
  margin-left: auto;
  margin-right: auto;
}

.client-work-card {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  background-color: var(--bg-main);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  overflow: hidden;
  height: 100%;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  margin-top: 0 !important;
  margin-bottom: 0 !important;
  transform: none;
  transition:
    border-color var(--transition-fast),
    transform var(--transition-smooth),
    box-shadow var(--transition-fast);
}
@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {

      0 0 var(--size-20px) var(--color-rgba-252-53-34-0-12);

.client-work-preview {

  background-color: var(--color-0c0e11);

  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.client-work-tag {

  top: var(--size-10px);

  z-index: var(--layer-decoration);
  padding: var(--space-xs) var(--space-sm);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
  background-color: var(--color-rgba-16-19-23-0-88);

  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  font-size: var(--size-0_72rem);
  font-weight: var(--weight-bold);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}


.reel-placeholder-box {

  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;

  height: 100%;

}

.reel-play-btn {

  justify-content: center;

  box-shadow: 0 0 var(--size-20px) var(--color-rgba-252-53-34-0-45);

    background-color var(--transition-fast),
    box-shadow var(--transition-smooth);
}

.reel-play-btn svg {
  width: var(--dimension-18);
  height: var(--dimension-18);
  margin-right: var(--size-negative-2px);
}
@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .client-work-card:hover .reel-play-btn {
    transform: scale(var(--scale-decoration-1-15));
    background-color: var(--primary-red);
    box-shadow: 0 0 var(--size-28px) var(--color-rgba-252-53-34-0-75);

}

.proof-placeholder-text {

  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.client-work-info {

}

.client-work-title {
  font-size: var(--size-0_95rem);
  font-weight: var(--weight-bold);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-xs);
  line-height: var(--leading-label);
}

.client-work-sub {
  font-size: var(--size-0_78rem);
  color: var(--text-muted);
  line-height: var(--leading-summary);
}

.transformation-section {
  text-align: center;
}

.transform-header {
  margin-bottom: var(--space-3xl);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  width: 100%;
}

.transformation-frame-card {
  background: var(--color-rgba-22-27-34-0-75);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  padding: var(--size-22px) var(--size-36px);
  margin-left: auto;
  margin-right: auto;
  margin-bottom: var(--size-20px);
  width: 100%;
  max-width: var(--inner-corridor-width, var(--inner-corridor-width));
  box-shadow: 0 var(--shadow-offset-12) var(--size-36px)
    var(--color-rgba-0-0-0-0-4);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.transformation-frame-card::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  right: 15%;
  left: 15%;
  height: var(--size-2px);

    transparent,
    var(--primary-red),

  );
}

.transform-headline {

  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;

  gap: var(--space-control);
}

.trans-from {

}

.trans-arrow {

}

.trans-to {

}

.transform-lead-text {

.transform-stages-grid {

  gap: var(--space-xl);
  position: relative;
  text-align: right;
  align-items: stretch;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: var(--inner-corridor-width, var(--inner-corridor-width));
  margin-left: auto;
  margin-right: auto;
}

.stage-column {
  position: relative;
  z-index: var(--layer-content);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  height: 100%;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  margin-top: 0 !important;
  margin-bottom: 0 !important;
  padding: var(--size-28px) var(--space-lg);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-subtle);
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  transform: none;
  transition:
    transform var(--transition-smooth),
    border-color var(--transition-fast),
    box-shadow var(--transition-smooth);
}
@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .stage-column:hover {
    transform: translateY(var(--size-negative-5px));
    border-color: var(--color-rgba-252-53-34-0-45);
    box-shadow:

  }
}

.stage-num-badge {

  font-weight: var(--weight-heavy);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-lg);
  transition:

    transform var(--transition-smooth);
}
@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .stage-column:hover .stage-num-badge {

.stage-title {

.stage-desc {

.roadmap-section {

}

.roadmap-header {

  align-items: center;
}

.roadmap-highlight-box {

  margin: var(--size-28px) auto;

.roadmap-highlight-title {

}

.roadmap-highlight-pills {

}

.formula-line-inputs,

}

.pill-item {

@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {

    transform var(--transition-smooth);
}
@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {

.roadmap-timeline {

.day-item {

}

.timeline-marker.day-number-col,

}

.day-badge-num {
  width: var(--size-78px);

  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: var(--size-3px);

  text-align: center;

}

.day-badge-digit {

  z-index: var(--layer-timeline-label);
  transition:

    transform var(--transition-smooth);
}

.day-badge-text {

}

.day-item.is-passed .day-badge-num {

}

.day-item.is-active .day-badge-num,

}

.day-item.is-passed .day-badge-digit,

.day-card {

}
@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {

.roadmap-bottom-cta {

.featured-review-card {

.review-card {

@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .review-card:hover {

.review-card-text {

  flex-grow: 1;
}

.review-card-author {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  border-top: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  padding-top: var(--space-md);
  margin-top: var(--space-sm);
}

.review-author-info {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-control);
}

.review-avatar-flag {
  width: var(--size-38px);
  height: var(--size-38px);
  border-radius: 50%;
  overflow: hidden;
  border: var(--size-1_5px) solid var(--border-strong);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  background-color: var(--bg-surface-elevated);
  box-shadow: 0 var(--shadow-offset-4) var(--size-10px)
    var(--color-rgba-0-0-0-0-35);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.review-avatar-flag img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  display: block;
}

.review-author-meta {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--size-2px);
  text-align: right;
}

.review-card-name {
  font-weight: var(--weight-bold);
  font-size: var(--size-0_98rem);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  line-height: var(--leading-tight);
}

.review-card-country {
  font-size: var(--size-0_78rem);
  color: var(--text-muted);
  line-height: var(--leading-compact);
}

.author-meta {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--size-3px);
  text-align: right;
}

.instructor-layout {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 0.85fr 1.15fr;
  gap: var(--space-4xl);
  align-items: center;
}

.instructor-photo-column {
  position: relative;
}

.instructor-photo-frame {
  position: relative;
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  background: radial-gradient(
    circle at 50% 30%,
    var(--primary-red) 0%,
    var(--color-d42010) 45%,
    var(--color-8a1208) 85%,
    var(--bg-section-alt) 100%
  );
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--color-rgba-252-53-34-0-55);
  overflow: hidden;
  aspect-ratio: 4 / 5;
  box-shadow:
    0 var(--space-lg) var(--size-60px) var(--color-rgba-0-0-0-0-55),
    0 0 var(--size-50px) var(--primary-red-border);
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: var(--size-36px) var(--size-20px) 0 var(--size-20px);
}

.instructor-photo-frame img,
.instructor-photo-img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: contain;
  object-position: center bottom;
  filter: drop-shadow(
    0 var(--shadow-offset-14) var(--size-28px) var(--color-rgba-0-0-0-0-65)
  );
  display: block;
}

.instructor-photo-placeholder {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: var(--space-md);
  background: linear-gradient(
    var(--size-180deg),
    var(--color-1c2229) 0%,
    var(--bg-main) 100%
  );
  padding: var(--space-lg);
  text-align: center;
}

.instructor-avatar-icon {
  width: var(--space-3xl);
  height: var(--space-3xl);
  color: var(--text-muted);
}

.instructor-badges-float {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: var(--space-md);
  right: var(--space-md);
  left: var(--space-md);
  padding: var(--size-10px) var(--space-detail);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  background-color: var(--color-rgba-16-19-23-0-92);
  backdrop-filter: blur(var(--size-10px));
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
}

.instructor-badge-label {
  font-size: var(--size-0_8rem);
  font-weight: var(--weight-bold);
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.instructor-exp-stat {
  font-size: var(--size-0_78rem);
  font-weight: var(--weight-heavy);
  color: var(--primary-red);
}

.instructor-name {
  font-size: clamp(var(--size-2rem), var(--size-3_5vw), var(--size-2_75rem));
  font-weight: var(--weight-heavy);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-xs);
}

.instructor-tagline {
  font-size: var(--size-1_15rem);
  font-weight: var(--weight-semibold);
  color: var(--primary-red);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-xl);
}

.instructor-manifesto {
  font-size: var(--size-1_15rem);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  line-height: var(--leading-spacious);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-2xl);
  max-width: var(--size-54ch);
}

.instructor-manifesto b {
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.instructor-actions {
  margin-top: var(--space-xl);
}

.instructor-stats-row {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--space-2xl);
  border-top: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  padding-top: var(--space-xl);
}

.inst-stat-item {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

.inst-stat-num {
  font-size: var(--size-2rem);
  font-weight: var(--weight-heavy);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  line-height: var(--leading-headline);
}

.inst-stat-lbl {
  font-size: var(--size-0_85rem);
  color: var(--text-muted);
}

.guarantee-card {
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  background-color: var(--bg-surface);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-right: var(--dimension-4) solid var(--primary-red);
  padding: var(--space-3xl);
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: var(--size-80px) 1fr;
  gap: var(--space-2xl);
  align-items: center;
}

.guarantee-icon-box {
  width: var(--size-72px);
  height: var(--size-72px);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  background-color: var(--primary-red-subtle);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--primary-red-border);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  color: var(--primary-red);
}

.guarantee-icon-box svg {
  width: var(--size-36px);
  height: var(--size-36px);
  fill: currentColor;
}

.guarantee-copy {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--space-sm);
}

.guarantee-headline {
  font-size: var(--size-1_65rem);
  font-weight: var(--weight-bold);
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.guarantee-text {
  font-size: var(--size-1_15rem);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  line-height: var(--leading-body);
}

.faq-header {
  text-align: center;
  margin-bottom: var(--space-4xl);
}

.faq-accordion {
  max-width: var(--container-narrow);
  margin: 0 auto;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--space-control);
}

.faq-item {
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  background-color: var(--bg-main);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: border-color var(--transition-fast);
}

.faq-item:hover {
  border-color: var(--border-subtle);
}

.faq-item.is-active {
  border-color: var(--border-strong);
}

.faq-question-btn {
  width: 100%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: var(--size-22px) var(--space-lg);
  font-size: var(--size-1_125rem);
  font-weight: var(--weight-semibold);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  text-align: right;
  gap: var(--space-md);
  cursor: pointer;
}

.faq-chevron {
  width: var(--size-20px);
  height: var(--size-20px);
  color: var(--text-muted);
  transition:
    transform var(--transition-smooth),
    color var(--transition-fast);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.faq-item.is-active .faq-chevron {
  transform: rotate(var(--size-negative-180deg));
  color: var(--primary-red);
}

.faq-answer-panel {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-rows: 0fr;
  opacity: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  transition:
    grid-template-rows var(--transition-smooth),
    opacity var(--transition-smooth);
}
.faq-answer-inner {
  min-height: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.faq-answer-content {
  padding: 0 var(--space-lg) var(--size-22px) var(--space-lg);
  font-size: var(--size-1rem);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  line-height: var(--leading-spacious);
  border-top: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  padding-top: var(--space-md);
}

.final-cta-section {
  position: relative;
  text-align: center;
}

.final-cta-box {
  max-width: var(--container-narrow);
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: var(--space-4xl) var(--space-2xl);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  background: linear-gradient(
    var(--size-180deg),
    var(--bg-surface) 0%,
    var(--color-12161c) 100%
  );
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-subtle);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-lg);
  box-shadow: 0 var(--space-xl) var(--size-80px) var(--color-rgba-0-0-0-0-5);
}

.final-cta-headline {
  max-width: var(--size-20ch);
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.final-cta-sub {
  font-size: var(--size-1_15rem);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  max-width: var(--size-52ch);
  line-height: var(--leading-spacious);
}

.final-btn-wrapper {
  margin-top: var(--space-md);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  width: 100%;
}

.final-btn-wrapper .btn-primary {
  width: var(--size-360px);
  max-width: 100%;
  padding: var(--space-md) var(--size-28px);
  font-size: var(--size-1_12rem);
  font-weight: var(--weight-heavy);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  justify-content: center;
  box-shadow: 0 var(--shadow-offset-12) var(--size-30px) var(--primary-red-glow);
}

.final-btn-wrapper .cta-microcopy {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  width: var(--size-360px);
  max-width: 100%;
  font-size: var(--size-0_88rem);
  color: var(--text-muted);
  margin-top: var(--space-md);
}

.site-footer {
  padding-top: var(--space-3xl);
  padding-bottom: var(--space-3xl);
  border-top: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  background-color: var(--color-0b0e11);
}

.footer-layout {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: var(--space-lg);
}

.footer-brand {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--space-xs);
}

.footer-brand-title {
  display: inline-block;
  font-size: var(--size-1_15rem);
  font-weight: var(--weight-heavy);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: color var(--transition-fast);
  cursor: pointer !important;
  width: fit-content;
}

.footer-brand-title:hover {
  color: var(--primary-red) !important;
}

.footer-copy-text {
  font-size: var(--size-0_85rem);
  color: var(--text-muted);
}

.footer-social-wrapper {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: var(--space-sm);
}

.footer-designer-credit {
  font-size: var(--size-0_85rem);
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-weight: var(--weight-regular);
  line-height: var(--leading-normal);
}

.footer-social-links {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-control);
  list-style: none;
}

.social-btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: var(--size-44px);
  height: var(--size-44px);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
  background-color: var(--bg-surface);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  transition: color var(--transition-fast);
}
@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .social-btn:hover {
    border-color: var(--primary-red-border);
    background-color: var(--primary-red-subtle);
    color: var(--primary-red);
    transform: translateY(var(--size-negative-2px));
  }
}

.social-btn svg {
  width: var(--size-20px);
  height: var(--size-20px);
  fill: currentColor;
}

.recent-signup-toast {
  position: fixed;
  bottom: var(--space-lg);
  right: var(--dimension-8);
  left: auto;
  z-index: var(--layer-toast);
  width: var(--size-152px);
  max-width: var(--size-152px);
  background: var(--color-rgba-14-18-25-0-96);
  border: var(--size-1px) solid var(--color-rgba-255-255-255-0-16);
  backdrop-filter: blur(var(--space-md));

  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  padding: var(--space-sm) var(--size-10px);
  box-shadow: 0 var(--shadow-offset-12) var(--size-28px)
    var(--color-rgba-0-0-0-0-55);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--size-5px);
  transform: translateY(120%);
  opacity: 0;
  visibility: hidden;
  transition:
    transform var(--transition-smooth),
    opacity var(--transition-smooth),
    visibility var(--motion-duration-surface);
}

.recent-signup-toast.is-active {
  transform: translateY(0);
  opacity: 1;
  visibility: visible;
}

.toast-card-inner {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--space-xs);
  width: 100%;
}

.toast-card-top-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--size-6px);
  font-size: var(--size-0_68rem);
}

.toast-dot {
  width: var(--size-6px);
  height: var(--size-6px);
  border-radius: 50%;
  background-color: var(--accent-green);
  box-shadow: 0 0 var(--size-6px) var(--accent-green);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.toast-status-badge {
  color: var(--accent-green);
  font-weight: var(--weight-bold);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.toast-card-user-row {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--size-1px);
  font-size: var(--size-0_74rem);
  line-height: var(--leading-title);
}

.toast-user-name {
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-weight: var(--weight-bold);
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.toast-user-country {
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-size: var(--size-0_68rem);
  font-weight: var(--weight-medium);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.toast-close-btn {
  position: absolute;
  top: var(--dimension-4);
  left: var(--size-6px);
  right: auto;
  background: none;
  border: none;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-size: var(--dimension-14);
  line-height: var(--leading-solid);
  cursor: pointer;
  padding: 0;
}

.toast-close-btn:hover {
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

@media (min-width: 1025px) {
  .top-scarcity-nav-capsule {
    width: var(--top-capsule-width, var(--top-capsule-width));
    max-width: var(--top-capsule-width, var(--top-capsule-width));
    margin-right: auto;
    margin-left: auto;
    align-self: center;
  }

  .hero-video-centered,
  .transformation-frame-card,
  .transform-stages-grid,
  .roadmap-timeline,
  .guarantee-card,
  .faq-accordion,
  .final-cta-box {
    width: 100% !important;
    max-width: var(
      --inner-corridor-width,
      var(--inner-corridor-width)
    ) !important;
    margin-right: auto !important;
    margin-left: auto !important;
    align-self: center !important;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  .top-scarcity-bar {
    font-size: var(--size-0_78rem);
  }

  .top-bar-inner {
    justify-content: center;
    text-align: center;
  }

  .site-navbar {
    top: 0;
  }

  .nav-links {
    display: flex;
    opacity: 0;
    visibility: hidden;
    pointer-events: none;
    transform: translateY(calc(-1 * var(--space-unit)));
    transition:
      opacity var(--transition-smooth),
      transform var(--transition-smooth),
      visibility var(--motion-duration-instant) linear var(--motion-duration-surface);
    flex-direction: column;
    position: absolute;
    top: 100%;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    background: var(--color-rgba-16-19-23-0-98);
    backdrop-filter: blur(var(--space-md));

    border-bottom: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-subtle);
    padding: var(--space-md) var(--size-20px);
    gap: var(--space-sm);
    box-shadow: 0 var(--size-20px) var(--size-40px) var(--color-rgba-0-0-0-0-5);
    z-index: var(--layer-navigation-menu);
  }

  .nav-links.is-open {
    opacity: 1;
    visibility: visible;
    pointer-events: auto;
    transform: none;
    transition-delay: var(--motion-duration-instant);
  }

  .nav-links .nav-link-item a {
    min-height: var(--size-44px);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    font-size: var(--size-1rem);
    padding: var(--space-sm) var(--space-control);
    border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
    border-bottom: var(--size-1px) solid var(--border-hairline);
  }

  .nav-links .nav-link-item:last-child a {
    border-bottom: none;
  }

  .mobile-nav-toggle {
    display: inline-flex;
  }

  .clients-single-line {
    white-space: normal;
  }

  .clients-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
    gap: var(--space-md);
  }

  .transform-stages-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: var(--space-xl);
  }

  .stage-desc {
    min-height: auto;
  }

  .testimonials-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  }

  .instructor-layout {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: var(--space-2xl);
  }

  .guarantee-card {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    text-align: center;
    justify-items: center;
    border-right-width: var(--size-1px);
    border-top: var(--dimension-4) solid var(--primary-red);
  }
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .site-header {
    position: -webkit-sticky !important;
    position: sticky !important;
    top: 0 !important;
    z-index: var(--layer-navigation) !important;
  }

  .top-scarcity-bar {
    height: auto;
    min-height: var(--space-2xl);
    padding: var(--size-6px) var(--space-control);
  }

  .top-scarcity-nav-capsule {
    height: auto;
    min-height: var(--size-38px);
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: var(--size-6px) var(--space-detail);
    font-size: var(--size-0_82rem);
    padding: var(--size-6px) var(--space-control);
  }

  .clients-single-line {
    white-space: normal;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    gap: var(--space-xs);
    font-size: clamp(
      var(--size-1_15rem),
      var(--size-4_2vw),
      var(--size-1_55rem)
    );
    line-height: var(--leading-label);
    text-align: center;
  }

  .clients-single-line span {
    display: block;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }

  .transformation-frame-card {
    padding: var(--space-md) var(--size-10px);
    margin-bottom: var(--space-md);
  }

  .transform-headline {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    gap: var(--size-6px);
    font-size: clamp(
      var(--size-0_92rem),
      var(--size-3_4vw),
      var(--size-1_25rem)
    );
    line-height: var(--leading-control);
    text-align: center;
  }

  .trans-from {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    text-align: center;
    white-space: nowrap;
    color: var(--text-secondary);
  }

  .trans-arrow {
    display: none;
  }

  .trans-to {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    text-align: center;
    white-space: nowrap;
    color: var(--text-primary);
    font-size: var(--size-0_98em);
  }

  .roadmap-highlight-box {
    padding: var(--space-detail) var(--size-10px);
  }

  .roadmap-highlight-pills {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    gap: var(--space-sm);
    width: 100%;
  }

  .formula-line-inputs {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: row;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-wrap: nowrap;
    gap: var(--size-3px);
    width: 100%;
  }

  .formula-line-inputs .pill-item {
    font-size: clamp(
      var(--size-0_62rem),
      var(--size-2_1vw),
      var(--size-0_76rem)
    );
    padding: var(--size-3px) var(--size-6px);
    white-space: nowrap;
  }

  .formula-line-inputs .pill-sep {
    font-size: var(--size-0_8rem);
    font-weight: var(--weight-heavy);
  }

  .formula-line-result {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    width: 100%;
  }

  .formula-line-result .pill-item-accent {
    font-size: clamp(
      var(--size-0_78rem),
      var(--size-2_7vw),
      var(--size-0_92rem)
    );
    padding: var(--size-5px) var(--space-detail);
    white-space: nowrap;
  }

  .roadmap-timeline {
    gap: var(--space-lg);
    padding-right: var(--size-28px);
  }

  .timeline-track,
  .timeline-progress {
    right: var(--size-13px);
    width: var(--size-2px);
  }

  .day-item {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: var(--space-control);
    width: 100%;
    position: relative;
  }

  .timeline-marker.day-number-col,
  .day-number-col {
    width: auto;
    justify-content: flex-start;
    position: relative;
  }

  .timeline-marker::before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    right: var(--size-negative-21px);
    top: 50%;
    transform: translateY(-50%);
    width: var(--dimension-12);
    height: var(--dimension-12);
    border-radius: 50%;
    background-color: var(--bg-main);
    border: var(--size-2px) solid var(--color-rgba-255-255-255-0-22);
    z-index: var(--layer-timeline-top);
    transition:
      border-color var(--transition-fast),
      background-color var(--transition-fast),
      box-shadow var(--transition-smooth);
  }

  .day-item.is-passed .timeline-marker::before {
    border-color: var(--color-rgba-252-53-34-0-7);
    background-color: var(--primary-red);
    box-shadow: 0 0 var(--shadow-offset-8) var(--color-rgba-252-53-34-0-45);
  }

  .day-item.is-active .timeline-marker::before {
    border-color: var(--text-primary);
    background-color: var(--primary-red);
    box-shadow: 0 0 var(--shadow-offset-12) var(--primary-red);
  }

  .day-badge-num {
    width: auto;
    min-width: var(--size-110px);
    height: var(--size-34px);
    flex-direction: row;
    align-items: center;
    gap: var(--space-sm);
    padding: var(--space-xs) var(--space-detail);
    border-radius: var(--radius-full);
    background-color: var(--bg-main) !important;
  }

  .day-badge-digit {
    font-size: var(--size-1rem);
    line-height: var(--leading-solid);
  }

  .day-badge-text {
    font-size: var(--size-0_78rem);
    font-weight: var(--weight-bold);
    line-height: var(--leading-solid);
  }

  .day-card {
    width: 100%;
    padding: var(--space-comfortable) var(--space-md);
  }

  .day-card-header {
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: var(--space-sm);
  }

  .day-card-title {
    font-size: var(--size-1_15rem);
  }

  .day-lessons-list li {
    font-size: var(--size-0_92rem);
  }

  .btn-primary {
    width: 100%;
    padding: var(--space-md) var(--size-20px);
    font-size: var(--size-1_05rem);
    min-height: var(--size-50px);
    justify-content: center;
  }

  .testimonials-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: var(--space-md);
  }

  .clients-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr) !important;
    gap: var(--size-10px);
  }

  .client-tagline {
    font-size: clamp(
      var(--size-0_78rem),
      var(--size-2_5vw),
      var(--size-0_92rem)
    );
    line-height: var(--leading-label);
    margin-bottom: var(--space-xs);
  }

  .client-meta-row {
    gap: var(--size-6px);
  }

  .client-tag {
    font-size: var(--size-0_68rem);
    padding: var(--size-2px) var(--size-6px);
  }

  .client-views-badge {
    font-size: var(--size-0_7rem);
    padding: var(--size-2px) var(--size-6px);
  }

  .guarantee-card {
    display: flex !important;
    flex-direction: column !important;
    align-items: center !important;
    text-align: center !important;
    padding: clamp(var(--space-lg), var(--size-5vw), var(--size-36px))
      var(--space-md);
    gap: var(--space-md);
    border-right-width: var(--size-1px);
    border-top: var(--dimension-4) solid var(--primary-red);
  }

  .guarantee-icon-box {
    margin: 0 auto;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
  }

  .guarantee-copy {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    text-align: center;
    width: 100%;
  }

  .guarantee-copy .eyebrow {
    margin-left: auto !important;
    margin-right: auto !important;
    margin-bottom: var(--size-10px) !important;
    align-self: center !important;
  }

  .guarantee-headline {
    text-align: center;
    font-size: clamp(
      var(--size-1_25rem),
      var(--size-3_5vw),
      var(--size-1_55rem)
    );
    margin-bottom: var(--space-sm);
    width: 100%;
  }

  .guarantee-text {
    text-align: center;
    font-size: var(--size-0_94rem);
    max-width: 100%;
    margin: 0 auto;
  }

  .faq-question-btn {
    padding: var(--size-13px) var(--space-control);
    min-height: var(--space-2xl);
    gap: var(--space-sm);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
  }

  .faq-question-btn span {
    font-size: clamp(
      var(--size-0_75rem),
      var(--size-2_6vw),
      var(--size-0_92rem)
    );
    line-height: var(--leading-label);
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    text-align: right;
  }

  .faq-answer-inner:not(:has(> .faq-answer-content)) {
    padding: 0 var(--space-md) var(--space-md);
    font-size: var(--size-0_92rem);
  }

  .final-cta-box {
    padding: clamp(var(--space-xl), var(--size-6vw), var(--size-54px))
      clamp(var(--space-md), var(--size-4vw), var(--size-28px));
    gap: var(--space-md);
  }

  .final-cta-headline {
    font-size: clamp(
      var(--size-1_45rem),
      var(--size-4_5vw),
      var(--size-2_1rem)
    );
  }

  .final-cta-sub {
    font-size: var(--size-0_95rem);
  }

  .final-btn-wrapper .btn-primary {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 100%;
  }

  .final-btn-wrapper .cta-microcopy {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 100%;
    font-size: var(--size-0_8rem);
  }

  .footer-layout {
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    text-align: center;
    gap: var(--size-20px);
  }

  .footer-brand {
    align-items: center;
    text-align: center;
  }

  .footer-social-wrapper {
    align-items: center;
    text-align: center;
  }

  .footer-social-links {
    justify-content: center;
  }

  .recent-signup-toast {
    right: var(--size-10px);
    left: auto;
    bottom: var(--size-10px);
    max-width: var(--size-152px);
  }
}

@media (max-width: 480px) {
  .top-bar-sep {
    display: none !important;
  }

  .top-scarcity-nav-capsule {
    padding: var(--space-xs) var(--space-sm);
    justify-content: space-between;
    width: 100%;
  }

  .timer-unit-box b {
    font-size: var(--size-0_92rem);
  }

  .timer-unit-box small {
    font-size: var(--size-0_7rem);
  }

  .nav-brand-title {
    font-size: var(--size-1_1rem);
  }

  .nav-cta-btn {
    padding: var(--size-6px) var(--space-control) !important;
    font-size: var(--size-0_8rem) !important;
    height: var(--size-36px);
  }
}

@media (max-width: 374px) {
  .top-timer-label {
    display: none !important;
  }

  .day-badge-num {
    min-width: var(--size-95px);
    padding: var(--size-3px) var(--size-10px);
    height: var(--size-30px);
  }

  .day-badge-digit {
    font-size: var(--size-0_9rem);
  }

  .day-badge-text {
    font-size: var(--size-0_72rem);
  }

  .btn-primary {
    padding: var(--space-detail) var(--space-md);
    font-size: var(--size-0_96rem);
  }

  .client-meta-row {
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: var(--size-2px);
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  *,
  *::before,
  *::after {
    animation-duration: var(--size-0_01ms) !important;
    animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
    transition-duration: var(--size-0_01ms) !important;
    transition-delay: var(--motion-duration-instant) !important;
    animation-delay: var(--motion-duration-instant) !important;
    scroll-behavior: auto !important;
  }
  .timeline-progress {
    transition: none !important;
  }
  .creators-track {
    animation: none !important;
  }
}

/* Functional accessibility, with the original visual styling. */
.roadmap-title {
  margin-bottom: var(--space-heading-tight);
}
.roadmap-intro {
  margin: 0 auto;
}
.testimonials-summary {
  max-width: var(--measure-testimonial-summary);
}
.featured-eyebrow {
  margin-bottom: 0;
}
.guarantee-eyebrow {
  margin-bottom: var(--space-sm);
}
.hero-video-placeholder {
  width: 100%;
  color: inherit;
  font: inherit;
}
.faq-item.is-active .faq-answer-panel {
  grid-template-rows: 1fr;
  opacity: 1;
}
.hero-video-placeholder:focus-visible {
  outline-offset: calc(-1 * var(--space-xs));
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  html {
    scroll-behavior: auto;
  }
  *,
  *::before,
  *::after {
    animation: none !important;
    transition: none !important;
  }
  .creators-track {
    animation: none;
  }
  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    .day-item:hover .day-card {
      transform: none;
    }
  }
}

/* Shared click feedback stays faster than hover/entrance motion. */
.btn-primary,
.nav-cta-btn,
.video-play-button,
.reel-play-btn {
  transition:
    transform var(--transition-smooth),
    scale var(--motion-duration-press) var(--motion-easing),
    color var(--transition-fast),
    background-color var(--transition-fast),
    border-color var(--transition-fast),
    box-shadow var(--transition-smooth);
}
.btn-primary:active,
.nav-cta-btn:active,
.video-play-button:active,
.reel-play-btn:active {
  scale: var(--motion-press-scale);
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .btn-primary:active,
  .nav-cta-btn:active,
  .video-play-button:active,
  .reel-play-btn:active {
    scale: none;
  }
}

.testimonials-more {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  margin-top: var(--space-xl);
}
.testimonials-more-button {
  border: 0;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--primary-red);
  font: inherit;
  font-weight: var(--weight-bold);
  padding: var(--space-control) var(--space-md);
  text-underline-offset: var(--space-xs);
}
.testimonials-more-button:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
.testimonials-more-button:focus-visible {
  outline: var(--size-2px) solid var(--primary-red);
  outline-offset: var(--space-xs);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
}
.review-revealed { animation: playerFadeIn var(--motion-duration-surface) var(--motion-easing); }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .review-revealed { animation: none; } }
```

```typescript
export interface VideoPlayerLabels {
  play: string;
  pause: string;
  replay: string;
  mute: string;
  unmute: string;
  seek: string;
  volume: string;
  enterFullscreen: string;
  exitFullscreen: string;
  loading: string;
  error: string;
  retry: string;
  controls: string;
}
export interface YouTubePlayerInstance {
  playVideo(): void;
  pauseVideo(): void;
  seekTo(seconds: number, allowSeekAhead: boolean): void;
  mute(): void;
  unMute(): void;
  isMuted(): boolean;
  setVolume(volume: number): void;
  getVolume(): number;
  getCurrentTime(): number;
  getDuration(): number;
  destroy(): void;
}
export interface YouTubePlayerEvent {
  target: YouTubePlayerInstance;
  data?: number;
}
export interface YouTubeAPI {
  Player: new (
    element: HTMLIFrameElement,
    options: {
      events: {
        onReady(event: YouTubePlayerEvent): void;
        onStateChange(event: YouTubePlayerEvent): void;
        onError(event: YouTubePlayerEvent): void;
        onAutoplayBlocked(event: YouTubePlayerEvent): void;
      };
    },
  ) => YouTubePlayerInstance;
}
export type PlayerStatus =
  "loading" | "playing" | "paused" | "buffering" | "ended" | "error";
export interface PlayerSnapshot {
  status: PlayerStatus;
  ready: boolean;
  time: number;
  duration: number;
  volume: number;
  muted: boolean;
}

export interface PlayerController {
  snapshot: PlayerSnapshot;
  toggle(): void;
  seek(time: number): void;
  toggleMute(): void;
  volume(value: number): void;
  retry(): void;
}
export interface FileVideoSource {
  kind: "file";
  url: string;
  poster?: string;
}

export type PlayerControlsVariant = "full" | "overlay";

export type VideoSourceProps =
  { url: string; source?: never } | { source: FileVideoSource; url?: never };
```

### File: `packages/design-system/ui/action-menu.tsx`

SHA-256: `f42c00f4208cacd4cad357b44f2b3e18f75ac11055d958f2f13fa607dae1ffdd`

```tsx
"use client";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useId } from "react";
import { useActionMenu } from "../hooks/use-action-menu";
import type { ActionMenuProps } from "../types/action-menu";
export default function ActionMenu({ trigger, label, links, action, error }: ActionMenuProps) {
  const id = useId();
  const { button, panel, open, setOpen, close, toggle, keyDown } = useActionMenu();
  return <div className="ds-action-menu" onKeyDown={keyDown} onBlur={event => {
    if (!event.currentTarget.contains(event.relatedTarget)) close();
  }}>
    <button ref={button} type="button" className="ds-action-trigger" aria-label={label} aria-expanded={open} aria-controls={id} onClick={toggle}>{trigger}</button>
    <div ref={panel} popover="auto" id={id} className="ds-action-panel" onToggle={event => setOpen(event.newState === "open")}>
      <nav aria-label={label}>{links.map(link => <Link key={link.href} href={link.href} target={link.external ? "_blank" : undefined} rel={link.external ? "noopener noreferrer" : undefined} onClick={close}>{link.label}</Link>)}</nav>
      <button type="button" className="ds-action-logout" disabled={action.disabled} onClick={action.onSelect}>{action.label}</button>
      {error && <p className="lms-error" role="alert">{error}</p>}
    </div>
  </div>;
}
```

### File: `packages/design-system/ui/action.tsx`

SHA-256: `c28b82f07e28289692b4d61887908beb85cf8c861dc080af12c16b576bb0a608`

```tsx
import Link from "next/link";
import type { ComponentPropsWithoutRef, ReactNode } from "react";
type Common = { children: ReactNode; className?: string };
export type ActionProps = Common &
  (
    | ({ kind: "button" } & Omit<
        ComponentPropsWithoutRef<"button">,
        "children"
      >)
    | ({ kind: "link"; href: string } & Omit<
        ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof Link>,
        "children"
      >)
    | ({ kind: "anchor"; href: string } & Omit<
        ComponentPropsWithoutRef<"a">,
        "children"
      >)
  );
export default function Action(props: ActionProps) {
  if (props.kind === "button") {
    const { kind, ...rest } = props;
    void kind;
    return <button type="button" {...rest} />;
  }
  if (props.kind === "link") {
    const { kind, ...rest } = props;
    void kind;
    return <Link {...rest} />;
  }
  const { kind, ...rest } = props;
  void kind;
  return <a {...rest} />;
}
```

```tsx
import type { CSSProperties } from "react";

export interface ComingSoonProps {
  label: string;
  detail?: string;
  className?: string;
  width?: CSSProperties["width"];
  height?: CSSProperties["height"];
  aspectRatio?: CSSProperties["aspectRatio"];
  color?: string;
}

/** Theme-aware artwork for any upcoming course, feature or release. */
export default function ComingSoon({
  label,
  detail,
  className = "",
  width = "100%",
  height,
  aspectRatio = "16 / 9",
  color,
}: ComingSoonProps) {
  const style: CSSProperties & { "--coming-soon-accent"?: string } = {
    width,
    height,
    aspectRatio: height === undefined ? aspectRatio : undefined,

  };
  return (

      <div className="coming-soon-art" aria-hidden="true">
        <span className="coming-soon-ghost">{detail ?? label}</span>

          {Array.from({ length: 5 }, (_, index) => (

          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="coming-soon-copy">
        <span className="coming-soon-label">{label}</span>
        {detail && <span className="coming-soon-detail">{detail}</span>}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### File: `packages/design-system/ui/deferred-video-player.tsx`

SHA-256: `25e2e80f81256106232223ac316733d68a835740ffe4393c8a8a5ab74cdbfb49`

```tsx
"use client";
import { lazy, Suspense, useCallback, useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { useExclusivePlayer } from "../hooks/use-exclusive-player";
import { getControlledYouTubeUrl } from "../helpers/media/youtube/controlled-url";
const NativeVideoPlayer = lazy(() => import("./native-video-player"));
import type {
  VideoSourceProps,
  PlayerControlsVariant,
  VideoPlayerLabels,
} from "../types/video-player";
const YouTubePlayer = lazy(() => import("./youtube-player"));
export default function DeferredVideoPlayer({
  url,
  source,
  controlsVariant,
  returnToPosterOnEnd = false,
  onActivate,
  onDeactivate,
  title,
  labels,
  playLabel,
  placeholderClassName,
  children,
}: {
  controlsVariant?: PlayerControlsVariant;
  returnToPosterOnEnd?: boolean;
  onActivate?: () => void;
  onDeactivate?: () => void;
  title: string;
  labels: VideoPlayerLabels;
  playLabel: string;
  placeholderClassName: string;
  children: ReactNode;
} & VideoSourceProps) {
  const [activation, setActivation] = useState<{
    url: string;
    embed: string;
  } | null>(null);
  const reset = useCallback(() => {
    setActivation(null);
    onDeactivate?.();
  }, [onDeactivate]);
  const claimPlayback = useExclusivePlayer(reset);
  const resolvedUrl = source?.url ?? url ?? "";
  if (activation?.url === resolvedUrl && source)
    return (
      <Suspense fallback={<div className={placeholderClassName} aria-label={labels.loading}>{children}</div>}><NativeVideoPlayer
        key={resolvedUrl}
        source={source}
        onEnded={returnToPosterOnEnd ? reset : undefined}
        onPlay={claimPlayback}
        controlsVariant={controlsVariant}
        title={title}
        labels={labels}
      /></Suspense>
    );
  if (activation?.url === resolvedUrl)
    return (
      <Suspense fallback={<div className={placeholderClassName} aria-label={labels.loading}>{children}</div>}><YouTubePlayer
        key={activation.embed}
        url={activation.embed}
        controlsVariant={controlsVariant}
        onEnded={returnToPosterOnEnd ? reset : undefined}
        onPlay={claimPlayback}
        title={title}
        labels={labels}
      /></Suspense>
    );
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      className={placeholderClassName}
      onClick={() => {
        const embed = source
          ? resolvedUrl
          : getControlledYouTubeUrl(resolvedUrl, window.location.origin);
        if (embed) {
          onActivate?.();
          claimPlayback();
          setActivation({ url: resolvedUrl, embed });
        }
      }}
      aria-label={playLabel}
    >
      {children}
    </button>
  );
}
```

```tsx
          onToggle={() => toggle(index)}
        />
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { preload } from "react-dom";

/** Register resource hints during server rendering, including streamed layouts. */
export default function FontPreloads({
  assets,
}: {
  assets: readonly string[];
}) {
  for (const href of assets) {
    preload(href, { as: "font", type: "font/ttf", crossOrigin: "anonymous" });
  }
  return null;
}
```

```tsx
          videoUrl={content.source.url}

          labels={content.controls}
          playLabel={content.playLabel}
          width="100%"
          height="100%"
          thumbnailLoading="eager"

          placeholderClassName="hero-video-placeholder"
          playButtonClassName="video-play-button"
        >
          <span className="video-meta-label" hidden>
            {content.caption}
          </span>
          <span className="video-meta-time" hidden>
            {content.hint}
          </span>
        </MediaPlayer>
      </div>
    );
  return (
    <div className="hero-video-shell">
      <DeferredVideoPlayer
        {...(content.source
          ? { source: content.source }
          : { url: content.url })}
        controlsVariant={content.controlsVariant}
        returnToPosterOnEnd={content.returnToPosterOnEnd}
        title={content.title}
        labels={content.controls}
        playLabel={content.playLabel}
        placeholderClassName="hero-video-placeholder"
      >
        <span className="video-play-button" aria-hidden="true">
          <Icon name="play" />
        </span>
        <span className="video-meta-label" hidden={Boolean(content.poster)}>
          {content.caption}
        </span>
        <span className="video-meta-time" hidden={Boolean(content.poster)}>
          {content.hint}
        </span>
      </DeferredVideoPlayer>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### File: `packages/design-system/ui/history-boundary.tsx`

SHA-256: `4a29496c3e64c3a7632f7856c5274ea89081ae2b08cfa8d7440c6e6a6c42657d`

```tsx
"use client";
import { createContext, useContext, useEffect, useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
const HistoryRestoration = createContext(0);
/** Persist history notifications across route unmounts, including visits to public pages. */
export default function HistoryBoundary({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const [restoration, setRestoration] = useState(0);
  useEffect(() => {
    const restored = () => setRestoration(value => value + 1);
    window.addEventListener("popstate", restored);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("popstate", restored);
  }, []);
  return <HistoryRestoration.Provider value={restoration}>{children}</HistoryRestoration.Provider>;
}
export function useHistoryRestoration() { return useContext(HistoryRestoration); }
```

### File: `packages/design-system/ui/media-player.tsx`

SHA-256: `dfcedc30a83667fcca76ecd52d2edaedfacfffb8f136f5a15e108ae97f3d72ce`

```tsx
"use client";
import { useMediaPlayerSession } from "../hooks/use-media-player-session";
import { mediaPlayerStyle } from "../helpers/media/appearance";
import type { MediaPlayerProps } from "../types/media-player";
import { arabicPlayerLabels } from "../lib/player-labels";
import DeferredVideoPlayer from "./deferred-video-player";
import PlayerIcon from "./player-icon";

/** Portable native-file player: configuration changes appearance, not playback logic. */
export default function MediaPlayer({
  videoUrl,
  thumbnailUrl,
  title,
  width,
  height,
  aspectRatio = "16 / 9",
  color,
  controlsVariant = "overlay",
  returnToPosterOnEnd = true,
  fullscreenOnPlay = false,
  resetOnScrollOut = true,
  labels = arabicPlayerLabels,
  playLabel,
  className = "",
  placeholderClassName = "",
  playButtonClassName = "",
  thumbnailLoading = "lazy",
  children,
}: MediaPlayerProps) {
  const { ref, generation, fullscreen, supported, enterFullscreen, exitFullscreen } = useMediaPlayerSession(resetOnScrollOut);
  const style = mediaPlayerStyle({ width, height, aspectRatio, color });
  return (
    <div ref={ref} className={`media-player ${className}`.trim()} style={style}
      tabIndex={-1}
      onKeyDown={(event) => {
        if (event.key === "Escape" && fullscreen) {
          event.preventDefault();
          void exitFullscreen();
        }
      }}
    >
      <DeferredVideoPlayer
        key={`${videoUrl}:${generation}`}
        source={{ kind: "file", url: videoUrl, poster: thumbnailUrl }}
        title={title ?? labels.controls}
        labels={labels}
        playLabel={playLabel ?? labels.play}
        controlsVariant={controlsVariant}
        returnToPosterOnEnd={returnToPosterOnEnd}
        onActivate={fullscreenOnPlay ? () => void enterFullscreen() : undefined}
        onDeactivate={exitFullscreen}
        placeholderClassName={`media-player-poster ${placeholderClassName}`.trim()}
      >
        {/* Arbitrary thumbnail URLs stay portable and bypass Next image-host configuration. */}
        {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
        <img
          src={thumbnailUrl}
          alt=""
          loading={thumbnailLoading}
          decoding="async"
          fetchPriority={thumbnailLoading === "eager" ? "high" : undefined}
        />
        <span
          className={`media-player-toggle ${playButtonClassName}`.trim()}
          aria-hidden="true"
        >
          <PlayerIcon name="play" />
        </span>
        {children}
      </DeferredVideoPlayer>
      {supported ? (
        <button
          type="button"
          className={`media-player-fullscreen custom-video-control${fullscreen ? " is-fullscreen" : ""}`}
          aria-label={fullscreen ? labels.exitFullscreen : labels.enterFullscreen}
          title={fullscreen ? labels.exitFullscreen : labels.enterFullscreen}
          onClick={() => void (fullscreen ? exitFullscreen() : enterFullscreen())}
        >
          <PlayerIcon name={fullscreen ? "exit-fullscreen" : "fullscreen"} />
        </button>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}
```

### File: `packages/design-system/ui/player-shell.tsx`

SHA-256: `ab7523d136189c5ab23690f8548cef6b87000929009b3ab7a5aac91ad59969c9`

```tsx
"use client";
import { useRef, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { usePlayerFullscreen } from "../hooks/use-player-fullscreen";
import { getPlaybackAction } from "../helpers/media/playback-action";
import { handlePlayerKey } from "../helpers/media/player-keyboard";
import type {
  PlayerController,
  PlayerControlsVariant,
  VideoPlayerLabels,
} from "../types/video-player";
import PlayerIcon from "./player-icon";
import VideoControls from "./video-controls";
export default function PlayerShell({
  title,
  labels,
  controller,
  children,
  controlsVariant = "full",
}: {
  title: string;
  labels: VideoPlayerLabels;
  controller: PlayerController;
  children: ReactNode;
  controlsVariant?: PlayerControlsVariant;
}) {
  const shellRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const { snapshot, toggle, retry } = controller;
  const { fullscreen, supported, toggleFullscreen } =
    usePlayerFullscreen(shellRef);
  const action = getPlaybackAction(snapshot, labels);
  return (
    <div
      className={`custom-video-player${controlsVariant === "overlay" ? " custom-video-player--overlay" : ""}`}
      ref={shellRef}
      tabIndex={0}
      role="region"
      aria-label={title}
      onKeyDown={(event) => handlePlayerKey(event, controller, toggleFullscreen)}
    >
      <div className="custom-video-stage" onClick={(event) => {
        if (event.target instanceof HTMLVideoElement && snapshot.ready) {
          shellRef.current?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
          toggle();
        }
      }}>
        {children}
        {controlsVariant === "overlay" && (snapshot.status === "paused" || snapshot.status === "ended") ? (
          <button
            type="button"
            className="custom-video-overlay-toggle"
            aria-label={action.label}
            title={action.label}
            disabled={!snapshot.ready}
            onClick={() => {
              shellRef.current?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
              toggle();
            }}
          >
            <PlayerIcon name={action.icon} />
          </button>
        ) : null}
      </div>
      {controlsVariant === "full" ? (
        <VideoControls
          state={snapshot}
          labels={labels}
          toggle={toggle}
          seek={controller.seek}
          toggleMute={controller.toggleMute}
          volume={controller.volume}
          fullscreen={fullscreen}
          fullscreenSupported={supported}
          toggleFullscreen={() => void toggleFullscreen()}
        />
      ) : null}
      {snapshot.status === "loading" || snapshot.status === "buffering" ? (
        <span className="custom-video-status" role="status">
          {labels.loading}
        </span>
      ) : null}
      {snapshot.status === "error" ? (
        <div className="custom-video-error" role="alert">
          <p>{labels.error}</p>
          <button type="button" className="custom-video-retry" onClick={retry}>
            {labels.retry}
          </button>
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";
import { useId, useState } from "react";
import type { TestimonialsContent } from "../types/marketing";
import ReviewCard from "./review-card";

export default function ReviewList({ reviews, expansion }: Pick<TestimonialsContent, "reviews" | "expansion">) {
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(false);
  const id = useId();
  const count = expansion ? Math.max(0, expansion.initialCount) : reviews.length;
  const visibleReviews = expanded ? reviews : reviews.slice(0, count);
  return (
    <>
      <div id={id} className="testimonials-grid">
        {visibleReviews.map((review, index) => (
          <div key={`${review.name}:${index}`} className={expanded && index >= count ? "review-revealed" : undefined}>
            <ReviewCard {...review} />
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
      {expansion && !expanded && count < reviews.length ? (
        <div className="testimonials-more">
          <button type="button" className="testimonials-more-button" aria-controls={id} aria-expanded={expanded} onClick={() => setExpanded(true)}>
            {expansion.showMoreLabel}
          </button>
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </>
  );
}
```

### File: `packages/design-system/ui/rich-text.tsx`

SHA-256: `e675e0fbfcbbf9115b1d717081df89f72cd709ed6511a293f480b6e178a7d76f`

```tsx
import { Fragment } from "react";
import Icon from "./ui-icon";
import type { RichTextContent } from "../types/ui";

export default function RichText({ content }: { content: RichTextContent }) {
  return content.map((part, index) => {
    if (typeof part === "string")
      return <Fragment key={index}>{part}</Fragment>;
    if (part.kind === "break") return <br key={index} />;
    const Tag = part.kind === "strong" ? "b" : "span";
    return (
      <Tag
        key={index}
        className={part.className}
        aria-hidden={part.decorative || undefined}
      >
        {part.icon && <Icon {...part.icon} fill="currentColor" />}
        <RichText content={part.children} />
      </Tag>
    );
  });
}
```
