```typescript
/* eslint-disable @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports -- Real isolated database and browser fixtures. */
const { Client } = require('pg');
const { chromium, expect } = require('@playwright/test');
module.exports = async function userSearchChecks({ admin, provision, anonymous, verify, url, config }) {
  const manager = await provision('Search Manager');
  await admin.from('admin_users').insert({ user_id: manager.id });
  const prefix = `Filter-${Date.now()}`, fixtures = [];
  for (let index = 0; index < 8; index++) fixtures.push(await provision(`${prefix} Account ${index}`));
  const [suspended, banned, old, expired, promoted] = fixtures;
  await manager.api(`/api/admin/users/${suspended.id}`, { action: 'suspend', period: 'week' });
  await manager.api(`/api/admin/users/${banned.id}`, { action: 'ban' });
  await manager.api(`/api/admin/users/${promoted.id}`, { action: 'promote' });
  const db = new Client({ connectionString: config.DB_URL });
  await db.connect();
  try {
    await db.query("update auth.users set created_at = now() - interval '30 days' where id = $1", [old.id]);
    await db.query("update auth.users set banned_until = now() - interval '1 minute' where id = $1", [expired.id]);
  } finally { await db.end(); }
  const params = { p_page: 1, p_limit: 5, p_search: '', p_statuses: [], p_admins_only: false };
  verify(Boolean((await fixtures[5].direct.rpc('search_admin_users', params)).error), 'Database rejects direct student user search');
  verify((await anonymous('/api/admin/users?q=' + prefix)).status === 401, 'Anonymous cannot search accounts');
  const get = async query => { const response = await manager.api('/api/admin/users?' + query); verify(response.status === 200, `Search request succeeds: ${query}`); return JSON.parse(response.data); };
  const first = await get('q=' + prefix), second = await get('q=' + prefix + '&page=2');
  verify(first.users.length === 5 && first.total === 8 && first.hasNext, 'Search paginates five of eight matches');
  verify(second.users.length === 3 && second.total === 8 && !second.hasNext, 'Second page includes remaining matches');
  verify(new Set([...first.users, ...second.users].map(user => user.id)).size === 8, 'Pages contain no overlapping or missing accounts');
  const specific = await get('q=' + encodeURIComponent(old.email.toUpperCase()));
  verify(specific.users.length === 1 && specific.users[0].id === old.id, 'Case-insensitive email search finds account beyond first page');
  const username = (await manager.api('/api/admin/users/' + old.id)).data;
  const byUsername = await get('q=' + JSON.parse(username).user.username);
  verify(byUsername.users[0]?.id === old.id, 'Username search works');
  const blocked = await get('q=' + prefix + '&status=suspended');
  verify(blocked.total === 1 && blocked.users[0].id === suspended.id, 'Suspended filter excludes permanent bans and expired suspension');
  const bannedOnly = await get('q=' + prefix + '&status=banned');
  verify(bannedOnly.total === 1 && bannedOnly.users[0].id === banned.id, 'Banned filter matches permanent restriction');
  const both = await get('q=' + prefix + '&status=suspended&status=banned&newcomers=1');
  verify(both.total === 2, 'Both status filters combine with search and newcomer window');
  const admins = await get('q=' + prefix + '&admins=1&newcomers=1');
  verify(admins.total === 1 && admins.users[0].id === promoted.id, 'Admin and newcomer filters intersect with search');
  const newcomers = await get('q=' + prefix + '&newcomers=1');
  verify(newcomers.total === 7 && !newcomers.users.some(user => user.id === old.id), 'Newcomers excludes accounts older than seven days');
  verify((await get('q=' + prefix + '&admins=1&status=banned')).total === 0, 'Contradictory filters show an empty result');
  verify((await get('q=' + encodeURIComponent("%' OR 1=1 --"))).total === 0, 'Search treats wildcard and SQL syntax literally');
  for (const query of ['status=unknown', 'admins=yes', 'newcomers=30', 'q=' + 'x'.repeat(101)])
    verify((await manager.api('/api/admin/users?' + query)).status === 400, `Malformed query rejected: ${query.slice(0, 30)}`);
  const browser = await chromium.launch({ headless: true });
  try {
    const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width: 390, height: 900 } });
    const errors = []; page.on('pageerror', error => errors.push(error.message));
    await page.goto(url + '/login');
    await page.getByLabel('البريد الإلكتروني', { exact: true }).fill(manager.email);
    await page.getByLabel('كلمة المرور', { exact: true }).fill(manager.password);
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'تسجيل الدخول', exact: true }).click();
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(url + '/admin/dashboard');
    await page.goto(url + '/admin/dashboard/users');
    await page.getByRole('searchbox').fill(prefix);
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'تطبيق البحث والفلاتر' }).click();
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(new RegExp('q=' + prefix));
    await expect(page.locator('.lms-admin-table tbody tr')).toHaveCount(5);
    await page.getByRole('link', { name: 'التالي', exact: true }).click();
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(new RegExp('page=2.*q=' + prefix));
    await expect(page.locator('.lms-admin-table tbody tr')).toHaveCount(3);
    await page.getByLabel('المنضمون خلال آخر ٧ أيام').check();
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'تطبيق البحث والفلاتر' }).click();
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(new RegExp('newcomers=1'));
    verify(!new URL(page.url()).searchParams.has('page'), 'Changing filters resets pagination to page one');
    await expect(page.locator('.lms-admin-table tbody tr')).toHaveCount(5);
    await page.getByLabel('معلّق', { exact: true }).check();
    await page.getByLabel('محظور', { exact: true }).check();
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'تطبيق البحث والفلاتر' }).click();
    await expect(page.locator('.lms-admin-table tbody tr')).toHaveCount(2);
    verify(await page.getByRole('searchbox').inputValue() === prefix, 'Combined filters preserve search');
    await page.screenshot({ path: 'docs/evidence/admin-dashboard/filters-mobile.png', fullPage: true });
    await page.reload(); await expect(page.getByLabel('معلّق', { exact: true })).toBeChecked();
    await page.goBack(); await expect(page.getByLabel('معلّق', { exact: true })).not.toBeChecked();
    verify(true, 'Filter values survive refresh and browser history');
    for (const width of [320, 390, 768, 1440]) {
      await page.setViewportSize({ width, height: 900 });
      verify(await page.evaluate(() => Math.max(document.body.scrollWidth, document.documentElement.scrollWidth) <= innerWidth), `Search/filter UI fits ${width}px`);
    }
    await page.getByRole('link', { name: 'مسح الفلاتر', exact: true }).click();
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(url + '/admin/dashboard/users');
    await expect(page.getByRole('searchbox')).toHaveValue('');
    verify((await page.locator('.lms-admin-table tbody tr').count()) <= 5, 'Clear filters keeps five-record page limit');
    verify(errors.length === 0, 'Search/filter browser has no JavaScript errors');
  } finally { await browser.close(); }
};
```

```typescript
/* eslint-disable @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports -- Isolated real Auth, API, RLS and browser acceptance tests. */
module.exports = async function userManagementChecks({ admin, provision, anonymous, student, verify, url }) {
  const manager = await provision('User Manager'), target = await provision('Moderation Student');
  await admin.from('admin_users').insert({ user_id: manager.id });
  const base = '/api/admin/users', endpoint = `${base}/${target.id}`;
  const json = response => JSON.parse(response.data);
  verify((await anonymous(base)).status === 401, 'Anonymous cannot list private users');
  verify((await anonymous('/admin/dashboard')).headers.get('location')?.includes('/login'), 'Anonymous admin dashboard redirects to login');
  verify((await student.api(base)).status === 403, 'Student cannot list private users');
  const deniedPage = await student.api('/admin/dashboard');
  verify(deniedPage.headers.get('location')?.endsWith('/dashboard') || (deniedPage.data.includes('NEXT_REDIRECT') && deniedPage.data.includes('/dashboard')), 'Student admin page redirects to private student dashboard');
  verify((await student.api(endpoint)).status === 403, 'Student cannot read another user detail');
  verify((await student.api(endpoint,{ action: 'promote' })).status === 403, 'Student cannot promote users');
  verify(Boolean((await student.direct.rpc('promote_admin_user',{ target_id: student.id })).error), 'Database rejects direct student role promotion');
  const list = await manager.api(base);
  verify(list.status === 200 && json(list).users.some(user => user.id === target.id && user.email === target.email), 'Admin sees names usernames and emails');
  verify(!list.data.includes('encrypted_password') && !list.data.includes('access_token'), 'User listing exposes only selected public account fields');
  verify(/no-store/.test(list.headers.get('cache-control')), 'User data is never cached');
  verify((await manager.api(base + '?page=-1')).status === 400, 'Invalid pagination rejected');
  verify((await manager.api(base + '?page=99999')).status === 200 && json(await manager.api(base + '?page=99999')).users.length === 0, 'Empty pagination is handled');
  verify((await manager.api(`${base}/not-an-id`)).status === 400, 'Malformed user ID rejected');
  verify((await manager.api(`${base}/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000`)).status === 404, 'Unknown user returns 404');
  verify((await manager.api(endpoint, { action: 'suspend', period: 'forever' })).status === 400, 'Unsupported suspension duration rejected');
  verify((await manager.api(endpoint, { action: 'remove' }, { headers: { Origin: 'https://attacker.example' } })).status === 403, 'Cross-origin user deletion rejected');
  verify((await manager.api(`${base}/${manager.id}`, { action: 'remove' })).status === 403, 'Admin cannot delete self');
  verify((await manager.api(`${base}/${manager.id}`, { action: 'ban' })).status === 403, 'Admin cannot ban self');
  verify(Boolean((await admin.auth.admin.updateUserById(manager.id,{ ban_duration: '24h' })).error), 'Database prevents administrator ban races');
  await admin.from('enrollments').insert({ user_id: target.id, course_slug: 'editing-foundations' });
  const detail = json(await manager.api(endpoint));
  verify(detail.user.name === 'Moderation Student' && /^moderationstudent[0-9]{6}$/.test(detail.user.username), 'User detail contains real profile and username');
  verify(detail.subscriptions.some(course => course.slug === 'editing-foundations'), 'User detail reads actual subscribed courses');
  for (const [period, hours] of [['day',24],['week',168],['month',720],['year',8760]]) {
    verify((await manager.api(endpoint,{ action: 'suspend', period })).status === 200, `${period} suspension succeeds`);
    const until = json(await manager.api(endpoint)).user.suspendedUntil;
    verify(Math.abs((Date.parse(until)-Date.now())/3600000-hours) < 0.01, `${period} suspension has correct expiry`);
    verify((await target.api('/api/auth/session')).status === 401, 'Suspension blocks previously issued API session');
    verify((await target.direct.from('enrollments').select('*')).data.length === 0, 'Suspension blocks direct Data API with existing JWT');
    verify((await target.direct.from('lessons').select('*').eq('course_slug','editing-foundations')).data.length === 0, 'Suspension blocks direct course playback retrieval');
    verify((await manager.api(endpoint,{ action: 'restore' })).status === 200, 'Admin restores access before expiry');
    verify((await target.api('/api/auth/session')).status === 200, 'Restored account regains authorized session access');
  }
  verify((await manager.api(endpoint,{ action: 'ban' })).status === 200, 'Permanent ban succeeds');
  verify(json(await manager.api(endpoint)).user.permanentlyBanned, 'Permanent ban has separate status from suspension');
  const denied = await target.direct.auth.signInWithPassword({ email: target.email, password: target.password });
  verify(Boolean(denied.error), 'Banned account cannot sign in');
  await manager.api(endpoint,{ action: 'restore' });
  await admin.auth.admin.updateUserById(target.id,{ ban_duration: '1s' });
  await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 1200));
  verify((await target.api('/api/auth/session')).status === 200, 'Expired suspension automatically restores access');
  await require('./admin-users-browser.cjs')({ manager, target, verify, url });
  verify((await manager.api(endpoint,{ action: 'remove' })).status === 200, 'Admin can delete student account');
  verify((await manager.api(endpoint)).status === 404, 'Deleted user disappears from private detail');
  verify((await admin.from('enrollments').select('*').eq('user_id',target.id)).data.length === 0, 'Delete cascades subscribed courses');
  verify((await target.api('/api/auth/session')).status === 401, 'Deleted user existing session is denied');
  verify((await target.direct.rpc('account_access_allowed')).data !== true, 'Deleted user old JWT cannot pass database access check');
  const promoted = await provision('Promoted User');
  try {
    verify((await manager.api(`${base}/${promoted.id}`,{ action: 'promote' })).status === 200, 'Admin promotes confirmed student');
    verify((await promoted.api(base)).status === 200, 'Promoted user gains admin access');
    await admin.auth.admin.updateUserById(promoted.id,{ email_confirm: true });
    verify((await promoted.api(base)).status === 200, 'Promotion persists after provider email confirmation updates');
    verify((await manager.api(`${base}/${promoted.id}`,{ action: 'ban' })).status === 403, 'Other administrators are protected');
  } finally { await admin.from('admin_allowlist').delete().eq('email',promoted.email); }
};
```

```typescript
    verify(true, 'Invalid browser signup focuses first field');
    const email = `signup-browser-${Date.now()}@example.com`, password = 'Local-Test-Password-19!';

    await page.getByLabel('كلمة المرور', { exact: true }).fill(password);
    await page.getByLabel('تأكيد كلمة المرور', { exact: true }).fill(password);
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'إنشاء حساب', exact: true }).click();
    await expect(page.getByRole('status').filter({ hasText: 'راجع بريدك الإلكتروني' })).toBeVisible();
    verify(!page.url().endsWith('/dashboard'), 'Signup waits for email confirmation');
    const users = await admin.auth.admin.listUsers();
    const created = users.data.users.find(user => user.email === email);
    if (created) identities.push(created.id);
    verify(Boolean(created && !created.email_confirmed_at), 'Signup creates an unconfirmed real account');
    const messages = await (await fetch(config.MAILPIT_URL + '/api/v1/messages')).json();
    const message = messages.messages.find(message => message.To.some(recipient => recipient.Address === email));
    verify(Boolean(message), 'Supabase sends confirmation email to local Mailpit');
    const mail = await (await fetch(config.MAILPIT_URL + '/api/v1/message/' + message.ID)).json();
    const link = mail.HTML.match(/href="([^"]+\/auth\/v1\/verify[^\"]+)"/)?.[1].replaceAll('&amp;', '&');
    verify(Boolean(link), 'Confirmation email includes valid Auth verification link');
    await page.goto(link);
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/dashboard$/);
    verify(true, 'Email verification and PKCE callback establish browser session');
    for (const width of [390, 1440]) {
      await page.setViewportSize({ width, height: 900 });
      await page.goto(url + '/login');
      await expect(page.locator('.lms-auth-card')).toBeVisible();
      verify(await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= innerWidth), `Auth layout fits ${width}px`);
      await page.screenshot({ path: `docs/evidence/backend/login-${width}.png`, fullPage: true });
    }
    verify(errors.length === 0, 'Real authentication browser flows have no JavaScript errors');
  } finally { await browser.close(); }
};
```

```typescript
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { test } from "node:test";
import { validateSections } from "../../modules/features/catalog/helpers/validate-sections";
import { createCourseMetadata } from "../../modules/features/admin/helpers/create-course-metadata";
import { validateCourse } from "../../modules/features/catalog/helpers/validate-course";

import type { Course } from "../../modules/types/lms";
const draft = () => createCourseMetadata({slug:"test-course",title:"دورة اختبار",description:"وصف دورة",amount:0,category:"editing",delivery:"recorded"},{currency:"ج.م",action:"اشتراك",liveLabel:"مباشرة"});
function fixture(): Course {
 const course=draft();course.modules=[{title:"Chapter",lessons:[{id:"first",title:"Lesson",duration:"1:00",durationSeconds:60,resourceIds:[],description:"",videoUrl:"",takeaway:[]}],sections:[{id:"intro",title:"Intro",lessonIds:["first"]}]}];return course;
}
test("Drafts are editable but cannot be published without curriculum",()=>{
 const course=draft();assert.doesNotThrow(()=>validateCourse(course,new Set(),{draft:true}));assert.doesNotThrow(()=>validateLessons(course,[],{draft:true}));assert.throws(()=>validateCourse(course,new Set()));assert.throws(()=>validateLessons(course,[]));
});
test("Sections reference real lessons and cannot assign a lesson twice",()=>{
 const course=fixture();assert.doesNotThrow(()=>validateSections(course));course.modules[0].sections![0].lessonIds.push("first");assert.throws(()=>validateSections(course));
 course.modules[0].sections![0].lessonIds=["missing"];assert.throws(()=>validateSections(course));
 course.modules[0].sections![0].lessonIds=["first"];course.modules[0].sections!.push({id:"second",title:"Second",lessonIds:["first"]});assert.throws(()=>validateSections(course));
});
test("Empty named sections are valid and chapter section identifiers stay unique",()=>{
 const course=fixture();course.modules[0].sections!.push({id:"empty",title:"Empty",lessonIds:[]});assert.doesNotThrow(()=>validateSections(course));course.modules[0].sections!.push({id:"intro",title:"Duplicate",lessonIds:[]});assert.throws(()=>validateSections(course));
});
test("Live courses require duration but may have no recorded lessons",()=>{
 const course=draft();course.delivery="live";course.deliveryLabel="ورشة مباشرة";
 assert.throws(()=>validateCourse(course,new Set()));course.duration="٧ أيام";
 assert.doesNotThrow(()=>validateCourse(course,new Set()));assert.doesNotThrow(()=>validateLessons(course,[]));
});
```

```typescript
import assert from "node:assert/strict";

const base = { slug:"new-course",title:"New course",description:"Course description",amount:100,category:"editing",delivery:"recorded" };

  assert.equal(course.duration,"٧ أيام");assert.equal(course.thumbnailUrl,input.thumbnailUrl);assert.equal(course.introVideoUrl,input.introVideoUrl);

test("Creation rejects invalid media or duration values", () => {

    assert.equal(validateCourseCreate({...base,[field]:value}),null);
  for(const duration of [42,null,"x".repeat(10000)]) assert.equal(validateCourseCreate({...base,duration}),null);
});
```

```typescript
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { test } from "node:test";
import { validCourseAmount, validPaidPriceInput, normalizeCoursePrice } from "../../modules/features/admin/helpers/course-price";
import { validateCourseEdit } from "../../modules/features/admin/helpers/validate-course-edit";
import { validateCourseCreate } from "../../modules/features/admin/helpers/validate-course-create";
test("Paid text prices accept positive integers and exclude zero, signs, decimals and exponents", () => {
  for (const value of ["1","499","1000000"]) assert.equal(validPaidPriceInput(value),true);
  for (const value of ["0","00","01","-1","+1","1.5","1e3","NaN","1000001"," 5 "]) assert.equal(validPaidPriceInput(value),false);
  assert.equal(validPaidPriceInput(""),true); // Editing may be empty; the required field blocks submission.
});
test("Arabic and Persian digits normalize without accepting malformed prices", () => {
  assert.equal(normalizeCoursePrice("١٢٣٤"),"1234");assert.equal(normalizeCoursePrice("۱۲۳۴"),"1234");
  assert.equal(validPaidPriceInput(normalizeCoursePrice("١٫٥")),false);
});
test("Creation and editing enforce integer amounts; zero remains the canonical free-course value", () => {
  const base={slug:"price-test",title:"Price test",description:"Course description",amount:1,category:"editing",delivery:"recorded",thumbnailUrl:"",introVideoUrl:"",published:false};
  for(const amount of [0,1,1000000]) { assert.equal(validCourseAmount(amount),true);assert.ok(validateCourseCreate({...base,amount}));assert.ok(validateCourseEdit({...base,amount})); }
  for(const amount of [-1,0.5,1200.99,1000001,Infinity,NaN,"10",null]) { assert.equal(validCourseAmount(amount),false);assert.equal(validateCourseCreate({...base,amount}),null);assert.equal(validateCourseEdit({...base,amount}),null); }
});
```

```typescript
/* eslint-disable @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports -- Isolated curriculum API acceptance checks. */
const assert=require('node:assert/strict'),{randomUUID}=require('node:crypto');
module.exports=async({admin,provision,anonymous,verify,url})=>{
 const manager=await provision('Curriculum Manager'),student=await provision('Curriculum Student');
 assert.ok(!(await admin.from('admin_users').insert({user_id:manager.id})).error);
 const slug='curriculum-'+randomUUID(),base='/api/admin/courses/'+slug;
 const parse=result=>JSON.parse(result.data),record=async()=>parse(await manager.api(base));
 const overview=current=>({title:current.course.title,description:current.course.description,amount:current.course.offer.amount,category:current.course.category,duration:current.course.duration,thumbnailUrl:current.course.thumbnailUrl??'',introVideoUrl:current.course.introVideoUrl??'',published:current.published,revision:current.revision});
 const mutate=async(input)=>manager.api(base+'/content',{revision:(await record()).revision,...input});
 try {
  verify((await manager.api('/api/admin/courses',{slug,title:'Curriculum test course',description:'Course authoring test content',amount:500,category:'editing',delivery:'recorded'})).status===201,'Create empty draft for curriculum');
  const initial=await record();
  const probe=base+'/media/stream?url='+encodeURIComponent('https://drive.google.com/file/d/1234567890/view');
  verify((await anonymous(probe)).status===401,'Guest cannot probe Drive media');verify((await student.api(probe)).status===403,'Student cannot probe Drive media');

  response=await mutate({kind:'chapter',operation:'create',title:'Second chapter'});verify(response.status===200,'Create second chapter');const second=parse(response).id;
```

```typescript
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { test } from "node:test";
import { applyCurriculumMutation } from "../../modules/features/admin/helpers/apply-curriculum-mutation";
import { curriculumCourse } from "../../modules/features/admin/helpers/curriculum-course";
import { createCourseMetadata } from "../../modules/features/admin/helpers/create-course-metadata";
import { courseContentGroups } from "../../modules/features/admin/helpers/course-content-groups";
import type { Course } from "../../modules/types/lms";
function fixture(): Course {
  const course = createCourseMetadata({slug:"reusable-course",title:"Reusable course",description:"Description",amount:0,category:"editing",delivery:"recorded"},{currency:"EGP",action:"Enroll",liveLabel:"Live"});
  const lesson = (id: string) => ({id,title:id,description:"",duration:"1:00",durationSeconds:60,videoUrl:"",resourceIds:["resource"],takeaway:["Outcome"]});
  course.modules = [{title:"First",lessons:[lesson("one"),lesson("two")],sections:[{id:"intro",title:"Intro",lessonIds:["one"]}]},{title:"Second",lessons:[],sections:[{id:"intro",title:"Other intro",lessonIds:[]}]}];
  return course;
}
test("Legacy chapter identifiers are stable and normalization does not modify its input", () => {
  const course = fixture(), snapshot = structuredClone(course);
  assert.deepEqual(curriculumCourse(course).modules.map(chapter=>chapter.id),["chapter-1","chapter-2"]);
  assert.deepEqual(curriculumCourse(course),curriculumCourse(course));assert.deepEqual(course,snapshot);
});
test("Repeated lesson edits preserve order, resources and learning outcomes without mutating inputs", () => {
  const course = fixture(), snapshot = structuredClone(course);
  const edit = {kind:"lesson" as const,operation:"edit" as const,revision:0,id:"one",chapterId:"chapter-1",sectionId:"intro",title:"Edited",description:"Updated",durationSeconds:3601,videoUrl:"/assets/video/workshop-intro.mp4",preview:true};
  for(const input of [course,fixture()]) {
    const updated = applyCurriculumMutation(input,edit,"one"),lesson=updated.modules[0].lessons[0];
    assert.deepEqual(updated.modules[0].lessons.map(lesson=>lesson.id),["one","two"]);
    assert.deepEqual(lesson.resourceIds,["resource"]);assert.deepEqual(lesson.takeaway,["Outcome"]);
    assert.equal(lesson.duration,"1:00:01");assert.equal(lesson.videoUrl,"");assert.equal(lesson.preview,true);
    assert.deepEqual(updated.modules[0].sections![0].lessonIds,["one"]);
  }
  assert.deepEqual(course,snapshot);
});
test("Legacy section ids repeated across chapters resolve within the selected source chapter", () => {
  const updated = applyCurriculumMutation(fixture(),{kind:"section",operation:"edit",revision:0,id:"intro",sourceChapterId:"chapter-2",chapterId:"chapter-2",title:"Renamed second"},"intro");
  assert.equal(updated.modules[0].sections![0].title,"Intro");assert.equal(updated.modules[1].sections![0].title,"Renamed second");
  assert.throws(()=>applyCurriculumMutation(fixture(),{kind:"section",operation:"edit",revision:0,id:"intro",sourceChapterId:"chapter-1",chapterId:"chapter-2",title:"Move"},"intro"),/SECTION_ID_CONFLICT/);
});
test("A real section named ungrouped remains distinguishable from unassigned lessons", () => {
  const chapter=fixture().modules[0];chapter.sections=[{id:"ungrouped",title:"Real section",lessonIds:["one"]}];
  const groups=courseContentGroups(chapter,"Without section");assert.equal(groups[0].sectionId,"ungrouped");assert.equal(groups[1].sectionId,undefined);
});
```

### File: `tests/backend/dashboard-access.cjs`

SHA-256: `94231e33b94a2e21a0a0d7c1e45f77e600b57caf216f32b0800ac9a0116a5bfe`

```typescript
/* eslint-disable @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports -- Isolated real-account access regression. */
const { chromium, expect } = require('@playwright/test');
module.exports = async function dashboardAccess({ url, student, verify }) {
  const browser = await chromium.launch({ headless: true });
  const context = await browser.newContext();
  const page = await context.newPage();
  const login = async () => {
    await page.goto(url + '/login');
    await page.getByLabel('البريد الإلكتروني', { exact: true }).fill(student.email);
    await page.getByLabel('كلمة المرور', { exact: true }).fill(student.password);
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'تسجيل الدخول', exact: true }).click();
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/dashboard$/);
  };
  try {
    await login();
    const admin = await context.request.get(url + '/api/admin/courses/7days-freelance');
    verify(admin.status() === 403, 'Signed-in student cannot use admin course APIs');
    await context.clearCookies();
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'قائمة الحساب', exact: true }).click();
    await page.locator('.ds-action-panel a[href="/dashboard/profile"]').click();
    await expect(page, 'Lost session navigation').toHaveURL(/\/login$/);
    verify(true, 'Lost session cannot navigate through a retained dashboard layout');
    await login();
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'قائمة الحساب', exact: true }).click();
    await page.locator('.ds-action-panel a[href="/dashboard/profile"]').click();
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/dashboard\/profile$/);
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'قائمة الحساب', exact: true }).click();
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'تسجيل الخروج', exact: true }).click();
    await expect(page, 'Logout navigation').toHaveURL(/\/login$/);
    await page.waitForLoadState('load');
    await page.goBack();
    await expect(page, 'Back navigation after logout').toHaveURL(/\/login$/);
    verify(true, 'Back after logout cannot restore cached dashboard content');
    const response = await context.request.get(url + '/dashboard', { maxRedirects: 0 });
    verify(response.status() === 307 && !(await response.text()).includes('lms-dashboard'), 'Logout removes access before dashboard rendering');
  } finally { await browser.close(); }
};
```

```typescript
/* eslint-disable @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports -- Generated email design, placeholders and rendering checks. */
const fs=require('node:fs'), assert=require('node:assert/strict');
const {chromium}=require('@playwright/test');
const allowed=new Set(['ConfirmationURL','Token','TokenHash','SiteURL','Email','Data','RedirectTo']);
const manifest=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('supabase/templates/variables.json','utf8'));
const config=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('supabase/templates/hosted-config.json','utf8'));
(async()=>{
 const browser=await chromium.launch({headless:true});let checks=0;
 try {
  fs.mkdirSync('docs/evidence/email-design',{recursive:true});
  for(const file of fs.readdirSync('supabase/templates').filter(file=>file.endsWith('.html'))) {
   const id=file.replace('.html',''),html=fs.readFileSync('supabase/templates/'+file,'utf8');
   const variables=[...new Set([...html.matchAll(/{{([\s\S]*?)}}/g)].map(match=>match[0]))];
   assert.deepEqual(manifest[id],variables);
   for(const variable of variables)assert.ok(allowed.has(variable.slice(2,-2).trim().slice(1)),`${id}: unexpected placeholder ${variable}`);
   assert.doesNotMatch(html,/{{ \.(?:NewEmail|OldEmail|Phone|OldPhone) }}/);
   if(id.endsWith('_notification'))assert.doesNotMatch(html,/{{ \.(?:ConfirmationURL|Token|TokenHash|RedirectTo) }}/);
   assert.equal(config[`mailer_templates_${id}_content`],html);assert.match(html,/lang="ar" dir="rtl"/);
   assert.match(html,/#101317/);assert.match(html,/#fc3522/);assert.doesNotMatch(html,/<script|var\(--|localhost|sb_secret_|SMTP_PASSWORD/);
   if(['confirmation','recovery','email_change','invite','magic_link'].includes(id))assert.equal((html.match(/href="{{ \.ConfirmationURL }}"/g)||[]).length,2);
   if(id==='reauthentication'){assert.match(html,/{{ \.Token }}/);assert.doesNotMatch(html,/ConfirmationURL/);}
   const page=await browser.newPage();
   const preview=html.replaceAll('{{ .ConfirmationURL }}','https://ta3allam.vercel.app/api/auth/callback?token_hash='+'x'.repeat(90)).replaceAll('{{ .SiteURL }}','https://ta3allam.vercel.app').replaceAll('{{ .Email }}','student@ta3allam.com').replaceAll('{{ .NewEmail }}','newstudent@ta3allam.com').replaceAll('{{ .OldEmail }}','student@ta3allam.com').replaceAll('{{ .Token }}','12345678').replaceAll('{{ .Phone }}','+201201024880').replaceAll('{{ .OldPhone }}','+201055555555');
   for(const width of [320,390,768]) {
    await page.setViewportSize({width,height:1000});await page.setContent(preview);
    assert.ok(await page.evaluate(()=>document.documentElement.scrollWidth<=innerWidth),`${id} overflows ${width}px`);
    assert.ok(await page.locator('h1').isVisible());
    if(['confirmation','recovery','email_change','invite','magic_link'].includes(id)) {
      const style=await page.locator('td[bgcolor="#fc3522"] a').evaluate(el=>({color:getComputedStyle(el).color,decoration:getComputedStyle(el).textDecorationLine}));
      assert.equal(style.color,'rgb(255, 255, 255)');assert.equal(style.decoration,'none');
    }
    if(id==='recovery'||id==='confirmation')await page.screenshot({path:`docs/evidence/email-design/${id}-${width}.png`,fullPage:true});
    checks++;
   }
   await page.close();
  }
  console.log(`Email design: ${checks} responsive renders passed; placeholders, canonical colors and generated payload verified.`);
 } finally {await browser.close();}
})().catch(error=>{console.error(error);process.exitCode=1;});
```

```typescript
/* eslint-disable @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports -- Node integration runner with local-only credentials. */
const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const fs = require('node:fs');
const { spawn } = require('node:child_process');
const { createClient } = require('@supabase/supabase-js');
const config = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('/tmp/khatab-supabase-status.json', 'utf8'));
assert.match(config.API_URL, /^http:\/\/127\.0\.0\.1:/, 'Tests require isolated local Supabase');
const url = 'http://localhost:3045';
const env = { ...process.env, NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL: config.API_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY: config.PUBLISHABLE_KEY ?? config.ANON_KEY, APP_ORIGIN: url, SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY: config.SECRET_KEY ?? config.SERVICE_ROLE_KEY };
const log = fs.openSync('/tmp/khatab-backend-server.log', 'w');
const server = spawn('node', ['node_modules/next/dist/bin/next', 'dev', '--hostname', '127.0.0.1', '--port', '3045'], { env, stdio: ['ignore', log, log] });
const admin = createClient(config.API_URL, config.SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, { auth: { persistSession: false, autoRefreshToken: false } });
const identities = [];
let checks = 0;
const verify = (condition, label) => { assert.ok(condition, label); console.log(`PASS ${++checks}: ${label}`); };
function account() {
  const cookies = new Map();
  return async (path, body, options = {}) => {
    const headers = { Cookie: [...cookies].map(([k,v]) => `${k}=${v}`).join('; '), ...options.headers };
    if (body !== undefined) { if (!(body instanceof FormData)) headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json'; headers.Origin ??= url; }
    const response = await fetch(url + path, { ...options, headers, method: body === undefined ? 'GET' : 'POST', body: body === undefined ? undefined : body instanceof FormData ? body : JSON.stringify(body), redirect: 'manual' });
    for (const value of response.headers.getSetCookie()) {
      const [pair] = value.split(';'); const index = pair.indexOf('='); cookies.set(pair.slice(0,index), pair.slice(index + 1));
    }
    return { status: response.status, data: await response.text(), headers: response.headers };
  };
}
const parse = response => JSON.parse(response.data);
async function provision(name) {
  const email = `test-${require("node:crypto").randomUUID()}@example.com`, password = 'Local-Test-Password-19!';
  const result = await admin.auth.admin.createUser({ email, password, email_confirm: true, user_metadata: { name } });
  assert.ok(!result.error, 'Local fixture user created'); identities.push(result.data.user.id);
  if (process.env.BACKEND_SUITE !== 'account-settings') {
    const phone = '+2012' + String(require('node:crypto').randomInt(10000000,99999999));
    assert.ok(!(await admin.from('account_contacts').update({phone_e164:phone}).eq('user_id',result.data.user.id)).error);

  assert.ok(!(await direct.auth.signInWithPassword({ email, password })).error, 'Local fixture can authenticate');
  const api = account(); verify((await api('/api/auth/login', { email, password })).status === 200, `${name}: real login`);
  return { id: result.data.user.id, email, password, direct, api };
}
async function run() {
  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 90; attempt++) {
    try { if ((await fetch(url + '/api/courses')).ok) break; } catch {}
    if (attempt === 89) throw new Error('Local Next.js server did not start; inspect /tmp/khatab-backend-server.log');
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 1000));
  }

    await require('./course-price.cjs')({admin,provision,verify,url});
    return;
  }

    await require('./curriculum-authoring.cjs')({admin,provision,anonymous,verify,url});
    return;
  }
  if (process.env.BACKEND_SUITE === 'admin-course-management') {
    await require('./admin-course-management.cjs')({admin,provision,anonymous,verify,url});
    return;
  }
  if (process.env.BACKEND_SUITE === 'image-uploads') {
    await require('./image-uploads.cjs')({admin,provision,anonymous,verify,url});
    return;
  }
  if (process.env.BACKEND_SUITE === 'performance') {
    await require('./performance.cjs')({admin,provision,verify,url});
    return;
  }
  if (process.env.BACKEND_SUITE === 'phone-confirmations') {
    await require('./phone-confirmations.cjs')({admin,provision,anonymous,verify,url});
    return;
  }
  if (process.env.BACKEND_SUITE === 'admin-analytics') {
    await require('./admin-analytics.cjs')({admin,provision,anonymous,verify,url,config});
    return;
  }
  if (process.env.BACKEND_SUITE === 'navigation') {
    const manager=await provision('Navigation Manager'),student=await provision('Navigation Student');
    assert.ok(!(await admin.from('admin_users').insert({user_id:manager.id})).error);
    await require('./navigation-browser.cjs')({url,manager,student,verify});
    return;
  }
  if (process.env.BACKEND_SUITE === 'account-settings-browser') {
    const manager=await provision('Account Manager'),student=await provision('Account Student');
    await admin.from('admin_users').insert({user_id:manager.id});
    await require('./account-settings-browser.cjs')({manager,student,url,verify,config,admin});
    return;
  }
  if (process.env.BACKEND_SUITE === 'account-settings') {
    await require('./account-settings.cjs')({ admin, provision, anonymous, verify, url, config });
    return;
  }
  if (process.env.BACKEND_SUITE === 'username-controls') {
    await require('./username-controls.cjs')({ admin, provision, anonymous, verify, url, config });
    return;
  }
  if (process.env.BACKEND_SUITE === 'admin-user-search') {
    await require('./admin-user-search.cjs')({ admin, provision, anonymous, verify, url, config });
    return;
  }
  if (process.env.BACKEND_SUITE === 'admin-users-browser') {
    const manager = await provision('User Manager'), target = await provision('Moderation Student');
    await admin.from('admin_users').insert({ user_id: manager.id });
    await admin.from('enrollments').insert({ user_id: target.id, course_slug: 'editing-foundations' });
    await require('./admin-users-browser.cjs')({ manager, target, verify, url });
    return;
  }
  if (process.env.BACKEND_SUITE === 'admin-users') {
    const student = await provision('API Student');
    await require('./admin-users.cjs')({ admin, provision, anonymous, student, verify, url });
    return;
  }
  const catalog = await anonymous('/api/courses');
  verify(catalog.status === 200, 'Anonymous catalog is database-backed');
  const courses = parse(catalog).courses, course = courses[0];
  const lessons = course.modules.flatMap(section => section.lessons), privateLesson = lessons.find(lesson => !lesson.preview), preview = lessons.find(lesson => lesson.preview);
  verify(lessons.every(lesson => !lesson.videoUrl), 'Public metadata excludes playback URLs');
  const playback = lesson => `/api/courses/${course.slug}/lessons/${lesson.id}/playback`;
  for (const path of ['/api/profile','/api/progress','/api/enrollments','/api/auth/session',`/api/certificates/${course.slug}`])
    verify((await anonymous(path)).status === 401, `Anonymous denied ${path}`);
  const protectedPage = await anonymous('/dashboard');
  verify(protectedPage.headers.get('location')?.includes('/login') || (protectedPage.data.includes('NEXT_REDIRECT') && protectedPage.data.includes('/login')), 'Protected dashboard redirects (including streamed redirects)');
  verify((await anonymous(playback(privateLesson))).status === 403, 'Private playback denied without enrollment');
  verify((await anonymous(playback(preview))).status === 200, 'Published preview playback is public');
  verify((await anonymous('/api/auth/login', { email: 'wrong@example.com', password: 'Incorrect-Password-19!' })).status === 401, 'Wrong password rejected');
  verify((await anonymous('/api/auth/signup', { name: 'x', email: 'invalid', password: 'short' })).status === 400, 'Invalid signup rejected');
  verify((await anonymous('/api/auth/signup', { payload: 'x'.repeat(17000) })).status === 400, 'Oversized JSON payload rejected');
  verify((await anonymous('/api/auth/login', { email: 'wrong@example.com', password: 'Incorrect-Password-19!' }, { headers: { Origin: 'https://attacker.example' } })).status === 403, 'Cross-origin login rejected');
  verify((await anonymous('/api/profile', undefined, { headers: { Cookie: 'ta3allam-state=forged' } })).status === 401, 'Forged demo cookie grants no authority');
  const a = await provision('Student A'), b = await provision('Student B');
  verify((await a.api('/api/auth/session')).status === 200, 'Verified session endpoint');
  await require('./browser.cjs')({ url, config, admin, identities, verify, student: a });
  await require('./dashboard-access.cjs')({ url, student: a, verify });
  await require('./admin.cjs')({ admin, provision, anonymous, student: b, verify, url, config });
  await require('./admin-users.cjs')({ admin, provision, anonymous, student: b, verify, url });
  verify((await a.api('/api/enrollments', { courseSlug: course.slug })).status === 403, 'Paid course cannot self-enroll through API');
  verify(Boolean((await a.direct.from('enrollments').insert({ user_id: a.id, course_slug: course.slug })).error), 'RLS blocks direct paid enrollment');
  verify(Boolean((await a.direct.from('profiles').upsert({ id: b.id, name: 'Impersonation' })).error), 'RLS blocks profile ownership forgery');
  verify((await a.direct.from('profiles').select('*').eq('id', b.id)).data.length === 0, 'RLS hides other student profile');
  const attemptedPrice = await a.direct.from('courses').update({ amount: 0 }).eq('slug',course.slug).select('amount');
  const persistedPrice = (await admin.from('courses').select('amount').eq('slug',course.slug).single()).data.amount;
  verify((attemptedPrice.error || attemptedPrice.data?.length === 0) && Number(persistedPrice) === course.offer.amount, 'Students cannot alter prices');
  verify((await a.api('/api/progress', { courseSlug: course.slug, lessonId: privateLesson.id, completed: true })).status === 403, 'Progress requires enrollment');
  const free = { ...course, slug: 'backend-test-free', offer: { ...course.offer, amount: 0 } };
  assert.ok(!(await admin.from('courses').upsert({ slug: free.slug, metadata: free, amount: 0, published: true, position: 99 })).error);
  verify((await a.api('/api/enrollments', { courseSlug: free.slug })).status === 200, 'Free enrollment succeeds');
  verify((await a.api('/api/enrollments', { courseSlug: free.slug })).status === 200, 'Free enrollment is idempotent');
  assert.ok(!(await admin.from('enrollments').insert({ user_id: a.id, course_slug: course.slug })).error);
  verify((await a.api(playback(privateLesson))).status === 200, 'Trusted grant unlocks private playback');
  verify((await b.api(playback(privateLesson))).status === 403, 'Grant never unlocks another account');
  verify((await b.direct.from('enrollments').select('*').eq('user_id', a.id)).data.length === 0, 'Direct requests hide another account enrollment');
  const updates = await Promise.all(lessons.slice(0,2).map(lesson => a.api('/api/progress', { courseSlug: course.slug, lessonId: lesson.id, completed: true })));
  verify(updates.every(result => result.status === 200), 'Concurrent progress updates succeed');
  const progress = parse(await a.api('/api/progress'));
  verify(lessons.slice(0,2).every(lesson => progress.completed.includes(`${course.slug}/${lesson.id}`)), 'Concurrent progress preserves both lessons');
  verify((await b.direct.from('lesson_progress').select('*').eq('user_id', a.id)).data.length === 0, 'RLS hides another account progress');
  verify(Boolean((await b.direct.from('lesson_progress').insert({ user_id: a.id, course_slug: course.slug, lesson_id: privateLesson.id, completed: true })).error), 'RLS rejects forged progress owner');
  verify((await a.api('/api/progress', { courseSlug: course.slug, lessonId: 'missing', completed: true })).status === 404, 'Unknown lesson rejected');
  verify((await a.api(`/api/certificates/${course.slug}`)).status === 403, 'Incomplete course certificate denied');
  for (const lesson of lessons) await a.api('/api/progress', { courseSlug: course.slug, lessonId: lesson.id, completed: true });
  verify((await a.api(`/api/certificates/${course.slug}`)).status === 200, 'Completed enrolled course certificate allowed');
  const resourceId = lessons.flatMap(lesson => lesson.resourceIds)[0];
  if (resourceId) {
    verify((await a.api(`/api/resources/${resourceId}`)).status === 200, 'Enrolled student can download resource');
    verify((await b.api(`/api/resources/${resourceId}`)).status === 404, 'Other student cannot download resource');
  }
  const profile = await a.api('/api/profile', { name: 'Updated Student', email: a.email });
  verify(profile.status === 200 && parse(profile).name === 'Updated Student', 'Own profile updates persist');
  verify(/no-store/.test(profile.headers.get('cache-control')), 'Personalized responses never cached');
  const changedEmail = await a.api('/api/profile', { name: 'Updated Student', email: `changed-${Date.now()}@example.com` });
  verify(changedEmail.status === 403 && parse(changedEmail).code === 'EMAIL_LOCKED', 'Student email change is locked on the legacy endpoint');
  await admin.from('enrollments').delete().eq('user_id',a.id).eq('course_slug',course.slug);
  verify((await a.api(playback(privateLesson))).status === 403, 'Revoked grant immediately denies playback');
  verify((await a.api('/api/auth/logout', {})).status === 200, 'Logout succeeds');
  verify((await a.api('/api/auth/session')).status === 401, 'Logout removes authenticated session');
}
(async () => {
  try { await run(); console.log(`Backend integration: ${checks} checks passed`); }
  finally {
    for (const id of identities) {
      const user=await admin.auth.admin.getUserById(id);
      if(user.data.user?.email) await admin.from("admin_allowlist").delete().eq("email",user.data.user.email);
      await admin.from("admin_users").delete().eq("user_id", id);
      await admin.auth.admin.deleteUser(id);
    }
    await admin.from('courses').delete().eq('slug','backend-test-free');
    server.kill('SIGTERM'); fs.closeSync(log);
  }
})().catch(error => { console.error(error.message); process.exitCode = 1; });
```

```typescript
/* eslint-disable @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports -- Real isolated database acceptance. */
const { Client } = require('pg');
module.exports = async function usernameControls({ admin, provision, anonymous, verify, url, config }) {
  const manager = await provision('Control Manager');
  await admin.from('admin_users').insert({ user_id: manager.id });
  const students = await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: 12 }, () => provision('Zack Middle River')));
  const profiles = (await admin.from('profiles').select('id,username').in('id',students.map(student => student.id))).data;
  verify(profiles.length === 12 && profiles.every(profile => /^zackriver\d{6}$/.test(profile.username)), 'Concurrent same-name signups merge first and last names with six random digits');
  verify(new Set(profiles.map(profile => profile.username)).size === 12, 'All concurrent generated usernames are unique');
  const arabic = await provision('محمد أحمد خطاب'), single = await provision('Cher');
  verify(/^[a-z]+ing-[a-z]+\d{6}$/.test(JSON.parse((await arabic.api('/api/profile')).data).username), 'Non-English names generate an English gerund-adjective username');
  verify(/^cher\d{6}$/.test(JSON.parse((await single.api('/api/profile')).data).username), 'Single-name accounts generate a valid username');
  const [a,b] = students;
  const handle = profiles.find(profile => profile.id === b.id).username;
  const detail = await manager.api('/admin/dashboard/users/'+handle);
  verify(detail.status === 200, 'Admin can open user details by username');
  const legacyPage = await manager.api('/admin/dashboard/users/'+b.id);
  verify(legacyPage.headers.get('location')?.endsWith('/'+handle) || legacyPage.data.includes('NEXT_REDIRECT'), 'Legacy UUID URL redirects to the username');
  const missingPage = await manager.api('/admin/dashboard/users/missing-handle');
  verify(missingPage.status === 404 || missingPage.data.includes('NEXT_HTTP_ERROR_FALLBACK;404'), 'Unknown username returns not found');
  const deniedPage = await b.api('/admin/dashboard/users/'+handle);
  verify(deniedPage.status !== 200 || deniedPage.data.includes('NEXT_REDIRECT'), 'Student cannot open username-based admin details');
  const change = (student, username) => student.api('/api/profile', { name: 'Zack Middle River', email: student.email, username });
  verify((await change(a,' My-Custom_Name ')).status === 200, 'Student can choose a normalized username');
  verify(JSON.parse((await a.api('/api/profile')).data).username === 'my-custom_name', 'Chosen username persists in profile');
  await a.api('/api/profile', { name: 'New Name', email:a.email });
  verify(JSON.parse((await a.api('/api/profile')).data).username === 'my-custom_name', 'Name-only profile upsert preserves chosen username');
  await Promise.all([a.api('/api/profile',{name:'Concurrent Name',email:a.email}),change(a,'kept-during-upsert')]);
  verify(JSON.parse((await a.api('/api/profile')).data).username === 'kept-during-upsert', 'Concurrent name-only upsert cannot overwrite a chosen username');
  await change(a,'my-custom_name');
  const duplicate = await change(b,'MY-CUSTOM_NAME');
  verify(duplicate.status === 409 && JSON.parse(duplicate.data).code === 'USERNAME_TAKEN', 'Case-insensitive duplicate rename returns helpful conflict');
  const racing = await Promise.all([change(a,'shared-race'),change(b,'shared-race')]);
  verify(racing.filter(response => response.status === 200).length === 1 && racing.filter(response => response.status === 409).length === 1, 'Concurrent custom renames reserve a username atomically');
  for (const invalid of ['ab','invalid name','x'.repeat(49),'../evil','محمدخطاب123456','zäck123']) verify((await change(b,invalid)).status === 400, 'Invalid username rejected: '+invalid.slice(0,20));
  verify((await anonymous('/api/profile',{ name:'New Name',email:a.email,username:'forged' })).status === 401, 'Anonymous cannot rename a profile');
  verify((await b.direct.from('profiles').update({username:'forged'}).eq('id',a.id).select()).data?.length === 0, 'RLS blocks another account rename');
  const db = new Client({ connectionString: config.DB_URL }); await db.connect();
  try {
    const result = await db.query("select private.username_base($1) as base, private.username_base($2) as fallback",[' ZACK   Middle River ','!!!']);
    verify(result.rows[0].base === 'zackriver' && result.rows[0].fallback === null, 'Username helper handles whitespace, case and fallback');
    const legacy = students[2], chosen = students[3];
    await db.query("update public.profiles set username='user-' || replace(id::text,'-','') where id=$1",[legacy.id]);
    await db.query("update public.profiles set username='chosen-keep' where id=$1",[chosen.id]);
    await db.query("update public.profiles set username=private.generate_default_username(name) where username='user-' || replace(id::text,'-','')");
    const migrated=await db.query('select id,username from public.profiles where id=any($1::uuid[])',[[legacy.id,chosen.id]]);
    verify(migrated.rows.find(row=>row.id===chosen.id).username==='chosen-keep' && /^zackriver\d{6}$/.test(migrated.rows.find(row=>row.id===legacy.id).username), 'Migration backfills legacy defaults and preserves chosen usernames');
    await db.query('begin');
    try {
      await db.query('alter table public.profiles drop constraint profiles_username_check');
      await db.query("update public.profiles set username='محمدخطاب123456' where id=$1",[arabic.id]);
      await db.query("update public.profiles set username=private.generate_default_username(name) where username !~ '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{2,47}$'");
      const backfill = await db.query('select username,name from public.profiles where id=$1',[arabic.id]);
      verify(/^[a-z]+ing-[a-z]+\d{6}$/.test(backfill.rows[0].username) && backfill.rows[0].name==='محمد أحمد خطاب','Backfill converts non-English handles while preserving display names');
      const retained = await db.query('select username from public.profiles where id=$1',[chosen.id]);
      verify(retained.rows[0].username==='chosen-keep','English chosen handles survive the ASCII backfill');
    } finally { await db.query('rollback'); }
    const invalidDb = await db.query("update public.profiles set username='محمد123' where id=$1",[arabic.id]).catch(error=>error);
    verify(invalidDb.code==='23514','Database rejects non-English handles independently of API validation');
    const variants = await db.query("select private.generate_default_username(name) as username from (values ('محمد River'),('Zack خطاب'),('李 明'),('!!!')) names(name)");
    verify(variants.rows.every(row=>/^[a-z]+ing-[a-z]+\d{6}$/.test(row.username)), 'Mixed-script, Chinese and punctuation-only names use English fallbacks');
    await db.query('set enable_seqscan=off');
    const plan = await db.query("explain select id from public.profiles where lower(name) ^@ lower($1)", ['محمد']);
    verify(plan.rows.some(row => row['QUERY PLAN'].includes('profiles_name_prefix_idx')), 'Actual parameterized prefix predicate can use the SP-GiST name index');
  } finally { await db.end(); }
  await a.api('/api/profile', { name:'Other Name',email:a.email });
  const search = async value => JSON.parse((await manager.api('/api/admin/users?mode=prefix&q='+encodeURIComponent(value))).data);
  verify((await search('محمد')).users.some(user => user.id === arabic.id), 'Arabic first-letter indexed search finds the right account');
  verify((await search(a.email)).total === 0, 'Prefix mode searches names rather than email');
  verify((await search('ZaCk')).total === 11, 'Name-prefix search ignores Latin case');
  verify((await manager.api('/api/admin/users?mode=unknown')).status === 400, 'Unknown search mode rejected');
  await require('./form-controls-browser.cjs')({ manager, student:b, verify, url });
};
```

### File: `tests/countdown.spec.ts`

SHA-256: `c186cfa88692f8d6c6083d8f5f58ab982e61feca2bd51de88012f0634fab9240`

```typescript
import { expect, test } from "@playwright/test";
import { offerConfig } from "../app/config/offer";
import { splitCountdown } from "../app/lib/countdown";

test("countdown splits day boundaries and stops at zero", () => {
  expect(splitCountdown(86400)).toEqual({
    days: "01",
    hours: "00",
    minutes: "00",
    seconds: "00",
  });
  expect(splitCountdown(-1)).toEqual({
    days: "00",
    hours: "00",
    minutes: "00",
    seconds: "00",
  });
});

test("reference countdown ticks and keeps its deadline after refreshing", async ({
  page,
}) => {
  const now = new Date("2026-10-03T10:00:00Z");
  const remaining = 3 * 86400 + 19 * 3600 + 27 * 60 + 13;
  await page.clock.setFixedTime(now);
  await page.addInitScript(
    ({ key, deadline }) => {
      if (!localStorage.getItem(key))
        localStorage.setItem(key, String(deadline));
    },
    { key: offerConfig.storageKey, deadline: now.getTime() + remaining * 1000 },
  );
  await page.goto("/7days-freelance");
  const timer = page.getByRole("timer");
  await expect(
    page.getByText("ينتهي الخصم خلال :", { exact: true }),
  ).toBeVisible();
  await expect(timer.locator('[data-countdown-unit="days"]')).toHaveText("03");
  await expect(timer.locator('[data-countdown-unit="hours"]')).toHaveText("19");
  await expect(timer.locator('[data-countdown-unit="minutes"]')).toHaveText(
    "27",
  );
  await expect(timer.locator('[data-countdown-unit="seconds"]')).toHaveText(
    "13",
  );
  await page.clock.setFixedTime(new Date(now.getTime() + 1000));
  await expect(timer.locator('[data-countdown-unit="seconds"]')).toHaveText(
    "12",
  );
  const deadline = await page.evaluate(
    (key) => localStorage.getItem(key),
    offerConfig.storageKey,
  );
  await page.reload();
  await expect(timer.locator('[data-countdown-unit="seconds"]')).toHaveText(
    "12",
  );
  expect(
    await page.evaluate(
      (key) => localStorage.getItem(key),
      offerConfig.storageKey,
    ),
  ).toBe(deadline);
});

test("expired discount stays expired and blocked storage does not crash", async ({
  page,
}) => {
  await page.addInitScript(
    (key) => localStorage.setItem(key, "1"),
    offerConfig.storageKey,
  );
  await page.goto("/7days-freelance");
  await expect(page.locator('[data-countdown-unit="days"]')).toHaveText("00");
  await expect(page.locator('[data-countdown-unit="seconds"]')).toHaveText(
    "00",
  );
  await page.reload();
  await expect(page.locator('[data-countdown-unit="days"]')).toHaveText("00");
  const errors: string[] = [];
  page.on("pageerror", (error) => errors.push(error.message));
  await page.addInitScript(() =>
    Object.defineProperty(window, "localStorage", {
      get() {
        throw new Error("Storage blocked");
      },
    }),
  );
  await page.reload();
  await expect(page.getByRole("timer")).toBeVisible();
  expect(errors).toEqual([]);
});
```

```typescript
import { expect, test } from "@playwright/test";

test("hero thumbnail activates original MP4 with only centered play/pause", async ({
  page,
}) => {
  const errors: string[] = [],
    providerRequests: string[] = [];
  page.on("pageerror", (error) => errors.push(error.message));
  page.on("request", (request) => {
    if (/youtube(?:-nocookie)?\.com/.test(request.url()))
      providerRequests.push(request.url());
  });
  await page.goto("/7days-freelance");
  const hero = page.locator(".hero-video-shell");
  await expect(hero.locator(".hero-video-placeholder img")).toHaveAttribute(
    "src",
    "/assets/images/workshop-intro-poster.jpg",
  );
  await expect(hero.locator("video,iframe")).toHaveCount(0);
  await page
    .getByRole("button", { name: "تشغيل الفيديو التعريفي", exact: true })
    .click();
  const video = hero.locator("video");
  await expect
    .poll(() => video.evaluate((node) => (node as HTMLVideoElement).readyState))
    .toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(2);
  await expect(video).toHaveAttribute(
    "src",
    "/assets/video/workshop-intro.mp4",
  );
  expect(
    await video.evaluate((node) => (node as HTMLVideoElement).controls),
  ).toBe(false);
  await expect(
    hero.locator(".custom-video-controls,input,iframe,a"),
  ).toHaveCount(0);
  await expect(hero.locator(".custom-video-stage button")).toHaveCount(0);
  await video.click();
  await expect
    .poll(() => video.evaluate((node) => (node as HTMLVideoElement).paused))
    .toBe(true);
  await hero
    .getByRole("button", { name: "تشغيل الفيديو", exact: true })
    .click();
  await expect
    .poll(() => video.evaluate((node) => (node as HTMLVideoElement).paused))
    .toBe(false);
  await video.evaluate((node) => {
    const v = node as HTMLVideoElement;
    v.currentTime = v.duration - 0.1;
    void v.play();
  });
  await expect(hero.locator(".hero-video-placeholder")).toBeVisible();
  await expect(video).toHaveCount(0);
  expect(providerRequests).toEqual([]);
  expect(errors).toEqual([]);
});
for (const width of [320, 390, 768, 1440])
  test(`hero thumbnail and overlay fit 16:9 at ${width}px`, async ({
    page,
  }) => {
    await page.setViewportSize({ width, height: 900 });
    await page.goto("/7days-freelance");
    const hero = page.locator(".hero-video-shell");
    await expect
      .poll(() =>
        hero
          .locator("img")
          .evaluate((node) => (node as HTMLImageElement).naturalWidth),
      )
      .toBeGreaterThan(0);
    await hero.locator(".hero-video-placeholder").click();

    await expect(hero.locator(".custom-video-controls")).toHaveCount(0);
    expect(
      await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth),
    ).toBeLessThanOrEqual(width);
    await expect
      .poll(() =>
        hero
          .locator("video")
          .evaluate((node) => (node as HTMLVideoElement).readyState),
      )
      .toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(2);
    await hero.locator("video").click();
    await expect(hero.locator(".custom-video-overlay-toggle")).toBeVisible();
    const geometry = await hero.evaluate((node) => {
      const v = node.querySelector("video")!.getBoundingClientRect(),
        b = node
          .querySelector(".custom-video-overlay-toggle")!
          .getBoundingClientRect();
      return {
        heightError: Math.abs(v.height - (v.width * 9) / 16),
        intrinsicRatio:
          (node.querySelector("video") as HTMLVideoElement).videoWidth /
          (node.querySelector("video") as HTMLVideoElement).videoHeight,
        dx: Math.abs(v.left + v.width / 2 - b.left - b.width / 2),
        dy: Math.abs(v.top + v.height / 2 - b.top - b.height / 2),
      };
    });
    // The existing 1px shell border affects its inner viewport by under 1px.
    expect(geometry.heightError).toBeLessThan(1);
    expect(geometry.intrinsicRatio).toBeCloseTo(16 / 9, 5);
    expect(geometry.dx).toBeLessThan(1);
    expect(geometry.dy).toBeLessThan(1);
  });
test("hero reports media failure and retries", async ({ page }) => {
```

### File: `tests/dashboard-access.spec.ts`

```typescript
import { test, expect } from "@playwright/test";
import { routes } from "../modules/config/navigation";
const protectedPages = [routes.dashboard, routes.library, routes.profile, routes.resources, routes.certificates, routes.admin, routes.adminCourse("7days-freelance")];
for (const path of protectedPages) test(`logged-out requests cannot render ${path}`, async ({ request, page }) => {
  const response = await request.get(path, { maxRedirects: 0 });
  expect(response.status()).toBe(307);
  expect(response.headers().location).toMatch(/\/login$/);
  expect(await response.text()).not.toContain("lms-dashboard");
  const rsc = await request.get(path, { maxRedirects: 0, headers: { RSC: "1" } });
  expect(rsc.status()).toBe(307);
  expect(await rsc.text()).not.toContain("lms-dashboard");
  await page.goto(path);
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/login$/);
  await expect(page.locator(".lms-dashboard-stats")).toHaveCount(0);
});
test("forged session and old demo cookies cannot unlock the dashboard", async ({ request }) => {
  const response = await request.get(routes.dashboard, { maxRedirects: 0, headers: { Cookie: "ta3allam-session=forged; ta3allam-learning=forged; sb-tatseklsvfdpuxuepbfo-auth-token=forged" } });
  expect(response.status()).toBe(307);
  expect(response.headers().location).toMatch(/\/login$/);
});
```

```typescript
import { expect, test } from "@playwright/test";
import { existsSync, readFileSync, realpathSync } from "node:fs";
import { createRequire } from "node:module";
import { resolve } from "node:path";

const rootRequire = createRequire(resolve("package.json"));
const moduleRequire = createRequire(resolve("modules/features/marketing/landing.tsx"));

test("T03 page modules resolve the single maintained foundation", () => {
  for (const entry of ["ui/container", "ui/rich-text", "types/ui", "hooks/use-accordion", "lib/scroll-reveals"]) {
    expect(realpathSync(rootRequire.resolve(`@khatab/design/${entry}`))).toBe(
      realpathSync(moduleRequire.resolve(`@khatab/design/${entry}`)),
    );
  }
  for (const app of ["app", "modules"]) {
    const base = readFileSync(`${app}/styles/theme.css`, "utf8");
    expect(base.match(/@import/g)).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(base).not.toMatch(/--primary-red:\s*#/);
    expect(existsSync(`${app}/styles/workshop.css`)).toBe(false);
    expect(existsSync(`${app}/styles/fonts.css`)).toBe(false);
  }
});

test("T10 generated exports resolve aliases and reject invalid token graphs", () => {
  const { parseTokens, resolveToken } = rootRequire("./packages/design-system/lib/theme.cjs");
  const source = ":root { --primary: #fc3522; --alias: var(--primary); }";
  expect(resolveToken(parseTokens([source]), "--alias")).toBe("#fc3522");
  expect(() => resolveToken({}, "--missing")).toThrow(/Missing/);
  expect(() => resolveToken({"--a":"var(--b)","--b":"var(--a)"}, "--a")).toThrow(/Cyclic/);
  expect(() => resolveToken({"--a":"calc(1 + 2)"}, "--a")).toThrow(/Unsupported/);
  for (const entry of ["app/styles", "modules/styles"]) {
    const base = readFileSync("packages/design-system/styles/theme.css", "utf8");
    const tokens = parseTokens([base, readFileSync(`${entry}/theme.css`, "utf8")]);
```

### File: `tests/helpers/browser-module.cjs`

SHA-256: `8a9b4ffbaf48683adcd452cf4ccd9936fbb64535d8e806cdfc43ee6de19199a5`

```typescript
/* eslint-disable @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports -- Bundle the real helper graph for browser lifecycle tests. */
const fs = require("node:fs"), path = require("node:path"), ts = require("typescript");
function bundleBrowserModule(entry) {
  const modules = {};
  function collect(file) {
    if (Object.hasOwn(modules, file)) return;
    modules[file] = "";
    const code = ts.transpileModule(fs.readFileSync(file, "utf8"), {
      compilerOptions: { module: ts.ModuleKind.CommonJS, target: ts.ScriptTarget.ES2020 },
    }).outputText;
    modules[file] = code.replace(/require\("([^\"]+)"\)/g, (_, request) => {
      if (!request.startsWith(".")) throw new Error(`Unsupported browser dependency: ${request}`);
      const dependency = path.resolve(path.dirname(file), `${request}.ts`);
      collect(dependency);
      return `require(${JSON.stringify(dependency)})`;
    });
  }
  const root = path.resolve(entry);
  collect(root);
  return `const sources=${JSON.stringify(modules)},cache={};
    function load(id){if(cache[id])return cache[id];const result=cache[id]={};
      new Function('require','exports',sources[id])(load,result);return result;}
    Object.assign(exports,load(${JSON.stringify(root)}));`;
}
module.exports = { bundleBrowserModule };
```

```typescript
const fs = require("node:fs"), path = require("node:path"), Module = require("node:module"), ts = require("typescript");
const resolve = Module._resolveFilename;
Module._resolveFilename = function (request, ...args) {
  const target = request.startsWith("@platform/") ? path.resolve("modules", request.slice(10))
    : request.startsWith("@/") ? path.resolve(request.slice(2)) : request;
  return resolve.call(this, target, ...args);
};
for (const extension of [".ts", ".tsx"]) {

      compilerOptions: { target: ts.ScriptTarget.ES2020, jsx: ts.JsxEmit.ReactJSX, module: ts.ModuleKind.CommonJS, esModuleInterop: true },
    }).outputText, filename);

}
```

```typescript
import { expect,test } from "@playwright/test";
test("body tolerance leaves child hydration warnings enabled in development", async ({
  page,
  baseURL,
}) => {
  const target = baseURL!.replace("127.0.0.1", "localhost") + "/7days-freelance";
  const warnings: string[] = [];
  page.on("console", (message) => {
    if (
      message.type() === "error" &&
      /hydrat|didn't match/i.test(message.text())
    )
      warnings.push(message.text());
  });
  await page.addInitScript(() => {

      observer.disconnect();
    });
    observer.observe(document, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  });
  await page.goto(target);

      warnings.some((message) => message.includes("data-test-child-mismatch")),

});
```

### File: `tests/hydration.spec.ts`

SHA-256: `caf6ded8d001e77c46aaffc0c27585ab532987834ae87898d9a68035de761355`

```typescript
import { expect, test } from "@playwright/test";

test("extension-injected body attributes do not warn or prevent hydration", async ({
  page,
  baseURL,
}) => {
  const hydrationWarnings: string[] = [];
  page.on("console", (message) => {
    if (
      message.type() === "error" &&
      /hydrat|didn't match/i.test(message.text())
    )
      hydrationWarnings.push(message.text());
  });
  // Simulate a document-start extension without altering Next's streamed response.
  await page.addInitScript(() => {
    const inject = () => {
      if (!document.body) return false;
      document.body.setAttribute("cz-shortcut-listen", "true");
      return true;
    };
    if (!inject()) {
      const observer = new MutationObserver(() => {
        if (inject()) observer.disconnect();
      });
      observer.observe(document, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    }
  });
  // Next's dev-origin guard permits localhost by default, unlike its IP alias.
  await page.goto(baseURL!.replace("127.0.0.1", "localhost") + "/7days-freelance");
  await expect(page.locator("body")).toHaveAttribute(
    "cz-shortcut-listen",
    "true",
  );
  expect(hydrationWarnings).toEqual([]);
  await page.locator(".faq-question-btn").first().click();
  await expect(page.locator(".faq-question-btn").first()).toHaveAttribute(
    "aria-expanded",
    "true",
  );
  expect(hydrationWarnings).toEqual([]);
});
```

### File: `tests/learning-command-contracts.spec.ts`

SHA-256: `6da1ce81f66e6390faa5046e2ebd15c72a0c5b4c7f462c570eb1e7e7997ef437`

```typescript
import { expect, test } from "@playwright/test";
import { startCourse } from "../modules/features/learning/client/start-course";
import { setLessonCompletion } from "../modules/features/learning/client/complete-lesson";
import { httpRequest } from "../modules/lib/http-request";
import { readLearningResponse } from "../modules/helpers/read-learning-response";

test("R07 workflows order enrollment, progress and navigation and stop on failures", async () => {
  const calls: string[] = [];
  const enroll = async () => { calls.push("enroll"); };
  const navigation = { push: () => { calls.push("push"); }, refresh: () => { calls.push("refresh"); } };
  const model = { slug: "course", firstLesson: "lesson", enrolled: true, enroll, lessonHref: () => "/lesson", navigation };
  await startCourse(model);
  expect(calls).toEqual(["push"]);
  calls.length = 0;
  await startCourse({ ...model, enrolled: false });
  expect(calls).toEqual(["enroll", "push", "refresh"]);
  calls.length = 0;
  await expect(startCourse({ ...model, enrolled: false, enroll: async () => { throw new Error("FAIL"); } })).rejects.toThrow("FAIL");
  expect(calls).toEqual([]);
  const progress = async () => { calls.push("progress"); };
  await setLessonCompletion({ slug: "course", lessonId: "lesson", enrolled: false, completed: true, enroll, progress, refresh: navigation.refresh });
  expect(calls).toEqual(["enroll", "progress", "refresh"]);
  calls.length = 0;
  await expect(setLessonCompletion({ slug: "course", lessonId: "lesson", enrolled: true, completed: true, enroll, progress: async () => { throw new Error("FAIL"); }, refresh: navigation.refresh })).rejects.toThrow("FAIL");
  expect(calls).toEqual([]);
  await expect(setLessonCompletion({ slug: "course", lessonId: "lesson", enrolled: false, completed: true,
    enroll: async () => { throw new Error("ENROLL FAILED"); }, progress, refresh: navigation.refresh })).rejects.toThrow("ENROLL FAILED");
  expect(calls).toEqual([]);
});

test("R07 successful HTTP responses require decoding and transport allows cancellation/substitution", async () => {
  const signal = new AbortController().signal;
  let passedSignal: AbortSignal | null | undefined;
  const fetcher: typeof fetch = async (_input, init) => { passedSignal = init?.signal; return Response.json({ enrolled: [], completed: [], profile: { name: "Student", email: "student@example.com" } }); };
  const options = { path: "/custom", body: {}, failureLabel: "FAIL", decode: readLearningResponse, fetcher, signal };
  expect((await httpRequest(options)).profile.name).toBe("Student");
  expect(passedSignal).toBe(signal);
  await expect(httpRequest({ ...options, fetcher: async () => Response.json({ enrolled: "bad" }) })).rejects.toThrow("Invalid learning response");
  await expect(httpRequest({ ...options, fetcher: async () => Response.json({ error: "REJECTED" }, { status: 400 }) })).rejects.toThrow("REJECTED");
});

test("R07 completion locks the entire two-request workflow and allows retry after failure", async ({ page }) => {
  const calls: string[] = [];
  let release = () => {};
  const gate = new Promise<void>((resolve) => { release = resolve; });
  const state = { enrolled: ["first-client"], completed: [], profile: { name: "Student", email: "" } };
  await page.route("**/api/enrollments", async (route) => {
    calls.push("enroll");
    await gate;
    await route.fulfill({ contentType: "application/json", body: JSON.stringify(state) });
  });
  await page.route("**/api/progress", async (route) => {
    calls.push("progress");
    await route.fulfill({ status: 400, contentType: "application/json", body: JSON.stringify({ error: "TRY AGAIN" }) });
  });
  await page.goto("/learn/first-client/portfolio");
  const button = page.getByRole("button", { name: "أتممت هذا الدرس", exact: true });
  await button.evaluate((element) => { (element as HTMLButtonElement).click(); (element as HTMLButtonElement).click(); });
  await expect.poll(() => calls).toEqual(["enroll"]);
  await expect(page.getByRole("button", { name: "جارٍ الحفظ…", exact: true })).toBeDisabled();
  release();
  await expect(page.locator(".lms-error[role=alert]")).toHaveText("TRY AGAIN");
  expect(calls).toEqual(["enroll", "progress"]);
  await expect(button).toBeEnabled();
  await button.click();
  await expect.poll(() => calls.length).toBe(4);
});
```

```typescript
for (const trigger of ["scroll", "another video"] as const)
  test(`${trigger} reset aborts an unfinished media response while buffering`, async ({ page }) => {
  const bytes = await readFile("public/assets/video/workshop-intro.mp4");
  const active = new Set<ServerResponse>();
  let aborted = 0;
  const server = createServer((request, response) => {
    const start = Number(request.headers.range?.match(/bytes=(\d+)-/)?.[1] ?? 0);
    response.writeHead(request.headers.range ? 206 : 200, {
      "Content-Type": "video/mp4", "Content-Length": bytes.length - start,
      "Accept-Ranges": "bytes", "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
      ...(request.headers.range ? { "Content-Range": `bytes ${start}-${bytes.length - 1}/${bytes.length}` } : {}),
    });
    active.add(response);
    let offset = start;
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      const end = Math.min(offset + 32768, bytes.length);
      response.write(bytes.subarray(offset, end));
      offset = end;
      if (offset === bytes.length) response.end();
    }, 100);
    response.on("close", () => {
      clearInterval(timer);
      active.delete(response);
      if (offset < bytes.length) aborted++;
    });
  });
  await new Promise<void>((resolve) => server.listen(0, "127.0.0.1", resolve));
  const address = server.address();
  if (!address || typeof address === "string") throw new Error("Missing media server port");
  try {
    await page.goto(`${fixtureUrl}/media-player`);
    await page.getByLabel("Video URL").fill(`http://127.0.0.1:${address.port}/slow.mp4`);
    const player = page.locator('[data-player="custom"]');
    await player.getByRole("button", { name: "PLAY", exact: true }).click();
    await expect.poll(() => active.size).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    const before = aborted;
    if (trigger === "scroll")
      await page.evaluate(() => window.scrollTo(0, document.body.scrollHeight));
    else
      await page.locator('[data-player="other"]').getByRole("button", { name: "PLAY", exact: true }).click();
    await expect(player.locator("video")).toHaveCount(0);
    await expect.poll(() => aborted).toBeGreaterThan(before);
    await expect.poll(() => active.size).toBe(0);
    await player.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
    await expect(player.locator(".media-player-poster")).toBeVisible();
    expect(active.size).toBe(0);
  } finally {
    server.closeAllConnections();
    await new Promise<void>((resolve) => server.close(() => resolve()));
  }
});


for (const previousState of ["playing", "paused"] as const)
  test(`starting another video restores the ${previousState} player's thumbnail and releases its source`, async ({ page }) => {
    await page.goto(`${fixtureUrl}/media-player`);
    const first = page.locator('[data-player="custom"]');
    const second = page.locator('[data-player="other"]');
    await first.getByRole("button", { name: "PLAY", exact: true }).click();
    const video = first.locator("video");
    await expect.poll(() => video.evaluate((node) => (node as HTMLVideoElement).readyState)).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(2);
    await expect.poll(() => video.evaluate((node) => (node as HTMLVideoElement).paused)).toBe(false);
    if (previousState === "paused") {
      await video.click();
      await expect.poll(() => video.evaluate((node) => (node as HTMLVideoElement).paused)).toBe(true);
    }
    const previousVideo = await video.elementHandle();
    await second.getByRole("button", { name: "PLAY", exact: true }).click();
    await expect(first.locator(".media-player-poster")).toBeVisible();
    await expect(first.locator("img")).toHaveAttribute("src", "/assets/images/workshop-video-poster.jpg");
    await expect(video).toHaveCount(0);
    expect(await previousVideo!.evaluate((node) => ({
      src: node.getAttribute("src"), paused: (node as HTMLVideoElement).paused,
      ready: (node as HTMLVideoElement).readyState,
    }))).toEqual({ src: null, paused: true, ready: 0 });
    await expect.poll(() => second.locator("video").evaluate((node) => (node as HTMLVideoElement).paused)).toBe(false);
    const secondVideo = await second.locator("video").elementHandle();
    await first.getByRole("button", { name: "PLAY", exact: true }).click();
    await expect(second.locator(".media-player-poster")).toBeVisible();
    await expect(second.locator("video")).toHaveCount(0);
    expect(await secondVideo!.getAttribute("src")).toBeNull();
    await expect.poll(() => video.evaluate((node) => (node as HTMLVideoElement).paused)).toBe(false);
    expect(await video.evaluate((node) => (node as HTMLVideoElement).currentTime)).toBeLessThan(3);
    await expect(page.locator("video")).toHaveCount(1);
  });
```

```typescript
  await expect
    .poll(

          .locator(".faq-header")
          .evaluate(
```

```tsx
import EmptyState from "../../modules/components/ui/empty-state";
import Symbol from "../../modules/components/ui/symbol";
import type {Course} from "../../modules/types/lms";
/** Compile-only negative contracts; unexpected acceptance fails TypeScript. */
export function verifyTypeContracts(course:Course){
 // @ts-expect-error a navigation action cannot be an unlabeled empty-state link
 const empty=<EmptyState title="EMPTY" description="BODY" href="/courses"/>;
 // @ts-expect-error a button cannot receive a navigation destination
 const button=<Action kind="button" href="/courses">START</Action>;
 // @ts-expect-error icon names are a closed product vocabulary
 const icon=<Symbol name="unknown"/>;

}
```
